+import com.facebook.react.ReactActivity
+import com.facebook.react.ReactActivityDelegate
+import com.facebook.react.bridge.Arguments
+import com.facebook.react.bridge.ReactContext
+import com.facebook.react.bridge.WritableMap
+import com.facebook.react.defaults.DefaultNewArchitectureEntryPoint.fabricEnabled
+import com.facebook.react.defaults.DefaultReactActivityDelegate
+import com.facebook.react.modules.core.DeviceEventManagerModule
+
+class MainActivity : ReactActivity() {
+
+  companion object {
+    private const val TAG = "MainActivity"
+    private var pendingNotificationData: WritableMap? = null
+  }
+
+  /**
+   * Returns the name of the main component registered from JavaScript. This is used to schedule
+   * rendering of the component.
+   */
+  override fun getMainComponentName(): String = "YouTrackMobile"
+
+  /**
+   * Handle notification data when app is opened from notification click
+   */
+  override fun onCreate(savedInstanceState: Bundle?) {
+    super.onCreate(savedInstanceState)
+    Log.d(TAG, "onCreate called")
+
+    // Handle notification intent on app launch
+    handleNotificationIntent(intent)
+
+    // Schedule notification data delivery after React Native is ready
+    scheduleNotificationDataDelivery()
+  }
+
+  /**
+   * Handle new intent when app is already running
+   */
+  override fun onNewIntent(intent: Intent?) {
+    super.onNewIntent(intent)
+    Log.d(TAG, "onNewIntent called")
+    intent?.let {
+      setIntent(it) // Update the intent for future use
+      handleNotificationIntent(it)
+    }
+  }
+
+  /**
+   * Override to handle React context when it becomes available
+   */
+  override fun onResume() {
+    super.onResume()
+    Log.d(TAG, "onResume called, pendingNotificationData exists: ${pendingNotificationData != null}")
+
+    // Try to send notification data when activity resumes
+    // Use longer delay for OPPO devices to ensure React Native is ready
+    Handler(Looper.getMainLooper()).postDelayed({
+      Log.d(TAG, "onResume delayed check triggered")
+      tryToSendNotificationData()
+    }, 2000) // Increased to 2 seconds for OPPO devices
+  }
+
+  /**
+   * Process notification intent and store data for React Native
+   */
+  private fun handleNotificationIntent(intent: Intent) {
+    try {
+      Log.d(TAG, "Processing notification intent")
+      Log.d(TAG, "Intent extras: ${intent.extras}")
+
+      // Check if app was opened from notification
+      val notificationClicked = intent.getBooleanExtra("notification_clicked", false)
+      val fromNotification = intent.getBooleanExtra("from_notification", false)
+
+      if (notificationClicked || fromNotification) {
+        Log.d(TAG, "App opened from notification click")
+
+        // Extract notification data from intent extras
+        val notificationData = Arguments.createMap()
+        intent.extras?.let { extras ->
+          for (key in extras.keySet()) {
+            when (val value = extras.get(key)) {
+              is String -> {
+                notificationData.putString(key, value)
+                Log.d(TAG, "Added string data: $key = $value")
+              }
+              is Int -> notificationData.putInt(key, value)
+              is Boolean -> notificationData.putBoolean(key, value)
+              is Double -> notificationData.putDouble(key, value)
+              else -> {
+                value?.let {
+                  notificationData.putString(key, it.toString())
+                  Log.d(TAG, "Added converted data: $key = ${it.toString()}")
+                }
+              }
+            }
+          }
+        }
+
+        // Store notification data for later delivery
+        pendingNotificationData = notificationData
+        Log.d(TAG, "Stored pending notification data")
+
+        // Don't try to send immediately, wait for React Native to initialize
+        Log.d(TAG, "Notification data stored, will send when React Native is ready")
+      }
+    } catch (e: Exception) {
+      Log.e(TAG, "Error handling notification intent", e)
+    }
+  }
+
+  /**
+   * Send pending notification data to React Native
+   */
+  private fun sendPendingNotificationData(context: ReactContext) {
+    try {
+      pendingNotificationData?.let { data ->
+        Log.d(TAG, "=== START SENDING NOTIFICATION DATA ===")
+        Log.d(TAG, "Data to send: $data")
+        Log.d(TAG, "ReactContext active: ${context.hasActiveCatalystInstance()}")
+        Log.d(TAG, "LifecycleState: ${context.lifecycleState}")
+
+        // Check if JS modules are accessible
+        try {
+          val jsModule = context.getJSModule(DeviceEventManagerModule.RCTDeviceEventEmitter::class.java)
+          Log.d(TAG, "JS Module accessible: ${jsModule != null}")
+        } catch (e: Exception) {
+          Log.e(TAG, "JS Module not ready: ${e.message}")
+          // Don't send if JS module is not ready
+          return
+        }
+
+        // Ensure we're on the JS thread
+        context.runOnJSQueueThread {
+          try {
+            val eventEmitter = context
+              .getJSModule(DeviceEventManagerModule.RCTDeviceEventEmitter::class.java)
+
+            Log.d(TAG, "Emitting 'notificationOpened' event with data")
+
+            // Send the notification data
+            eventEmitter.emit("notificationOpened", data)
+
+            Log.d(TAG, "✅ NOTIFICATION DATA SENT SUCCESSFULLY TO REACT NATIVE")
+            Log.d(TAG, "=== END SENDING NOTIFICATION DATA ===")
+
+            // Clear pending data after successful send
+            pendingNotificationData = null
+          } catch (e: Exception) {
+            Log.e(TAG, "❌ Error emitting notification event", e)
+            Log.e(TAG, "Error details: ${e.message}")
+            // Keep the data for retry
+          }
+        }
+      } ?: Log.d(TAG, "No pending notification data to send")
+    } catch (e: Exception) {
+      Log.e(TAG, "❌ Error in sendPendingNotificationData", e)
+    }
+  }
+
+  /**
+   * Try to send notification data if React Context is ready
+   */
+  private fun tryToSendNotificationData() {
+    try {
+      val reactContext = reactNativeHost?.reactInstanceManager?.currentReactContext
+      if (reactContext != null && reactContext.hasActiveCatalystInstance()) {
+        sendPendingNotificationData(reactContext)
+      } else {
+        Log.d(TAG, "React context not ready yet, scheduling retry")
+        scheduleNotificationDataDelivery()
+      }
+    } catch (e: Exception) {
+      Log.e(TAG, "Error accessing React context", e)
+      scheduleNotificationDataDelivery()
+    }
+  }
+
+  /**
+   * Schedule notification data delivery with retry mechanism
+   */
+  private fun scheduleNotificationDataDelivery() {
+    // Don't schedule if no data to send
+    if (pendingNotificationData == null) {
+      Log.d(TAG, "No pending notification data, skipping schedule")
+      return
+    }
+
+    val handler = Handler(Looper.getMainLooper())
+    var retryCount = 0
+    val maxRetries = 30  // Increased retries for OPPO devices
+    val retryDelay = 1000L // 1 second between retries
+    val initialDelay = 3000L // 3 seconds initial delay for OPPO
+
+    val runnable = object : Runnable {
+      override fun run() {
+        retryCount++
+        Log.d(TAG, "=== Notification Data Retry $retryCount/$maxRetries ===")
+
+        // Still have pending data?
+        if (pendingNotificationData == null) {
+          Log.d(TAG, "Data already sent, stopping retries")
+          return
+        }
+
+        try {
+          val reactInstanceManager = reactNativeHost?.reactInstanceManager
+          Log.d(TAG, "ReactInstanceManager exists: ${reactInstanceManager != null}")
+
+          val reactContext = reactInstanceManager?.currentReactContext
+          Log.d(TAG, "ReactContext exists: ${reactContext != null}")
+
+          if (reactContext != null) {
+            Log.d(TAG, "ReactContext state - hasActiveCatalystInstance: ${reactContext.hasActiveCatalystInstance()}")
+            Log.d(TAG, "ReactContext lifecycle: ${reactContext.lifecycleState}")
+
+            if (reactContext.hasActiveCatalystInstance()) {
+              // Try to check if JS is really ready
+              try {
+                val testModule = reactContext.getJSModule(DeviceEventManagerModule.RCTDeviceEventEmitter::class.java)
+                if (testModule != null) {
+                  Log.d(TAG, "JS modules are ready, sending notification data")
+                  sendPendingNotificationData(reactContext)
+
+                  // Check if data was sent successfully
+                  if (pendingNotificationData == null) {
+                    Log.d(TAG, "✅ Data sent successfully, stopping retries")
+                    return
+                  }
+                }
+              } catch (e: Exception) {
+                Log.d(TAG, "JS modules not ready yet: ${e.message}")
+              }
+            }
+          }
+
+          if (retryCount < maxRetries) {
+            Log.d(TAG, "Scheduling next retry in $retryDelay ms")
+            handler.postDelayed(this, retryDelay)
+          } else {
+            Log.e(TAG, "❌ Failed to send notification data after $maxRetries retries")
+            Log.e(TAG, "Data that couldn't be sent: $pendingNotificationData")
+            pendingNotificationData = null // Clear data after max retries
+          }
+        } catch (e: Exception) {
+          Log.e(TAG, "Error in retry $retryCount: ${e.message}", e)
+          if (retryCount < maxRetries) {
+            handler.postDelayed(this, retryDelay)
+          } else {
+            Log.e(TAG, "Final retry failed", e)
+            pendingNotificationData = null
+          }
+        }
+      }
+    }
+
+    Log.d(TAG, "Scheduling notification data delivery with $initialDelay ms initial delay")
+    handler.postDelayed(runnable, initialDelay)
+  }
+
+  /**
+   * Returns the instance of the [ReactActivityDelegate]. We use [DefaultReactActivityDelegate]
+   * which allows you to enable New Architecture with a single boolean flags [fabricEnabled]
+   */
+  override fun createReactActivityDelegate(): ReactActivityDelegate =
+      DefaultReactActivityDelegate(this, mainComponentName, fabricEnabled)
+}

+package com.csx.mobile.app
+
+import android.app.NotificationChannel
+import android.app.NotificationManager
+import android.app.PendingIntent
+import android.content.Context
+import android.content.Intent
+import android.os.Build
+import android.util.Log
+import androidx.core.app.NotificationCompat
+import com.google.firebase.messaging.FirebaseMessagingService
+import com.google.firebase.messaging.RemoteMessage
+import org.json.JSONObject
+
+/**
+ * Firebase Messaging Service for handling background push notifications
+ * This service runs even when the app is killed/terminated
+ */
+class MyFirebaseMessagingService : FirebaseMessagingService() {
+
+    companion object {
+        private const val TAG = "MyFirebaseMessaging"
+        private const val NOTIFICATION_CHANNEL_ID = "csx_mobile_channel"
+        private const val NOTIFICATION_CHANNEL_NAME = "CSX Mobile Notifications"
+        private const val NOTIFICATION_CHANNEL_DESC = "CSX Mobile push notifications"
+        private const val NOTIFICATION_ID = 1001
+    }
+
+    /**
+     * Called when a new FCM token is generated
+     */
+    override fun onNewToken(token: String) {
+        super.onNewToken(token)
+        Log.d(TAG, "Refreshed token: $token")
+        // Send token to your server if needed
+        sendTokenToServer(token)
+    }
+
+    /**
+     * Called when a message is received
+     * This method is called even when the app is in background or killed
+     */
+    override fun onMessageReceived(remoteMessage: RemoteMessage) {
+        super.onMessageReceived(remoteMessage)
+
+        Log.d(TAG, "From: ${remoteMessage.from}")
+        Log.d(TAG, "Message data: ${remoteMessage.data}")
+        Log.d(TAG, "Message notification: ${remoteMessage.notification}")
+
+        // Check if message contains data payload
+        if (remoteMessage.data.isNotEmpty()) {
+            Log.d(TAG, "Message data payload: ${remoteMessage.data}")
+            handleDataMessage(remoteMessage.data)
+        }
+
+        // Check if message contains notification payload
+        remoteMessage.notification?.let {
+            Log.d(TAG, "Message Notification Body: ${it.body}")
+            showNotification(it.title ?: "CSX Mobile", it.body ?: "", remoteMessage.data)
+        }
+
+        // If no notification payload, create notification from data
+        if (remoteMessage.notification == null && remoteMessage.data.isNotEmpty()) {
+            val title = remoteMessage.data["title"] ?: "CSX Mobile"
+            val body = remoteMessage.data["body"] ?: remoteMessage.data["message"] ?: ""
+            if (body.isNotEmpty()) {
+                showNotification(title, body, remoteMessage.data)
+            }
+        }
+    }
+
+    /**
+     * Handle data message payload
+     */
+    private fun handleDataMessage(data: Map<String, String>) {
+        try {
+            // Process the data based on type
+            val type = data["type"]
+            val action = data["action"]
+
+            Log.d(TAG, "Processing data message - Type: $type, Action: $action")
+
+            // Store data for app to process when opened
+            val sharedPref = getSharedPreferences("push_notification_data", Context.MODE_PRIVATE)
+            with(sharedPref.edit()) {
+                putString("last_notification_data", JSONObject(data).toString())
+                putLong("last_notification_time", System.currentTimeMillis())
+                apply()
+            }
+
+            // Handle specific types
+            when (type) {
+                "appointment" -> handleAppointmentNotification(data)
+                "emergency" -> handleEmergencyNotification(data)
+                "video_call" -> handleVideoCallNotification(data)
+                else -> Log.d(TAG, "Unknown notification type: $type")
+            }
+        } catch (e: Exception) {
+            Log.e(TAG, "Error handling data message", e)
+        }
+    }
+
+    /**
+     * Show notification in system tray
+     */
+    private fun showNotification(title: String, body: String, data: Map<String, String>) {
+        try {
+            val intent = Intent(this, MainActivity::class.java).apply {
+                addFlags(Intent.FLAG_ACTIVITY_CLEAR_TOP or Intent.FLAG_ACTIVITY_SINGLE_TOP)
+                // Pass notification data to activity
+                data.forEach { (key, value) ->
+                    putExtra(key, value)
+                }
+                putExtra("notification_clicked", true)
+            }
+
+            val pendingIntent = PendingIntent.getActivity(
+                this,
+                0,
+                intent,
+                PendingIntent.FLAG_UPDATE_CURRENT or PendingIntent.FLAG_IMMUTABLE
+            )
+
+            val notificationManager = getSystemService(Context.NOTIFICATION_SERVICE) as NotificationManager
+
+            // Create notification channel for Android O and above
+            if (Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= Build.VERSION_CODES.O) {
+                createNotificationChannel(notificationManager)
+            }
+
+            // Build notification
+            val notificationBuilder = NotificationCompat.Builder(this, NOTIFICATION_CHANNEL_ID)
+                .setSmallIcon(R.drawable.notification_icon) // Make sure this icon exists
+                .setContentTitle(title)
+                .setContentText(body)
+                .setAutoCancel(true)
+                .setPriority(NotificationCompat.PRIORITY_HIGH) // High priority for heads-up notification
+                .setCategory(NotificationCompat.CATEGORY_MESSAGE)
+                .setVisibility(NotificationCompat.VISIBILITY_PUBLIC)
+                .setDefaults(NotificationCompat.DEFAULT_ALL) // Sound, vibration, lights
+                .setContentIntent(pendingIntent)
+                .setWhen(System.currentTimeMillis())
+
+            // Add actions based on notification type
+            val type = data["type"]
+            when (type) {
+                "video_call" -> {
+                    // Add accept/decline actions for video calls
+                    val acceptIntent = createActionIntent("ACCEPT_CALL", data)
+                    val declineIntent = createActionIntent("DECLINE_CALL", data)
+
+                    notificationBuilder
+                        .addAction(android.R.drawable.ic_menu_call, "Accept", acceptIntent)
+                        .addAction(android.R.drawable.ic_menu_close_clear_cancel, "Decline", declineIntent)
+                        .setCategory(NotificationCompat.CATEGORY_CALL)
+                        .setPriority(NotificationCompat.PRIORITY_MAX)
+                }
+                "emergency" -> {
+                    notificationBuilder
+                        .setPriority(NotificationCompat.PRIORITY_MAX)
+                        .setCategory(NotificationCompat.CATEGORY_ALARM)
+                }
+            }
+
+            // Show notification with unique ID
+            val notificationId = System.currentTimeMillis().toInt()
+            notificationManager.notify(notificationId, notificationBuilder.build())
+
+            Log.d(TAG, "Notification shown with ID: $notificationId")
+        } catch (e: Exception) {
+            Log.e(TAG, "Error showing notification", e)
+        }
+    }
+
+    /**
+     * Create notification channel for Android O+
+     */
+    private fun createNotificationChannel(notificationManager: NotificationManager) {
+        if (Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= Build.VERSION_CODES.O) {
+            val channel = NotificationChannel(
+                NOTIFICATION_CHANNEL_ID,
+                NOTIFICATION_CHANNEL_NAME,
+                NotificationManager.IMPORTANCE_HIGH
+            ).apply {
+                description = NOTIFICATION_CHANNEL_DESC
+                enableLights(true)
+                enableVibration(true)
+                setShowBadge(true)
+                lockscreenVisibility = NotificationCompat.VISIBILITY_PUBLIC
+            }
+            notificationManager.createNotificationChannel(channel)
+            Log.d(TAG, "Notification channel created: $NOTIFICATION_CHANNEL_ID")
+        }
+    }
+
+    /**
+     * Create pending intent for notification actions
+     */
+    private fun createActionIntent(action: String, data: Map<String, String>): PendingIntent {
+        val intent = Intent(this, MainActivity::class.java).apply {
+            addFlags(Intent.FLAG_ACTIVITY_CLEAR_TOP or Intent.FLAG_ACTIVITY_SINGLE_TOP)
+            putExtra("notification_action", action)
+            data.forEach { (key, value) ->
+                putExtra(key, value)
+            }
+        }
+
+        return PendingIntent.getActivity(
+            this,
+            action.hashCode(),
+            intent,
+            PendingIntent.FLAG_UPDATE_CURRENT or PendingIntent.FLAG_IMMUTABLE
+        )
+    }
+
+    /**
+     * Handle appointment notifications
+     */
+    private fun handleAppointmentNotification(data: Map<String, String>) {
+        val appointmentId = data["appointmentId"]
+        val patientName = data["patientName"] ?: "Patient"
+        val appointmentTime = data["appointmentTime"] ?: ""
+
+        val title = "Appointment Reminder"
+        val body = "You have an appointment with $patientName at $appointmentTime"
+
+        showNotification(title, body, data)
+    }
+
+    /**
+     * Handle emergency notifications
+     */
+    private fun handleEmergencyNotification(data: Map<String, String>) {
+        val title = "Emergency Alert"
+        val body = data["message"] ?: "Emergency notification received"
+
+        showNotification(title, body, data)
+    }
+
+    /**
+     * Handle video call notifications
+     */
+    private fun handleVideoCallNotification(data: Map<String, String>) {
+        val callerName = data["callerName"] ?: "Someone"
+        val title = "Incoming Video Call"
+        val body = "$callerName is calling you"
+
+        showNotification(title, body, data)
+    }
+
+    /**
+     * Send token to server
+     */
+    private fun sendTokenToServer(token: String) {
+        // Store token locally for later use
+        val sharedPref = getSharedPreferences("fcm_data", Context.MODE_PRIVATE)
+        with(sharedPref.edit()) {
+            putString("fcm_token", token)
+            putLong("token_timestamp", System.currentTimeMillis())
+            apply()
+        }
+        Log.d(TAG, "Token saved locally: $token")
+    }
+}

+package com.csx.mobile.app

+class PDFDownloadModule(reactContext: ReactApplicationContext) : ReactContextBaseJavaModule(reactContext) {
+
+    override fun getName(): String {
+        return "PDFDownloadModule"
+    }
+
+    @ReactMethod
+    fun savePDFToDownloads(sourcePath: String, fileName: String, promise: Promise) {
+        try {
+            val sourceFile = File(sourcePath)
+            if (!sourceFile.exists()) {
+                promise.reject("FILE_NOT_FOUND", "Source file does not exist: $sourcePath")
+                return
+            }
+
+            val context = reactApplicationContext
+            
+            // Always save/overwrite the file, don't check if exists
+            Log.d("PDFDownloadModule", "Saving PDF to Downloads (will overwrite if exists)...")
+            
+            // Proceed with saving/overwriting
+            if (Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= Build.VERSION_CODES.Q) {
+                // Android 10+ - Use MediaStore API
+                savePDFWithMediaStore(context, sourceFile, fileName, promise)
+            } else {
+                // Android 9 and below - Direct file access
+                savePDFDirectly(sourceFile, fileName, promise)
+            }
+        } catch (e: Exception) {
+            Log.e("PDFDownloadModule", "Error saving PDF", e)
+            promise.reject("SAVE_ERROR", e.message, e)
+        }
+    }
+
+    private fun savePDFWithMediaStore(context: Context, sourceFile: File, fileName: String, promise: Promise) {
+        try {
+            val resolver = context.contentResolver
+            val audioCollection = if (Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= Build.VERSION_CODES.Q) {
+                MediaStore.Downloads.EXTERNAL_CONTENT_URI
+            } else {
+                MediaStore.Files.getContentUri("external")
+            }
+
+            // First check if file already exists in MediaStore to delete it
+            val projection = arrayOf(
+                MediaStore.Downloads._ID,
+                MediaStore.Downloads.DISPLAY_NAME
+            )
+            val selection = "${MediaStore.Downloads.DISPLAY_NAME} = ?"
+            val selectionArgs = arrayOf(fileName)
+            
+            val cursor = resolver.query(
+                audioCollection,
+                projection,
+                selection,
+                selectionArgs,
+                null
+            )
+            
+            cursor?.use {
+                if (it.moveToFirst()) {
+                    // File already exists in MediaStore, delete it to overwrite
+                    Log.d("PDFDownloadModule", "File already exists in MediaStore, deleting to overwrite: $fileName")
+                    
+                    val idIndex = it.getColumnIndexOrThrow(MediaStore.Downloads._ID)
+                    val existingId = it.getLong(idIndex)
+                    
+                    // Delete existing file from MediaStore
+                    val deleteUri = ContentUris.withAppendedId(audioCollection, existingId)
+                    resolver.delete(deleteUri, null, null)
+                    Log.d("PDFDownloadModule", "Deleted existing file from MediaStore")
+                }
+            }
+
+            // Create new entry (either new file or overwriting)
+            val newPdfDetails = ContentValues().apply {
+                put(MediaStore.Downloads.DISPLAY_NAME, fileName)
+                put(MediaStore.Downloads.MIME_TYPE, "application/pdf")
+                if (Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= Build.VERSION_CODES.Q) {
+                    put(MediaStore.Downloads.IS_PENDING, 1)
+                    put(MediaStore.Downloads.RELATIVE_PATH, Environment.DIRECTORY_DOWNLOADS)
+                }
+            }
+
+            val pdfContentUri = resolver.insert(audioCollection, newPdfDetails)
+            
+            if (pdfContentUri == null) {
+                promise.reject("INSERT_ERROR", "Failed to create MediaStore entry")
+                return
+            }
+
+            resolver.openOutputStream(pdfContentUri)?.use { outputStream ->
+                FileInputStream(sourceFile).use { inputStream ->
+                    inputStream.copyTo(outputStream)
+                }
+            }
+
+            if (Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= Build.VERSION_CODES.Q) {
+                newPdfDetails.clear()
+                newPdfDetails.put(MediaStore.Downloads.IS_PENDING, 0)
+                resolver.update(pdfContentUri, newPdfDetails, null, null)
+            }
+
+            // For Android 10+, the file is saved through MediaStore
+            // We can't get the exact file path reliably, but we know it's in Downloads
+            val downloadsPath = Environment.getExternalStoragePublicDirectory(Environment.DIRECTORY_DOWNLOADS).absolutePath
+            val expectedPath = "$downloadsPath/$fileName"
+            
+            // Check if file exists at expected location (may not on Android 10+ due to scoped storage)
+            val verifyFile = File(expectedPath)
+            val fileExistsAtExpected = verifyFile.exists()
+            
+            Log.d("PDFDownloadModule", "Expected Downloads path: $expectedPath")
+            Log.d("PDFDownloadModule", "File exists at expected path: $fileExistsAtExpected")
+            Log.d("PDFDownloadModule", "Source file path: ${sourceFile.absolutePath}")
+            Log.d("PDFDownloadModule", "Content URI: $pdfContentUri")
+            
+            // For viewing, we should use the source file path since it's accessible
+            // The file is also saved to Downloads via MediaStore for user access
+            val viewablePath = sourceFile.absolutePath // Use source path for immediate viewing
+
+            // Return the result with full path
+            val result = Arguments.createMap().apply {
+                putBoolean("success", true)
+                putString("uri", pdfContentUri.toString()) // MediaStore URI
+                putString("fileName", fileName)
+                putString("path", viewablePath) // Path that can be used for viewing
+                putBoolean("savedToDownloads", true) // File IS saved to Downloads via MediaStore
+                putString("downloadsPath", expectedPath) // Where file should be in Downloads
+                putString("message", "PDF saved/overwritten to Downloads folder via MediaStore")
+            }
+            promise.resolve(result)
+            
+        } catch (e: Exception) {
+            Log.e("PDFDownloadModule", "MediaStore save failed", e)
+            promise.reject("MEDIASTORE_ERROR", e.message, e)
+        }
+    }
+
+    private fun savePDFDirectly(sourceFile: File, fileName: String, promise: Promise) {
+        try {
+            val downloadsDir = Environment.getExternalStoragePublicDirectory(Environment.DIRECTORY_DOWNLOADS)
+            if (!downloadsDir.exists()) {
+                downloadsDir.mkdirs()
+            }
+
+            val destFile = File(downloadsDir, fileName)
+            
+            // Delete existing file if it exists
+            if (destFile.exists()) {
+                Log.d("PDFDownloadModule", "File already exists, deleting to overwrite: ${destFile.absolutePath}")
+                destFile.delete()
+            }
+            
+            FileInputStream(sourceFile).use { input ->
+                FileOutputStream(destFile).use { output ->
+                    input.copyTo(output)
+                }
+            }
+
+            Log.d("PDFDownloadModule", "PDF saved/overwritten directly to: ${destFile.absolutePath}")
+
+            // IMPORTANT: Return source path for viewing, not Downloads path
+            // Even on Android 9 and below, we should use source for consistency
+            val result = Arguments.createMap().apply {
+                putBoolean("success", true)
+                putString("path", sourceFile.absolutePath) // Use source file for viewing
+                putString("fileName", fileName)
+                putBoolean("savedToDownloads", true)
+                putString("downloadsPath", destFile.absolutePath) // Store actual Downloads path separately
+            }
+            promise.resolve(result)
+            
+        } catch (e: Exception) {
+            Log.e("PDFDownloadModule", "Direct save failed", e)
+            promise.reject("DIRECT_SAVE_ERROR", e.message, e)
+        }
+    }
+
+    @ReactMethod
+    fun openDownloadsFolder(promise: Promise) {
+        try {
+            val context = reactApplicationContext
+            val downloadsPath = Environment.getExternalStoragePublicDirectory(Environment.DIRECTORY_DOWNLOADS).absolutePath
+            
+            // Method 1: Try to open with system file manager using DocumentsContract
+            try {
+                val downloadsUri = if (Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= Build.VERSION_CODES.Q) {
+                    // Use DocumentsContract to create proper URI for Downloads folder
+                    val externalStorageUri = Uri.parse("content://com.android.externalstorage.documents/tree/primary%3ADownload")
+                    externalStorageUri
+                } else {
+                    // For older Android versions
+                    Uri.parse("content://com.android.externalstorage.documents/document/primary%3ADownload")
+                }
+                
+                val intent = Intent(Intent.ACTION_VIEW).apply {
+                    setDataAndType(downloadsUri, DocumentsContract.Document.MIME_TYPE_DIR)
+                    addFlags(Intent.FLAG_ACTIVITY_NEW_TASK)
+                    addFlags(Intent.FLAG_GRANT_READ_URI_PERMISSION)
+                    addFlags(Intent.FLAG_GRANT_WRITE_URI_PERMISSION)
+                    addFlags(Intent.FLAG_GRANT_PERSISTABLE_URI_PERMISSION)
+                }
+                
+                context.startActivity(intent)
+                Log.d("PDFDownloadModule", "Opened Downloads folder with DocumentsContract")
+                promise.resolve(true)
+                return
+            } catch (e1: Exception) {
+                Log.d("PDFDownloadModule", "DocumentsContract method failed, trying next method: ${e1.message}")
+            }
+            
+            // Method 2: Try to find and launch file manager directly
+            val packageManager = context.packageManager
+            
+            // Common file manager package names with specific intents
+            val fileManagerConfigs = listOf(
+                // System file manager
+                Pair("com.android.documentsui", null),
+                // Google Files
+                Pair("com.google.android.apps.nbu.files", "android.intent.action.VIEW"),
+                // Samsung My Files
+                Pair("com.sec.android.app.myfiles", "samsung.myfiles.intent.action.NAVIGATE_TO"),
+                // Xiaomi File Manager
+                Pair("com.mi.android.globalFileexplorer", null),
+                // OPPO File Manager
+                Pair("com.coloros.filemanager", null),
+                // Vivo File Manager  
+                Pair("com.android.filemanager", null),
+                // OnePlus File Manager
+                Pair("com.oneplus.filemanager", null),
+                // Huawei File Manager
+                Pair("com.huawei.hidisk", null)
+            )
+            
+            for ((packageName, customAction) in fileManagerConfigs) {
+                try {
+                    // Check if package exists
+                    packageManager.getPackageInfo(packageName, 0)
+                    
+                    val intent = if (customAction != null && packageName == "com.sec.android.app.myfiles") {
+                        // Special handling for Samsung My Files
+                        Intent(customAction).apply {
+                            putExtra("samsung.myfiles.intent.extra.START_PATH", downloadsPath)
+                            setPackage(packageName)
+                        }
+                    } else {
+                        // Generic approach for other file managers
+                        Intent(Intent.ACTION_VIEW).apply {
+                            setDataAndType(Uri.parse("file://$downloadsPath"), "resource/folder")
+                            setPackage(packageName)
+                        }
+                    }
+                    
+                    intent.addFlags(Intent.FLAG_ACTIVITY_NEW_TASK)
+                    intent.addFlags(Intent.FLAG_GRANT_READ_URI_PERMISSION)
+                    
+                    context.startActivity(intent)
+                    Log.d("PDFDownloadModule", "Successfully opened file manager: $packageName")
+                    promise.resolve(true)
+                    return
+                    
+                } catch (e: Exception) {
+                    // Package not found or cannot be opened, try next
+                    Log.d("PDFDownloadModule", "Failed to open $packageName: ${e.message}")
+                    continue
+                }
+            }
+            
+            // Method 3: Last resort - open any file manager app
+            try {
+                val intent = Intent(Intent.ACTION_VIEW).apply {
+                    val uri = Uri.parse("content://com.android.externalstorage.documents/document/primary%3ADownload")
+                    setDataAndType(uri, "*/*")
+                    addFlags(Intent.FLAG_ACTIVITY_NEW_TASK)
+                    addFlags(Intent.FLAG_GRANT_READ_URI_PERMISSION)
+                }
+                
+                context.startActivity(intent)
+                Log.d("PDFDownloadModule", "Opened with generic file viewer")
+                promise.resolve(true)
+                return
+            } catch (e: Exception) {
+                Log.e("PDFDownloadModule", "All file manager opening methods failed", e)
+            }
+            
+            promise.reject("OPEN_FOLDER_ERROR", "Could not open Downloads folder. No compatible file manager found.")
+            
+        } catch (e: Exception) {
+            Log.e("PDFDownloadModule", "Failed to open Downloads folder", e)
+            promise.reject("OPEN_FOLDER_ERROR", "Failed to open Downloads folder: ${e.message}", e)
+        }
+    }
+

+    fun generateAndSavePDF(html: String, fileName: String, width: Int, height: Int, promise: Promise) {
+        try {
+            val context = reactApplicationContext
+            
+            // First generate PDF to temp file using existing method

+    private fun getFilePathFromUri(context: Context, uri: Uri): String? {
+        return try {
+            // For Android 10+, we can't reliably get the file path from MediaStore
+            // So we'll construct it from known Downloads directory and file name
+            if (Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= Build.VERSION_CODES.Q) {
+                // Query for display name
+                val projection = arrayOf(MediaStore.MediaColumns.DISPLAY_NAME)
+                val cursor: Cursor? = context.contentResolver.query(uri, projection, null, null, null)
+                
+                cursor?.use {
+                    if (it.moveToFirst()) {
+                        val nameIndex = it.getColumnIndexOrThrow(MediaStore.MediaColumns.DISPLAY_NAME)
+                        val fileName = it.getString(nameIndex)
+                        val downloadsPath = Environment.getExternalStoragePublicDirectory(Environment.DIRECTORY_DOWNLOADS).absolutePath
+                        val constructedPath = "$downloadsPath/$fileName"
+                        
+                        // Verify the file exists
+                        val file = File(constructedPath)
+                        if (file.exists()) {
+                            Log.d("PDFDownloadModule", "File verified at: $constructedPath")
+                            return constructedPath
+                        } else {
+                            Log.w("PDFDownloadModule", "File not found at constructed path: $constructedPath")
+                        }
+                    }
+                }
+                
+                // Fallback: return null, will use default path
+                null
+            } else {
+                // For older Android versions, DATA column is reliable
+                val projection = arrayOf(MediaStore.MediaColumns.DATA)
+                val cursor: Cursor? = context.contentResolver.query(uri, projection, null, null, null)
+                
+                cursor?.use {
+                    if (it.moveToFirst()) {
+                        val columnIndex = it.getColumnIndexOrThrow(MediaStore.MediaColumns.DATA)
+                        return it.getString(columnIndex)
+                    }
+                }
+                null
+            }
+        } catch (e: Exception) {
+            Log.e("PDFDownloadModule", "Error getting file path from URI", e)
+            null
+        }
+    }
+}

diff --git a/babel-plugin-fix-tslib-this.js b/babel-plugin-fix-tslib-this.js
new file mode 100644
index 00000000..1f9e9cb7
--- /dev/null
+++ b/babel-plugin-fix-tslib-this.js
@@ -0,0 +1,120 @@
+/**
+ * Babel Plugin: Fix tslib "this" reference in strict mode
+ *
+ * Problem: tslib helpers use pattern `(this && this.__extends)` which fails
+ * in ES modules/strict mode where `this` is `undefined`.
+ *
+ * Solution: Replace `this` with `globalThis` in tslib helper patterns.
+ *
+ * Transforms:
+ *   (this && this.__extends) => (globalThis && globalThis.__extends)
+ *   (this && this.__assign)  => (globalThis && globalThis.__assign)
+ *   etc.
+ *
+ * IMPORTANT: Only transform SPECIFIC tslib helper names, not all __xxx patterns!
+ * React Native uses __guard, __callFunction, etc. which must NOT be transformed.
+ */
+
+// Specific tslib helper names that should be transformed
+// These are the standard TypeScript helper function names
+const TSLIB_HELPERS = new Set([
+  // TypeScript style (double underscore)
+  '__extends',
+  '__assign',
+  '__rest',
+  '__decorate',
+  '__param',
+  '__metadata',
+  '__awaiter',
+  '__generator',
+  '__spreadArray',
+  '__values',
+  '__read',
+  '__createBinding',
+  '__exportStar',
+  '__spread',
+  '__spreadArrays',
+  '__asyncGenerator',
+  '__asyncDelegator',
+  '__asyncValues',
+  '__makeTemplateObject',
+  '__importStar',
+  '__importDefault',
+  '__classPrivateFieldGet',
+  '__classPrivateFieldSet',
+  '__classPrivateFieldIn',
+  // Babel style (single underscore) - kept separate for clarity
+  '_extends',
+  '_objectSpread',
+  '_objectSpread2',
+]);
+
+// Check if a name is a tslib helper
+function isTslibHelper(name) {
+  return TSLIB_HELPERS.has(name);
+}
+
+let transformCount = 0;
+
+module.exports = function() {
+  return {
+    name: 'fix-tslib-this',
+    visitor: {
+      // Transform: (this && this.__xxx) => (globalThis && globalThis.__xxx)
+      // Only for specific tslib helpers
+      LogicalExpression(path) {
+        const { node } = path;
+
+        // Check if it's: this && this.__xxx
+        if (
+          node.operator === '&&' &&
+          node.left.type === 'ThisExpression' &&
+          node.right.type === 'MemberExpression' &&
+          node.right.object.type === 'ThisExpression' &&
+          node.right.property.type === 'Identifier'
+        ) {
+          const helperName = node.right.property.name;
+
+          // ONLY transform known tslib helpers, not all __xxx patterns
+          if (isTslibHelper(helperName)) {
+            transformCount++;
+            if (transformCount <= 10) {
+              console.log(`[babel-plugin-fix-tslib-this] Transformed: this.${helperName} -> globalThis.${helperName}`);
+            }
+            node.left = {
+              type: 'Identifier',
+              name: 'globalThis'
+            };
+            node.right.object = {
+              type: 'Identifier',
+              name: 'globalThis'
+            };
+          }
+        }
+      },
+
+      // Also handle direct this.__xxx access (without && guard)
+      // Only for specific tslib helpers
+      MemberExpression(path) {
+        const { node } = path;
+
+        // Check if it's: this.__xxx
+        if (
+          node.object.type === 'ThisExpression' &&
+          node.property.type === 'Identifier'
+        ) {
+          const helperName = node.property.name;
+
+          // ONLY transform known tslib helpers, not all __xxx patterns
+          // This prevents breaking React Native's internal __guard, __callFunction, etc.
+          if (isTslibHelper(helperName)) {
+            node.object = {
+              type: 'Identifier',
+              name: 'globalThis'
+            };
+          }
+        }
+      }
+    }
+  };
+};

+import UIKit

+// 不需要重新定义协议，直接使用 react-native-app-auth 库提供的协议
+// RNAppAuthAuthorizationFlowManager 通常来自 react-native-app-auth 库
+
+@main
+class AppDelegate: UIResponder, UIApplicationDelegate, UNUserNotificationCenterDelegate, MessagingDelegate {
+    var window: UIWindow?
+    
+    var reactNativeDelegate: ReactNativeDelegate?
+    var reactNativeFactory: RCTReactNativeFactory?
+    
+    // 这个属性需要根据实际的库来定义
+    var authorizationFlowManagerDelegate: AnyObject?

+    func application(
+        _ application: UIApplication,
+        didFinishLaunchingWithOptions launchOptions: [UIApplication.LaunchOptionsKey: Any]? = nil
+    ) -> Bool {
+        // 配置 Firebase 应用实例，通常使用 GoogleService-Info.plist 文件中的设置
+        FirebaseApp.configure()
+        
+        // 设置消息中心的代理
+        UNUserNotificationCenter.current().delegate = self
+        
+        // 请求推送通知权限
+        UNUserNotificationCenter.current().requestAuthorization(options: [.alert, .badge, .sound]) { granted, error in
+            if granted {
+                DispatchQueue.main.async {
+                    application.registerForRemoteNotifications()
+                }
+            }
+            // 错误处理
+            if let error = error {
+                print("Error requesting authorization for notification: \(error)")
+            }
+        }
+        
+        // 设置 Firebase 消息代理
+        Messaging.messaging().delegate = self
+        
+        let delegate = ReactNativeDelegate()
+        let factory = RCTReactNativeFactory(delegate: delegate)
+        delegate.dependencyProvider = RCTAppDependencyProvider()
+        
+        reactNativeDelegate = delegate
+        reactNativeFactory = factory
+        
+        window = UIWindow(frame: UIScreen.main.bounds)
+        
+        factory.startReactNative(
+            withModuleName: "YouTrackMobile",
+            in: window,
+            launchOptions: launchOptions
+        )
+        
+        // 设置根视图背景色
+        if let rootView = window?.rootViewController?.view {
+            if #available(iOS 13.0, *) {
+                rootView.backgroundColor = UIColor.systemBackground
+            } else {
+                rootView.backgroundColor = UIColor.white
+            }
+        }
+        
+        return true
+    }
+

+

+        // 将 APNs 令牌传递给 Firebase
+        Messaging.messaging().apnsToken = deviceToken
+    }
+    
+    func application(_ application: UIApplication, didFailToRegisterForRemoteNotificationsWithError error: Error) {

+        // 处理接收到的远程通知
+        completionHandler(.noData)
+    }
+    
+    // MARK: - App Lifecycle
+

+        let blurEffect = UIBlurEffect(style: .regular)
+        let blurEffectView = UIVisualEffectView(effect: blurEffect)

+        blurEffectView.autoresizingMask = [.flexibleWidth, .flexibleHeight]

+    func application(_ app: UIApplication, open url: URL, options: [UIApplication.OpenURLOptionsKey : Any] = [:]) -> Bool {
+        // 安全地尝试调用 resumeExternalUserAgentFlow 方法
+        if let authDelegate = authorizationFlowManagerDelegate as? NSObject,
+           authDelegate.responds(to: Selector(("resumeExternalUserAgentFlowWithUrl:"))) {
+            let method = unsafeBitCast(
+                authDelegate.method(for: Selector(("resumeExternalUserAgentFlowWithUrl:"))),

+            )

+        }
+        return RCTLinkingManager.application(app, open: url, options: options)
+    }
+    
+    func application(_ application: UIApplication, continue userActivity: NSUserActivity, restorationHandler: @escaping ([UIUserActivityRestoring]?) -> Void) -> Bool {
+        if userActivity.activityType == NSUserActivityTypeBrowsingWeb {
+            if let authDelegate = authorizationFlowManagerDelegate as? NSObject,
+               authDelegate.responds(to: Selector(("resumeExternalUserAgentFlowWithUrl:"))) {
+                let method = unsafeBitCast(
+                    authDelegate.method(for: Selector(("resumeExternalUserAgentFlowWithUrl:"))),
+                    to: (@convention(c)(AnyObject, Selector, URL?) -> Bool).self
+                )
+                let resumableAuth = method(authDelegate, Selector(("resumeExternalUserAgentFlowWithUrl:")), userActivity.webpageURL)
+                if resumableAuth {
+                    return true
+                }
+            }
+        }
+        return RCTLinkingManager.application(application, continue: userActivity, restorationHandler: restorationHandler)
+    }
+    
+    // MARK: - UNUserNotificationCenterDelegate
+    
+    // 用于在前台收到通知时展示通知的回调
+    func userNotificationCenter(_ center: UNUserNotificationCenter, willPresent notification: UNNotification, withCompletionHandler completionHandler: @escaping (UNNotificationPresentationOptions) -> Void) {
+        completionHandler([.sound, .alert, .badge])
+    }
+    
+    // MARK: - MessagingDelegate
+    
+    // Firebase 消息代理的回调，用于接收到 FCM 令牌更新
+    func messaging(_ messaging: Messaging, didReceiveRegistrationToken fcmToken: String?) {
+        print("FCM registration token: \(String(describing: fcmToken))")
+        // Note: This callback is fired at each app startup and whenever a new token is generated.
+    }
+}

+    override func sourceURL(for bridge: RCTBridge) -> URL? {
+        self.bundleURL()
+    }
+
+    override func bundleURL() -> URL? {
+#if DEBUG
+        return RCTBundleURLProvider.sharedSettings().jsBundleURL(forBundleRoot: "index")
+#else
+        return Bundle.main.url(forResource: "main", withExtension: "jsbundle")
+#endif
+    }

diff --git a/scripts/fix-tslib-this.js b/scripts/fix-tslib-this.js
new file mode 100644
index 00000000..73a4d49d
--- /dev/null
+++ b/scripts/fix-tslib-this.js
@@ -0,0 +1,108 @@
+/**
+ * Fix tslib "this" reference in node_modules
+ *
+ * This script patches all files that use the problematic pattern:
+ *   (this && this.__extends)
+ *
+ * And replaces it with:
+ *   (globalThis && globalThis.__extends)
+ *
+ * Run this after npm install:
+ *   node scripts/fix-tslib-this.js
+ */
+
+const fs = require('fs');
+const path = require('path');
+
+const NODE_MODULES = path.join(__dirname, '..', 'node_modules');
+
+// Packages known to have this issue
+const PACKAGES_TO_PATCH = [
+  'rxjs',
+  'recyclerlistview',
+  'i18n-js',
+  'lodash',
+];
+
+// Pattern to find and replace
+const PATTERNS = [
+  { find: /\(this && this\.__extends\)/g, replace: '(globalThis && globalThis.__extends)' },
+  { find: /\(this && this\.__assign\)/g, replace: '(globalThis && globalThis.__assign)' },
+  { find: /\(this && this\.__rest\)/g, replace: '(globalThis && globalThis.__rest)' },
+  { find: /\(this && this\.__decorate\)/g, replace: '(globalThis && globalThis.__decorate)' },
+  { find: /\(this && this\.__param\)/g, replace: '(globalThis && globalThis.__param)' },
+  { find: /\(this && this\.__metadata\)/g, replace: '(globalThis && globalThis.__metadata)' },
+  { find: /\(this && this\.__awaiter\)/g, replace: '(globalThis && globalThis.__awaiter)' },
+  { find: /\(this && this\.__generator\)/g, replace: '(globalThis && globalThis.__generator)' },
+  { find: /\(this && this\.__spreadArray\)/g, replace: '(globalThis && globalThis.__spreadArray)' },
+  { find: /\(this && this\.__values\)/g, replace: '(globalThis && globalThis.__values)' },
+  { find: /\(this && this\.__read\)/g, replace: '(globalThis && globalThis.__read)' },
+  { find: /\(this && this\.__createBinding\)/g, replace: '(globalThis && globalThis.__createBinding)' },
+  { find: /\(this && this\.__exportStar\)/g, replace: '(globalThis && globalThis.__exportStar)' },
+];
+
+let totalFilesPatched = 0;
+let totalReplacements = 0;
+
+function patchFile(filePath) {
+  try {
+    let content = fs.readFileSync(filePath, 'utf8');
+    let modified = false;
+    let fileReplacements = 0;
+
+    for (const pattern of PATTERNS) {
+      const matches = content.match(pattern.find);
+      if (matches) {
+        content = content.replace(pattern.find, pattern.replace);
+        modified = true;
+        fileReplacements += matches.length;
+      }
+    }
+
+    if (modified) {
+      fs.writeFileSync(filePath, content, 'utf8');
+      totalFilesPatched++;
+      totalReplacements += fileReplacements;
+      console.log(`  ✓ Patched: ${path.relative(NODE_MODULES, filePath)} (${fileReplacements} replacements)`);
+    }
+  } catch (error) {
+    console.error(`  ✗ Error patching ${filePath}: ${error.message}`);
+  }
+}
+
+function walkDir(dir, callback) {
+  if (!fs.existsSync(dir)) return;
+
+  const files = fs.readdirSync(dir);
+  for (const file of files) {
+    const filePath = path.join(dir, file);
+    const stat = fs.statSync(filePath);
+
+    if (stat.isDirectory()) {
+      walkDir(filePath, callback);
+    } else if (file.endsWith('.js')) {
+      callback(filePath);
+    }
+  }
+}
+
+console.log('╔════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════╗');
+console.log('║  Fix tslib "this" reference in node_modules                    ║');
+console.log('║  Fixing: (this && this.__xxx) -> (globalThis && globalThis.__xxx) ║');
+console.log('╚════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════╝');
+console.log('');
+
+for (const pkg of PACKAGES_TO_PATCH) {
+  const pkgPath = path.join(NODE_MODULES, pkg);
+  if (fs.existsSync(pkgPath)) {
+    console.log(`📦 Patching ${pkg}...`);
+    walkDir(pkgPath, patchFile);
+  } else {
+    console.log(`⚠️  Package ${pkg} not found, skipping...`);
+  }
+}
+
+console.log('');
+console.log('════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════');
+console.log(`✅ Done! Patched ${totalFilesPatched} files with ${totalReplacements} replacements.`);
+console.log('════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════');
diff --git a/skiaMock.js b/skiaMock.js

@@ -0,0 +1,349 @@
+/**
+ * Comprehensive mock module for @shopify/react-native-skia
+ * This prevents runtime errors when @wuba/react-native-echarts tries to use Skia APIs
+ * We only use SVG renderer, so Skia functionality is not needed
+ *
+ * IMPORTANT: This mock is completely self-contained with NO external imports
+ * to avoid circular dependencies during module initialization
+ */
+
+'use strict';
+
+// ============================================
+// React Components (lazy-loaded to avoid circular deps)
+// ============================================
+
+// Use a getter to lazily require React only when component is actually used
+const createComponent = (displayName) => {
+  // Return a function component that returns null (renders nothing)
+  const Component = function(props) {
+    return null;
+  };
+  Component.displayName = displayName;
+  return Component;
+};
+
+// Create a forwardRef component lazily
+const createForwardRefComponent = (displayName) => {
+  let cached = null;
+  return function(...args) {
+    if (!cached) {
+      // Lazily require React only when actually used
+      try {
+        const React = require('react');
+        cached = React.forwardRef(function(props, ref) {
+          return null;
+        });
+        cached.displayName = displayName;
+      } catch (e) {
+        // Fallback if React not available
+        cached = createComponent(displayName);
+      }
+    }
+    return cached;
+  };
+};
+
+// Main Canvas component - will be a no-op component
+const Canvas = createComponent('SkiaCanvas');
+
+// Group component for grouping elements
+const Group = createComponent('SkiaGroup');
+
+// Rect component for rectangles
+const Rect = createComponent('SkiaRect');
+
+// Path component for custom paths
+const Path = createComponent('SkiaPath');
+
+// Image component
+const Image = createComponent('SkiaImage');
+
+// Shadow component
+const Shadow = createComponent('SkiaShadow');
+
+// Gradient components
+const LinearGradient = createComponent('SkiaLinearGradient');
+const RadialGradient = createComponent('SkiaRadialGradient');
+
+// Text/Paragraph component
+const Paragraph = createComponent('SkiaParagraph');

+export const login = async (
+  installationId: string = 'GhostKnowDEV' /**/,
+  username: string = 'Heals' /**/,
+  password: string = 'Heals', /**/
+  ignoreMFA: boolean = false,
+): Promise<LoginData> => {
+  console.log('api login username=', username); //
+  console.log('api login password=', password); //
+  console.log('api login installationId=', installationId); //
+  // Add breadcrumb for login attempt
+  addBreadcrumb('Login attempt started', 'auth', {
+    username,
+    installationId,
+    timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),
+  });
+  // Check for old app data conflict
+  const cachedTenantId = await storage.getItem(storage.csxMobileCachekeys.TenantID);
+  const isOldAppConflict = cachedTenantId && cachedTenantId !== installationId.trim();
+  //
+  // if (isOldAppConflict) {
+  //   console.warn('Detected potential old app conflict, clearing storage');
+  //   await storage.clearCsxMobileStorage();
+  // }
+  // Create AbortController for request cancellation
+  const abortController = new AbortController();
+  const requestStartTime = Date.now();
+  // Create timeout promise with enhanced error info
+  const timeoutPromise = new Promise<never>((_, reject) => {
+    setTimeout(() => {
+      console.log('api login timeoutPromise abortController.abort()')
+      abortController.abort(); // Cancel the fetch request
+      const timeoutError = new Error('api FETCH_TIMEOUT: Login request timeout after 4 seconds');
+      timeoutError.name = 'TimeoutError';
+      (timeoutError as any).isTimeout = true;
+      (timeoutError as any).timeoutDuration = 10000;
+      (timeoutError as any).actualDuration = Date.now() - requestStartTime;
+      reject(timeoutError);
+    }, 10000);
+  });
+  try {
+    const url = constant.API_BASE_URL + '/Account/Login';
+    console.log('api login url=', url);
+    const body = {username: username.trim(), password: password.trim(), installationId: installationId.trim(), ignoreMFA};
+    storage.setItem(storage.csxMobileCachekeys.TenantID, installationId.trim());
+    console.log('api login body=', body);
+    // Race between fetch and timeout with AbortController
+    const fetchPromise = new Promise<Response>((resolve, reject) => {
+      {
+        // Normal request
+        fetch(url, {
+          method: 'POST',
+          headers: {
+            'Content-Type': 'application/json',
+          },
+          body: JSON.stringify(body),
+          signal: abortController.signal,
+        })
+          .then(resolve)
+          .catch(reject);
+      }
+    });
+    console.log('Starting Promise.race between fetch and timeout...');
+    let response = await Promise.race([fetchPromise, timeoutPromise]);
+    console.log('api login response=', response);
+    // 获取从服务器响应中的Set-Cookie头部,debugger模式下,在response.headers中没有set-cookie,只能关了debug在终端查看
+    const setCookieHeader = response.headers.get('set-cookie');
+    console.log('api login setCookieHeader=', setCookieHeader);
+    if (setCookieHeader) {
+      // 在这里，你需要自己实现一个函数来保存cookie到某处，例如AsyncStorage
+      // await storage.setItem(storage.csxMobileCachekeys.cookie, setCookieHeader);
+      global.cookie = setCookieHeader; // 关闭chrome 调试 才有cookie
+    }
+    let json = await response.json();
+    console.log('api login json=', json);
+    if (json.code === 200) {
+      // await storage.setItem(storage.csxMobileCachekeys.Login, json.data)
+      global.curClinicData = null;
+      global.curDoctorData = null;
+      // Update Sentry user context on successful login
+      setUserContext(json.data?.username, username, installationId);
+      addBreadcrumb('Login successful', 'auth', {
+        username,
+        installationId,
+      });
+      return Promise.resolve({username, ...json.data});

+/**
+ * Register push notification client with backend server
+ * Supports both Firebase FCM and Huawei HMS Push
+ * @param token - Push token (FCM or HMS)
+ * @param pushType - Type of push service: 'fcm' or 'hms' (default: 'fcm')
+ */
+export const register_client = async (token?: string, pushType: 'fcm' | 'hms' = 'fcm') => {
+  try {
+    const url = constant.API_BASE_URL + '/notification/v1/push/register-client';
+    console.log('api register_client url=', url);
+    logUtils.addLog('info', 'api register_client url=', '', url);
+    if (!token) {
+      // Only try to get FCM token if pushType is 'fcm'
+      // HMS tokens should always be passed explicitly
+      if (pushType === 'fcm') {
+        // 当网络访问Google Firebase不畅时，messaging().getToken()会花费数十秒才继续执行，造成登录无反应的现象，影响用户体验
+        // android和iOS都存在此现象
+        // 添加超时机制
+        const tokenPromise = messaging().getToken();
+        const timeoutPromise = new Promise<string>((_, reject) => {
+          setTimeout(() => reject(new Error('FCM token fetch timeout')), 2000); // 2秒超时
         });
-        console.log('api register_client response=', response)
-        if (!response.ok) {
-            return null
-        } else {
-            let json = await response.json();
-            console.log('api register_client json=', json)
-            return json
-        }
-    } catch (error) {
-        console.error('api register_client error=', error);
-        return null
-    }
-}
+
+        try {
+          token = await Promise.race([tokenPromise, timeoutPromise]);
+        } catch (error) {
+          // 如果获取 token 失败，可以选择跳过或使用默认值
+          return null; // 或者继续执行其他逻辑
+        }
+      } else {
+        console.log('api register_client: HMS token must be provided explicitly');
+        return null;
+      }
+    }
+    const deviceId = await DeviceInfo.getUniqueId();
+    const body = {
+      clientId: 'cs-mobile',
+      token,
+      deviceId,
+      pushType // Add pushType to distinguish FCM from HMS tokens
+    };
+    console.log('api register_client body=', body);
+    logUtils.addLog('info', 'api register_client body=', '', body);
+    let response = await fetch(url, {
+      method: 'POST', // 指定请求方法
+      headers: headers(),
+      body: JSON.stringify(body),
+    });
+    console.log('api register_client response=', response);
+    logUtils.addLog('info', 'api register_client response=', '', response);
+    if (!response.ok) {
+      return null;
+    } else {
+      let json = await response.json();
+      console.log('api register_client json=', json);
+      logUtils.addLog('info', 'api register_client json=', '', json);
+      return json;
+    }
+  } catch (error) {
+    console.error('api register_client error=', error);
+    logUtils.addLog('info', 'api register_client error=', '', error);
+    return null;
+  }
+};

+export const open_biometrics_auth = async (p, username?: string, tenantID?: string): Promise<open_biometrics_auth_data | null> => {
+  try {
+    console.log('api open_biometrics_auth p=', p);
+    const keys = generateKeys();
+    console.log('api open_biometrics_auth keys=', keys);
+    // ✅ 使用用户维度的缓存键
+    const publicKeyKey = username && tenantID
+      ? storage.getUserStorageKey(storage.csxMobileCachekeys.publicKey, username, tenantID)
+      : storage.csxMobileCachekeys.publicKey;
+    console.log('api open_biometrics_auth publicKeyKey=', publicKeyKey);
+    const privateKeyKey = username && tenantID
+      ? storage.getUserStorageKey(storage.csxMobileCachekeys.privateKey, username, tenantID)
+      : storage.csxMobileCachekeys.privateKey;
+    console.log('api open_biometrics_auth privateKeyKey=', privateKeyKey);
+    const authDataKey = username && tenantID
+      ? storage.getUserStorageKey(storage.csxMobileCachekeys.open_biometrics_auth_data, username, tenantID)
+      : storage.csxMobileCachekeys.open_biometrics_auth_data;
+    console.log('api open_biometrics_auth authDataKey=', authDataKey);
+    await storage.setItem(publicKeyKey, keys.publicKey);
+    await storage.setItem(privateKeyKey, keys.privateKey);
+    const BearerTKey = 'Bearer ' + global.token;
+    console.log('open_biometrics_auth BearerTKey=', BearerTKey);
+    let md5_signature = CryptoJS.MD5(BearerTKey).toString();
+    console.log('open_biometrics_auth md5_signature=', md5_signature);
+    const signature = getSHA256withRSA(md5_signature, keys.privateKey);
+    const url = constant.API_BASE_URL + '/Account/open-biometrics-auth';
+    console.log('api open_biometrics_auth url=', url);
+    const body = {...p, signature, halg: 'SHA256', publicKey: keys.publicKey}; // 将JavaScript对象转换为字符串
+    console.log('api open_biometrics_auth body=', body);
+    let response = await fetch(url, {
+      method: 'POST', // 指定请求方法
+      headers: headers(),
+      body: JSON.stringify(body),
+    });
+    console.log('api open_biometrics_auth response=', response);
+    if (!response.ok) {
+      return null;
+    }
+    let json = await response.json();
+    console.log('api open_biometrics_auth json=', json);
+    if (json.code === 0 || json.code === 200) {
+      await storage.setItem(authDataKey, json.data);
+      return json.data;
+    }
+    return null;
+  } catch (error) {
+    console.error('open_biometrics_auth error=', error);
+    return null;
+  }

+/**
+ * 通过生物认证登录
+ * @param p : {
+ * biometricsId: string,
+ * secret: string,
+ * publicKey: string
+ * username: string,
+ * tenantID: string
+ * }
+ * return: sign_in_by_biometrics_data | null
+ */
+export const sign_in_by_biometrics = async (p : {
+  biometricsId: string,
+  secret: string,
+  publicKey: string
+  username: string,
+  tenantID: string
+}): Promise<sign_in_by_biometrics_data | null> => {
+  try {
+    console.log('api sign_in_by_biometrics p=', p);
+    // const publicKey = await storage.getItem(storage.csxMobileCachekeys.publicKey);
+    console.log('api sign_in_by_biometrics storage.csxMobileCachekeys.publicKey=', await storage.getItem(storage.csxMobileCachekeys.publicKey));
+    const publicKey = p.username && p.tenantID
+      ? await storage.getItem((storage.getUserStorageKey(storage.csxMobileCachekeys.publicKey, p.username, p.tenantID)))
+      : await storage.getItem(storage.csxMobileCachekeys.publicKey);
+    console.log('api sign_in_by_biometrics publicKey=', publicKey);
+    // const privateKey = await storage.getItem(storage.csxMobileCachekeys.privateKey);
+    console.log('api sign_in_by_biometrics storage.csxMobileCachekeys.privateKey=', await storage.getItem(storage.csxMobileCachekeys.privateKey));
+    const privateKey = p.username && p.tenantID
+      ? await storage.getItem(storage.getUserStorageKey(storage.csxMobileCachekeys.privateKey, p.username, p.tenantID))
+      : await storage.getItem(storage.csxMobileCachekeys.privateKey);
+    console.log('api sign_in_by_biometrics privateKey=', privateKey);
+    const BearerTKey = 'plainText';
+    console.log('sign_in_by_biometrics BearerTKey=', BearerTKey);
+    // let md5_signature = CryptoJS.MD5(BearerTKey).toString();
+    // console.log('sign_in_by_biometrics md5_signature=', md5_signature)
+    const signature = getSHA256withRSA(BearerTKey, privateKey);
+    const url = constant.API_BASE_URL + '/Account/sign-in-by-biometrics';
+    console.log('api sign_in_by_biometrics url=', url);
+    const data = encryptWithPublicKey(p.publicKey, `v1|${p.secret}`);
+    console.log('sign_in_by_biometrics data=', data);
+    const body = {type: p.type, signature, halg: 'SHA256', biometricsId: p.biometricsId, plainText: BearerTKey, data}; // 将JavaScript对象转换为字符串
+    console.log('api sign_in_by_biometrics body=', body);
+    let response = await fetch(url, {
+      method: 'POST', // 指定请求方法
+      headers: headers(),
+      body: JSON.stringify(body),
+    });
+    console.log('api sign_in_by_biometrics response=', response);
+    if (!response.ok) {
+      return null;
+    }
+    let json = await response.json();
+    console.log('api sign_in_by_biometrics json=', json);
+    if (json.code === 0 || json.code === 200) {
+      return json.data;
+    }
+    return null;
+  } catch (error) {
+    console.error('sign_in_by_biometrics error=', error);
+    return null;
+  }
+};

+export const list_allergic_drugs = async (p: {
+  pageIndex: number;
+  clinicId: string;
+  category?: string;
+  keyWord: string;
+  pageSize: number;
+}): Promise<Data | null> => {
+  try {
+    const url = constant.API_BASE_URL + '/csx/consultation/resource/list-allergic-drugs';
+    console.log('api list_allergic_drugs url=', url);
+    const body = {...p};
+    console.log('api list_allergic_drugs body=', body);
+    let response = await fetch(url, {
+      method: 'POST', // 指定请求方法
+      headers: headers(),
+      body: JSON.stringify(body),
+    });
+    console.log('api list_allergic_drugs response=', response);
+    if (!response.ok) {
+      return Promise.reject(null);
+    }
+    let json = await response.json();
+    console.log('api list_allergic_drugs json=', json);
+    if (json.code === 0 || json.code === 200) {
+      if (json.data.pagingInfo) {
+        if (json.data.items.length >= json.data.pagingInfo.pageSize) {
+          //有下页数据
+          const pageIndex = json.data.pagingInfo.pageIndex + 1;
+          return Promise.resolve({
+            items: json.data.items,
+            totalPage: pageIndex,
+            pageIndex: pageIndex,
+            needLoadMore: true,
+          });
+        } else {
+          const pageIndex = json.data.pagingInfo.pageIndex;
+          return Promise.resolve({
+            items: json.data.items,
+            totalPage: pageIndex,
+            pageIndex: json.data.pagingInfo.pageIndex,
+            needLoadMore: false,
+          });
+        }
+      } else {
+        return Promise.resolve(json.data);
+      }
+    }
+    return Promise.reject(null);
+  } catch (error) {
+    console.error('list_allergic_drugs error=', error);
+    return Promise.reject(null);
+  }
+};

+export const list_doctor_medical_terms = async (p): Promise<Data | null> => {
+  try {
+    const url = constant.API_BASE_URL + '/csx/consultation/resource/list-doctor-medical-terms';
+    console.log('api list_doctor_medical_terms url=', url);
+    const body = {...p};
+    console.log('api list_doctor_medical_terms body=', body);
+    let response = await fetch(url, {
+      method: 'POST', // 指定请求方法
+      headers: headers(),
+      body: JSON.stringify(body),
+    });
+    console.log('api list_doctor_medical_terms response=', response);
+    if (!response.ok) {
+      return null;
+    }
+    let json = await response.json();
+    console.log('api list_doctor_medical_terms json=', json);
+    if (json.code === 0 || json.code === 200) {
+      if (json.data.pagingInfo) {
+        if (json.data.items.length >= json.data.pagingInfo.pageSize) {
+          //有下页数据
+          const pageIndex = json.data.pagingInfo.pageIndex + 1;
+          return {
+            items: json.data.items,
+            totalPage: pageIndex + 1,
+            pageIndex,
+          };
+        } else {
+          const pageIndex = json.data.pagingInfo.pageIndex;
+          return {
+            items: json.data.items,
+            totalPage: pageIndex,
+            pageIndex: json.data.pagingInfo.pageIndex,
+          };
+        }
+      } else {
+        return json.data;
+      }
+    }
+    return null;
+  } catch (error) {
+    console.error('list_doctor_medical_terms error=', error);
+    return null;
+  }
+};

+export const list_hkctt_drug_vaccine_terms = async (p: {
+  pageIndex: number;
+  keyWord?: string;
+  pageSize?: number;
+}): Promise<Data | null> => {
+  try {
+    const url = constant.API_BASE_URL + '/csx/consultation/resource/list-hkctt-drug-vaccine-terms';
+    console.log('api list_hkctt_drug_vaccine_terms url=', url);
+    const body = {...p, pageSize: p.pageSize || 50};
+    console.log('api list_hkctt_drug_vaccine_terms body=', body);
+    let response = await fetch(url, {
+      method: 'POST', // 指定请求方法
+      headers: headers(),
+      body: JSON.stringify(body),
+    });
+    console.log('api list_hkctt_drug_vaccine_terms response=', response);
+    if (!response.ok) {
+      return Promise.reject(null);
+    }
+    let json = await response.json();
+    console.log('api list_hkctt_drug_vaccine_terms json=', json);
+    if (json.code === 0 || json.code === 200) {
+      if (json.data.pagingInfo) {
+        if (json.data.items.length >= json.data.pagingInfo.pageSize) {
+          //有下页数据
+          const pageIndex = json.data.pagingInfo.pageIndex + 1;
+          return Promise.resolve({
+            items: json.data.items as List_hkctt_drug_vaccine_terms_Item[],
+            totalPage: pageIndex + 1,
+            pageIndex,
+            needLoadMore: true,
+          });
+        } else {
+          const pageIndex = json.data.pagingInfo.pageIndex;
+          return Promise.resolve({
+            items: json.data.items as List_hkctt_drug_vaccine_terms_Item[],
+            totalPage: pageIndex,
+            pageIndex: json.data.pagingInfo.pageIndex,
+            needLoadMore: false,
+          });
+        }
+      } else {
+        return Promise.resolve(json.data);
+      }
+    }
+    return Promise.reject(null);
+  } catch (error) {
+    console.error('list_hkctt_drug_vaccine_terms error=', error);
+    return Promise.reject(null);
+  }
+};

+export const list_medical_terms = async (p: {
+  pageIndex: number;
+  Category: string;
+  keyWord?: string;
+  pageSize?: number;
+}): Promise<Data | null> => {

+    const url = constant.API_BASE_URL + '/csx/consultation/resource/list-medical-terms';
+    console.log('api list_medical_terms url=', url);
+    const body = {...p, pageSize: p.pageSize || 100};
+    console.log('api list_medical_terms body=', body);
+    let response = await fetch(url, {
+      method: 'POST', // 指定请求方法
+      headers: headers(),
+      body: JSON.stringify(body),
+    });
+    console.log('api list_medical_terms response=', response);
+    if (!response.ok) {
+      return Promise.reject(null);
+    }
+    let json = await response.json();
+    console.log('api list_medical_terms json=', json);
+    if (json.code === 0 || json.code === 200) {
+      if (json.data.pagingInfo) {
+        if (json.data.items.length >= json.data.pagingInfo.pageSize) {
+          //有下页数据
+          const pageIndex = json.data.pagingInfo.pageIndex + 1;
+          return Promise.resolve({
+            items: json.data.items as List_medical_terms_Item[],
+            totalPage: pageIndex + 1,
+            pageIndex,
+            needLoadMore: true,
+          });
+        } else {
+          const pageIndex = json.data.pagingInfo.pageIndex;
+          return Promise.resolve({
+            items: json.data.items as List_medical_terms_Item[],
+            totalPage: pageIndex,
+            pageIndex: json.data.pagingInfo.pageIndex,
+            needLoadMore: false,
+          });

+    const body = {...p, pageSize: p.pageSize || 20};
+    console.log('api get_drugbook_master_search_list body=', body);
+    let response = await fetch(url, {
+      method: 'POST', // 指定请求方法
+      headers: headers(),
+      body: JSON.stringify(body),
+    });
+    console.log('api get_drugbook_master_search_list response=', response);
+    if (!response.ok) {
+      return Promise.reject(response);
+    }
+    let json = await response.json();
+    console.log('api get_drugbook_master_search_list json=', json);
+    if (json.code === 0 || json.code === 200) {
+      if (json.data.pagingInfo) {
+        if (json.data.items.length >= json.data.pagingInfo.pageSize) {
+          //有下页数据
+          const pageIndex = json.data.pagingInfo.pageIndex + 1;
+          return Promise.resolve({
+            items: json.data.items as DrugbookMasterSearchListItem[],
+            totalPage: pageIndex + 1,
+            pageIndex,
+          });
+        } else {
+          const pageIndex = json.data.pagingInfo.pageIndex;
+          return Promise.resolve({
+            items: json.data.items as DrugbookMasterSearchListItem[],
+            totalPage: pageIndex,
+            pageIndex: json.data.pagingInfo.pageIndex,
+          });
+        }

+        return Promise.resolve(json.data);

+export const getGuideBanner = async () => {
+  try {
+    let response = await fetch(constant.API_BASE_BANNERS_URL, {
+      method: 'GET', // 指定请求方法
+      headers: {
+        'Cache-Control': 'no-cache', // 這裡的Header是防止某些瀏覽器可能會緩存請求

+      // body: JSON.stringify(body),
+    });

+      return null;

+    console.log('api get Guide Banner json=', json);
+    if (json) {
+      return !global.isTablet ? json.csmAdvertising || null : json.csmAdvertisingTablet || null;
+    }
+    return null;

+export const sign_out = async (curAccount, navigation, dispatch) => {
+  try {
+    await unregister_client();
+    const url = constant.API_BASE_URL + '/Account/sign-out';
+    console.log('api sign_out url=', url);
+    const body = {};
+    console.log('api sign_out body=', body);
+    let response = await fetch(url, {
+      method: 'POST', // 指定请求方法
+      headers: headers(),
+      body: JSON.stringify(body),
+    });
+    console.log('sign_out response=', response);
+    if (!response.ok) {
+      return null;
+    }
+    let json = await response.json();
+    console.log('api sign_out json=', json);
+    if (json.code === 0 || json.code === 200) {
+      routes.reset(navigation, routes.LoginPage.routeName, {
+        pageData: {
+          type: 0,
+          username: curAccount?.username,
+          skipBioMetric: true,
+        },
+      });
+      storage.clearCsxMobileStorage(dispatch, curAccount?.username, curAccount?.InstallationID, true);
+      return json.data;
+    }
+    return null;
+  } catch (error) {
+    console.error('api sign_out error=', error);
+    return null;
+  }
+};

+export const loginFromQRCodeAsync = async (qrCode: string): Promise<LoginFromQRCodeData | null> => {
+  try {
+    const url = constant.API_BASE_URL + '/Account/loginFromQRCodeAsync';
+    console.log('api loginFromQRCodeAsync url=', url);
+    const body = {qrCode};
+    console.log('api loginFromQRCodeAsync body=', body);
+    let response = await fetch(url, {
+      method: 'POST',
+      headers: headers(),
+      body: JSON.stringify(body),
+    });
+    console.log('api loginFromQRCodeAsync response=', response);
+    if (!response.ok) {
+      return Promise.reject(null);
+    }
+    // 获取从服务器响应中的Set-Cookie头部,debugger模式下,在response.headers中没有set-cookie,只能关了debug在终端查看
+    const setCookieHeader = response.headers.get('set-cookie');
+    console.log('api loginFromQRCodeAsync setCookieHeader=', setCookieHeader);
+    if (setCookieHeader) {
+      global.cookie = setCookieHeader; // 关闭chrome 调试 才有cookie
+    }
+    let json = await response.json();
+    console.log('api loginFromQRCodeAsync json=', json);
+    if (json.code === 0 || json.code === 200) {
+      global.curClinicData = null;
+      global.curDoctorData = null;
+      return Promise.resolve(json.data);
+    }
+    return Promise.reject(json.message);
+    ;
+  } catch (error) {
+    console.error('api loginFromQRCodeAsync error=', error);
+    return Promise.reject(null);
+    ;
+  }
+};

+export const trusted_devices_remove = async (p: {
+  trustedDeviceRequestId: string,
+  verificationCode: string,
+  username: string
+}): Promise<any | null> => {
+  try {
+    const privateKey = await storage.getItem(`${storage.csxMobileCachekeys.trusted_devices_privateKey}|${p.username}`);
+    console.log('api trusted_devices_remove privateKey=', privateKey);
+    const BearerTKey = 'plainText';
+    console.log('trusted_devices_remove BearerTKey=', BearerTKey);
+    //signature 使用RSA的私钥对 plainTextForSigning 进行签名
+    const signature = getSHA256withRSA(BearerTKey, privateKey)
+    const url = constant.API_BASE_URL + '/trusted-devices/v1/remove';
+    console.log('api trusted_devices_remove url=', url);
+    logUtils.addLog('info', 'api trusted_devices_remove url=', '', url);
+    const trusted_devices_confirm_api_cache = await storage.getItem(`${storage.csxMobileCachekeys.trusted_devices_confirm_api_cache}|${p.username}`, true);
+    console.log('api trusted_devices_remove trusted_devices_confirm_api_cache=', trusted_devices_confirm_api_cache);
+    logUtils.addLog('info', 'api trusted_devices_remove trusted_devices_confirm_api_cache=', '', url);
+    if (!trusted_devices_confirm_api_cache) {
+      return null
+    }
+    //data 使用RSA的公钥对 字符串 `v1|serverSecret|verificationCode` 进行加密,ServerSecret 是confirm接口返回的数据,VerificationCode 是csm会收到的push消息里的数据
+    const data = encryptWithPublicKeyPKCS1(trusted_devices_confirm_api_cache.publicKey, `v1|${trusted_devices_confirm_api_cache.serverSecret}|${p.verificationCode}`);
+    // Add padding parameter to match server-side expectation (default "Pkcs1")
+    const body = {...p, plainTextForSigning: BearerTKey, signature, data, padding: "Pkcs1"};
+    console.log('api trusted_devices_remove body=', body);
+    logUtils.addLog('info', 'api trusted_devices_remove body=', '', body);
+    const _headers = headers()
+    logUtils.addLog('info', 'api trusted_devices_remove _headers=', '', _headers);
+    let response = await fetch(url, {
+      method: 'POST',
+      headers: _headers,
+      body: JSON.stringify(body),
+    });
+    console.log('api trusted_devices_remove response=', response);
+    logUtils.addLog('info', 'api trusted_devices_remove response=', '', response);
+    if (!response.ok) {
+      return null;
+    }
+    let json = await response.json();
+    console.log('api trusted_devices_remove json=', json);
+    logUtils.addLog('info', 'api trusted_devices_remove json=', '', json);
+    if (json.code === 0 || json.code === 200) {
+      return json;
+    }
+    processJson(json, url);
+    return null;
+  } catch (error) {
+    console.error('api trusted_devices_remove error=', error);
+    logUtils.addLog('info', 'api trusted_devices_remove error=', '', error);
+    // processJson(json, url);
+    return null;
+  }
