+export const trusted_devices_fingerprint = async (p:
+                                                  {
+                                                    "trustedDeviceRequestId": string,
+                                                    "deviceFingerprint": string,
+                                                    deviceFingerprintPlaintext: string,
+                                                    username: string
+                                                  }): Promise<any | null> => {
+  try {
+    const privateKey = await storage.getItem(`${storage.csxMobileCachekeys.trusted_devices_privateKey}|${p.username}`);
+    console.log('api trusted_devices_fingerprint privateKey=', privateKey);
+    const BearerTKey = 'plainText';
+    console.log('trusted_devices_fingerprint BearerTKey=', BearerTKey);
+    //signature 使用RSA的私钥对 plainTextForSigning 进行签名
+    const signature = getSHA256withRSA(BearerTKey, privateKey)
+    const url = constant.API_BASE_URL + '/trusted-devices/v1/fingerprint';
+    console.log('api trusted_devices_fingerprint url=', url);
+    logUtils.addLog('info', `api trusted_devices_fingerprint url=`, '', url);
+    const trusted_devices_confirm_api_cache = await storage.getItem(`${storage.csxMobileCachekeys.trusted_devices_confirm_api_cache}|${p.username}`, true);
+    console.log('api trusted_devices_remove trusted_devices_confirm_api_cache=', trusted_devices_confirm_api_cache);
+    if (!trusted_devices_confirm_api_cache) {
+      return null
+    }
+    //data 使用 confirm接口返回 的publicKey对 字符串 `v1|serverSecret|deviceFingerprint` 进行  (RSA padding: "Pkcs1")加密,ServerSecret 是confirm接口返回的数据
+    const data = encryptWithPublicKeyPKCS1(trusted_devices_confirm_api_cache.publicKey, `v1|${trusted_devices_confirm_api_cache.serverSecret}|${p.deviceFingerprint}`);
+    // Add padding parameter to match server-side expectation (default "Pkcs1")
+    const body = {...p, plainTextForSigning: BearerTKey, signature, data, padding: "Pkcs1"};
+    console.log('api trusted_devices_fingerprint body=', body);
+    logUtils.addLog('info', `api trusted_devices_fingerprint body=`, '', body);
+    let response = await fetch(url, {
+      method: 'POST',
+      headers: headers(),
+      body: JSON.stringify(body),
+    });
+    console.log('api trusted_devices_fingerprint response=', response);
+    logUtils.addLog('info', `api trusted_devices_fingerprint response=`, '', response);
+    if (!response.ok) {
+      return null;
+    }
+    let json = await response.json();
+    console.log('api trusted_devices_fingerprint json=', json);
+    logUtils.addLog('info', `api trusted_devices_fingerprint json=`, '', json);
+    if (json.code === 0 || json.code === 200) {
+      return json.data;
+    }
+    processJson(json, url);
+    return null;
+  } catch (error) {
+    console.error('api trusted_devices_fingerprint error=', error);
+    return null;
+  }
+};

+export const QueryPhoneBindStatus = async () => {
+  try {
+    const url = constant.API_BASE_URL + `/Account/QueryPhoneBindStatus`;
+    console.log('api QueryPhoneBindStatus url=', url);
+    const params = {};
+    console.log('api QueryPhoneBindStatus params=', params);
+    // 将参数转换为URL的查询字符串
+    const queryString = Object.keys(params)
+      .map((key) => key + '=' + encodeURIComponent(params[key]))
+      .join('&');
+    // 完整的URL，包括查询字符串
+    const urlWithParams = url + (queryString ? `?${queryString}` : '');
+    console.log('api QueryPhoneBindStatus urlWithParams=', urlWithParams);
+    let response = await fetch(urlWithParams, {
+      method: 'GET', // 指定请求方法
+      headers: headers(),
+      // body: JSON.stringify(body),
+    });
+    console.log('api QueryPhoneBindStatus response=', response);
+    if (!response.ok) {
+      return null;
+    }
+    let json = await response.json();
+    console.log('api QueryPhoneBindStatus get_PDF json=', json);
+    if (json.code === 0 || json.code === 200) {
+      return json.data;
+    }
+    return null;
+  } catch (error) {
+    console.error('api QueryPhoneBindStatus  error=', error);
+    return null;
+  }
+};

+export const trusted_devices_check = async (p:
+                                            {
+                                              deviceFingerprintPlaintext: string,
+                                              "deviceFingerprint": string,
+                                              deviceId: string,
+                                            }): Promise<any | null> => {
+  try {
+    const url = constant.API_BASE_URL + '/trusted-devices/v1/check';
+    console.log('api trusted_devices_check url=', url);
+    logUtils.addLog('info', `api trusted_devices_check url=`, '', url);
+    const body = p;
+    console.log('api trusted_devices_check body=', body);
+    logUtils.addLog('info', `api trusted_devices_check body=`, '', body);
+    let response = await fetch(url, {
+      method: 'POST',
+      headers: headers(),
+      body: JSON.stringify(body),
+    });
+    console.log('api trusted_devices_check response=', response);
+    logUtils.addLog('info', `api trusted_devices_check response=`, '', response);
+    if (!response.ok) {
+      return Promise.resolve(false);
+    }
+    let json = await response.json();
+    console.log('api trusted_devices_check json=', json);
+    logUtils.addLog('info', `api trusted_devices_check json=`, '', json);
+    if (json.code === 0 || json.code === 200) {
+      return Promise.resolve(json.data);
+    } else if (json.code === 500 && !json.success && !json.data) {//当前账号未绑定任何可信设备
+      return Promise.resolve(true);
+    }
+    // processJson(json, url);
+    return Promise.resolve(false);
+  } catch (error) {
+    console.error('api trusted_devices_check error=', error);
+    return Promise.resolve(false);
+  }
+};

+import React, {ForwardedRef, forwardRef, ForwardRefExoticComponent, memo, MemoExoticComponent, useImperativeHandle, useMemo, useRef} from "react";
+import {Image, Text, View, TouchableOpacity, ViewStyle} from "react-native";
+import styles from "./AutoDropdownRow.style";
+import AutoDropdown from "components/AutoDropdown/AutoDropdown";
+import {chooseDoctorArrow} from "/icon/icon";
+import {AutoDropdownRowProps} from "components/AutoDropdownRow/AutoDropdownRowProps";
+import ArrowUpDown from "../../assets/svg/ArrowUpDown.tsx";
+
+/**
+ * 以废弃, 将被 AutoPositionedPopup 替代
+ */
+const AutoDropdownRow: MemoExoticComponent<ForwardRefExoticComponent<AutoDropdownRowProps>> = memo(
+  forwardRef<unknown, AutoDropdownRowProps>(
+    ({
+       style, labelStyle, updateState, tag, tagStyle, fetchData, renderItem, onItemSelected, onSubmitEditing, localSearch = true,
+       placeholder = global.i18n.t('Please_enter'), textAlign = 'right', pageSize, selectedItem,
+       useCustomRenderRow = false,
+       CustomRow = (props: ViewStyle) => <View style={props}></View>,
+       AutoDropdownBtnStyle,
+       btwChildren = undefined, CustomPopView = undefined, CustomPopViewStyle,
+       useTextInput = true, keyExtractor = (item: any) => item?.id,
+       forceRemoveAllRootViewOnItemSelected, inputStyle, centerDisplay,onChangeText
+     }: AutoDropdownRowProps, parentRef: ForwardedRef<unknown>): React.JSX.Element => {
+      const ref_AutoDropdown = useRef();
+      useImperativeHandle(parentRef, () => ({
+        clearSelectedItem: () => {
+          console.log('AutoDropdownRow  clearSelectedItem tag=', tag)
+          ref_AutoDropdown.current?.clearSelectedItem();
+        }
+      }), [])
+      return useMemo(() => {
+        console.log('AutoDropdownRow  tag=', tag)
+        console.log('AutoDropdownRow  selectedItem=', selectedItem)
+        console.log('AutoDropdownRow  useCustomRenderRow=', useCustomRenderRow)
+        return !useCustomRenderRow ?
+          <View
+            style={[styles.AutoDropdownRow, style,]}>
+            {tag !== global.i18n.t('Medication_notes') && tag !== global.i18n.t('Caution')  &&
+              <Text style={[styles.usageRowText, tagStyle]}>{tag}</Text>
+            }
+            <AutoDropdown ref={ref_AutoDropdown} tag={tag} keyExtractor={keyExtractor} labelStyle={labelStyle}
+                          AutoDropdownBtnStyle={( tag !== global.i18n.t('Medication_notes') && tag !== global.i18n.t('Caution') && tag !== global.i18n.t('Medical_procedures')  &&  tag !== global.i18n.t('diagnosis1')) ? styles.AutoDropdownBtnStyle : styles.AutoDropdownBtnStyle1}
+                          placeholder={placeholder} pageSize={pageSize}
+                          TextInputProps={{autoFocus: true, textAlign: textAlign, onSubmitEditing: onSubmitEditing}} fetchData={fetchData} renderItem={renderItem}
+                          onItemSelected={onItemSelected} localSearch={localSearch} selectedItem={selectedItem}
+                          forceRemoveAllRootViewOnItemSelected={forceRemoveAllRootViewOnItemSelected} inputStyle={inputStyle} onChangeText={onChangeText}></AutoDropdown>
+            {
+              <ArrowUpDown></ArrowUpDown>
+              // <Image source={chooseDoctorArrow} style={styles.selectArrow} />
+            }
+          </View> :
+          <CustomRow>
+            <AutoDropdown ref={ref_AutoDropdown} tag={tag} btwChildren={btwChildren} CustomPopView={CustomPopView} CustomPopViewStyle={CustomPopViewStyle} inputStyle={inputStyle}
+                          AutoDropdownBtnStyle={AutoDropdownBtnStyle} useTextInput={useTextInput}
+                          pageSize={pageSize} keyExtractor={keyExtractor}
+                          placeholder={placeholder}
+                          TextInputProps={{autoFocus: true, textAlign: textAlign, onSubmitEditing: onSubmitEditing}}
+                          fetchData={fetchData} renderItem={renderItem}
+                          onItemSelected={onItemSelected} localSearch={localSearch} selectedItem={selectedItem}
+                          forceRemoveAllRootViewOnItemSelected={forceRemoveAllRootViewOnItemSelected} centerDisplay={centerDisplay} onChangeText={onChangeText}></AutoDropdown>
+          </CustomRow>;
+      }, [updateState, tag, fetchData, renderItem, onItemSelected, onSubmitEditing, localSearch, placeholder, textAlign, pageSize, selectedItem, useCustomRenderRow, CustomRow, useTextInput, btwChildren, selectedItem, keyExtractor, AutoDropdownBtnStyle, CustomPopView, CustomPopViewStyle, forceRemoveAllRootViewOnItemSelected, inputStyle, centerDisplay]);
+    }
+  )
+);
+
+export default AutoDropdownRow

+// Lightweight emitter to decouple TextInput and list without re-rendering context
+type QueryListener = (query: string) => void;
+const queryChangeListeners: QueryListener[] = [];
+const emitQueryChange = (query: string) => {
+  console.log('AutoPositionedPopup.tsx emitQueryChange query=', query, ' listeners=', queryChangeListeners.length);
+  queryChangeListeners.forEach((l) => l(query));
+};
+const subscribeQueryChange = (listener: QueryListener) => {
+  queryChangeListeners.push(listener);
+  return () => {
+    const idx = queryChangeListeners.indexOf(listener);
+    if (idx !== -1) queryChangeListeners.splice(idx, 1);
+  };
+};

+// ListItem
+const ListItem: React.FC<{
+  updateState: (key: string, value: SelectedItem) => void;
+  item: SelectedItem;
+  index: number;
+  selectedItem?: SelectedItem;
+}> = memo(
+  ({
+    updateState,
+    item,
+    index,
+    selectedItem,
+  }: {
+    updateState: (key: string, value: SelectedItem) => void;
+    item: SelectedItem;
+    index: number;
+    selectedItem?: SelectedItem;
+  }): React.JSX.Element => {
+    const { mode, uiTheme, setMode } = useThemeProvider(); //mode='light' | 'dark'
+    const { addRootView, setRootViewNativeStyle, removeRootView, rootViews } = useRootView();
+    const rootViewsRef = useRef(rootViews);
+    useEffect(() => {
+      rootViewsRef.current = rootViews;
+    }, [rootViews]);
+    return useMemo(() => {
+      // console.log('AutoPositionedPopup.tsx ListItem index=', index);
+      // console.log('AutoPositionedPopup.tsx ListItem item=', item);
+      const isSelected = item.id === selectedItem?.id; //|| item.title === selectedItem?.title;
+      // console.log('AutoPositionedPopup.tsx ListItem isSelected=', isSelected);
+      return (
+        <ThemeContext.Consumer>
+          {(theme: Theme) => {
+            return (
+              <TouchableOpacity
+                key={item.id}
+                style={[
+                  styles.commonModalRow,
+                  { backgroundColor: isSelected ? 'rgba(116, 116, 128, 0.08)' : 'transparent' },
+                ]}
+                onPress={() => {
+                  console.log('AutoPositionedPopup.tsx ListItem onPress item=', item);
+                  console.log('AutoPositionedPopup.tsx ListItem onPress rootViews=', rootViewsRef.current);
+                  updateState('selectedItem', item);
+                }}
+              >
+                <Text style={styles.ListItemCode} numberOfLines={1} ellipsizeMode="tail">
+                  {item.title}
+                </Text>
+              </TouchableOpacity>

+          }}
+        </ThemeContext.Consumer>
+      );
+    }, [updateState, item, index, selectedItem, rootViewsRef]);

+ *     }
+ *     return Promise.resolve(null);
+ *   }}
+ *   //#endregion
+ *   //#region onItemSelected Handler
+ *   onItemSelected={(item: AutoPositionedPopupSelectedItem) => {
+ *     console.log('onItemSelected=', item);
+ *     setState((prevState) => {
+ *       return { ...prevState, chooseClinicItem: item };

+ *   }}

+                console.log('onSubmitEditing=', e.nativeEvent.text);

+ * //#region ScrollView Component

+ *     removeRootView('', true);

+const AutoPositionedPopup: MemoExoticComponent<ForwardRefExoticComponent<AutoPositionedPopupProps>> = memo(

+              // Get the full screen height (including the status bar and navigation bar)

+              console.log('AutoPositionedPopup screenHeight=', screenHeight);
+              if (y + height < screenHeight / 2 - listLayout.height / 2) {

+                console.log('AutoPositionedPopup y + height >= screenHeight / 2');

+                  typeof CustomPopViewStyle.height === 'number' ? CustomPopViewStyle.height : listLayout.height;

+                if (y + height < screenHeight / 2 - customHeight / 2) {

+                    ref_listPos.current = { x: x, y: y - customHeight, width: width };

+                    console.log('AutoPositionedPopup onModalClose tag=', tag);

+                    setState((prevState) => {
+                      return {
+                        ...prevState,

+       * Methods of child components that can be directly called by the parent component

+        inputStyle,
+        TextInputProps,
+        state.isFocus,
+      ]);
+    }
+  )
+);
+
+export default AutoPositionedPopup;

+import React, {useCallback, useRef} from 'react';
+import FingerprintPopup from '../FingerprintPopup/FingerprintPopup.component.android';
+import FingerprintPopupIOS from '../FingerprintPopup/FingerprintPopup.component.ios';
+import {useCommonAlertModal} from '../CommonAlertModal/CommonAlertModalContext';
+import {useAccount} from 'useHooks/useAccount';
+import {useGlobalEventListener} from 'tools/useGlobalEventEmitter';
+import {globalEventName} from 'tools/useGlobalEventEmitter';
+import {useSelector, useDispatch} from 'react-redux';
+
+/**
+ * BiometricAuthPopup Component
+ * Handles biometric authentication popup display and logic
+ * Used globally for biometric authentication requests
+ */
+const BiometricAuthPopup: React.FC = () => {
+  const [state, setState] = React.useState({
+    biometryType: '' as string,
+    showFingerprintPopup: false as boolean,
+    onSuccess: null as (() => void) | null,
+    onFailure: null as (() => void) | null,
+  });
+  const ref_onSuccess = useRef(state.onSuccess);
+  const ref_onFailure = useRef(state.onFailure);
+
+  const {
+    setShowCommonAlertModal,
+    setCommonAlertModalTitle,
+    setCommonAlertModalContent,
+    setCommonAlertModalCancelTxt,
+    setCommonAlertModalConfirmTxt,
+  } = useCommonAlertModal();
+
+  const curAccount = useAccount();
+  const dispatch = useDispatch();
+
+  // Listen for biometric authentication requests
+  useGlobalEventListener(globalEventName.showBiometricAuthPopup, useCallback((data: { biometryType: string, onSuccess: () => void ,onFailure:()=>void}) => {
+    console.log('BiometricAuthPopup received showBiometricAuthPopup event=', data);
+    setState((prevState) => ({
+      ...prevState,
+      biometryType: data.biometryType,
+      showFingerprintPopup: true,
+      onSuccess: data.onSuccess,
+      onFailure: data.onFailure,
+    }));
+    ref_onSuccess.current = data.onSuccess;
+    ref_onFailure.current = data.onFailure;
+  }, []));
+
+  const agree_check = useCallback(async (callback: () => void) => {
+    // Simplified version of agree_check logic
+    // In a real implementation, you would check agreement status
+    callback();
+  }, []);
+
+  const handlePopupDismissed = useCallback(async (success: boolean) => {
+    console.log('BiometricAuthPopup handlePopupDismissed success=', success, ' state.onSuccess=', state.onSuccess,' ref_onSuccess.current=', ref_onSuccess.current);
+    if (success) {
+      ref_onSuccess.current && ref_onSuccess.current();
+    }else {
+      ref_onFailure.current && ref_onFailure.current();
+    }
+    // Reset popup state to allow future displays
+    setState((prevState) => ({
+      ...prevState,
+      showFingerprintPopup: false,
+      onSuccess: null,
+      onFailure: null,
+    }));
+    ref_onSuccess.current = null;
+    ref_onFailure.current = null;
+  }, [state.biometryType, curAccount, dispatch, setCommonAlertModalTitle, setCommonAlertModalContent, setCommonAlertModalCancelTxt, setShowCommonAlertModal, agree_check]);
+
+  return (
+    <>
+      {state.showFingerprintPopup && global.android && (
+        <FingerprintPopup
+          description={global.i18n.t((state.biometryType === 'Touch ID' || state.biometryType === 'Biometrics') ? 'Please_verify_the_fingerprint' : 'Please_verify_the_faceID')}
+          handlePopupDismissed={handlePopupDismissed}
+        />
+      )}
+      {state.showFingerprintPopup && global.ios && (
+        <FingerprintPopupIOS
+          description={global.i18n.t((state.biometryType === 'Touch ID') ? 'Please_verify_the_fingerprint' : 'Please_verify_the_faceID')}
+          handlePopupDismissed={handlePopupDismissed}
+        />
+      )}
+    </>
+  );
+};
+
+export default BiometricAuthPopup;

+export enum ButtonDirection {

+const Context = createContext<CommonAlertModalContextType | undefined>(undefined);
+/**

+  const [commonAlertModalConfirmTxt, setCommonAlertModalConfirmTxt] = useState<string>('');

+  >()
+  const [buttonDirection, setButtonDirection] = useState<string>(ButtonDirection.HORIZONTAL);

+  const refOnConfirm = useRef(() => {
+  });
+  const refOnReject = useRef(() => {
+  });
+  useEffect(() => {

+/**
+ * 在需要显示或隐藏 CommonAlertModal 的地方使用 useCommonAlertModal 钩子;
+ * import {useCommonAlertModal} from 'components/CommonAlertModal/CommonAlertModalContext'
+ *
+ * const { showCommonAlertModal,setShowCommonAlertModal,commonAlertModalTitle,setCommonAlertModalTitle ,commonAlertModalContent,
+ * setCommonAlertModalContent,setCommonAlertModalCancelTxt,setCommonAlertModalConfirmTxt,commonAlertModalConfirmTxt
+ * ,refOnConfirm,refOnReject ,commonAlertModalConfirmTxtStyle,setCommonAlertModalConfirmTxtStyle,setButtonDirection } = useCommonAlertModal();
+ *
+ setCommonAlertModalTitle(global.i18n.t('delete_record'));
+ setCommonAlertModalContent('');
+ setCommonAlertModalConfirmTxt(global.i18n.t('Delete Record'));
+ setCommonAlertModalCancelTxt(global.i18n.t('cancel'));
+ setCommonAlertModalConfirmTxtStyle({color: uiTheme.colors.$redColor})
+ setButtonDirection(ButtonDirection.VERTICAL);
+ refOnConfirm.current = () => {
+ }
+ refOnReject.current = () => {
+ }
+ setShowCommonAlertModal(true);
+ */
+export const useCommonAlertModal = (): CommonAlertModalContextType => {
+  /**
+   * 使用 useContext 鉤子來獲取 Context 的值 ,其類型是 CommonAlertModalContextType,也就是 { showCommonAlertModal,setShowCommonAlertModal  }
+   */
+  const context = useContext(Context);
+  if (context === undefined) {
+    throw new Error('useCommonAlertModal must be used within a CommonAlertModalProvider');
+  }

+import React, {useCallback, useMemo} from 'react';
+import {Switch, ViewStyle} from 'react-native';
+import {ThemeContext} from '../theme/theme-context';
+import styles from './styles';
+
+/**
+ * import { CustomSwitch } from 'components';
+ * <CustomSwitch
+                  value={state.isEnabledNKDA}
+                  onValueChange={(value: boolean) => {
+                    setState(prevState => {
+                      return {
+                        ...prevState,
+                        isEnabledNKDA: value,
+                      };
+                    });
+                  }}
+                  trackColor={{
+                    false: '#E5E5EA', // 关闭状态：灰色
+                    true: '#34C759', // 开启状态：绿色
+                  }}
+                  thumbColor="#FFFFFF"
+                  ios_backgroundColor="#E5E5EA"
+                />
+ */
+export interface CustomSwitchProps {
+  // Switch state
+  value: boolean;
+  onValueChange: (value: boolean) => void;
+
+  // Customizable styles
+  trackColor?: {
+    false?: string;
+    true?: string;
+  };
+  thumbColor?: string;
+  ios_backgroundColor?: string;
+
+  // Additional props
+  disabled?: boolean;
+  style?: ViewStyle;
+}
+
+export const CustomSwitch: React.FC<CustomSwitchProps> = ({
+  value,
+  onValueChange,
+  trackColor,
+  thumbColor,
+  ios_backgroundColor,
+  disabled = false,
+  style,
+}) => {
+  // Handle switch toggle
+  const handleToggle = useCallback(
+    (newValue: boolean) => {
+      if (!disabled) {
+        onValueChange(newValue);
+      }
+    },
+    [disabled, onValueChange]
+  );
+
+  // Memoized component
+  const switchComponent = useMemo(
+    () => (
+      <ThemeContext.Consumer>
+        {theme => {
+          // Default colors based on Figma design
+          const defaultTrackColor = {
+            false: '#E5E5EA', // Gray color for OFF state
+            true: '#34C759', // Green color for ON state (iOS system green)
+          };
+
+          const defaultThumbColor = thumbColor || '#FFFFFF'; // White thumb
+          const defaultIosBackgroundColor = ios_backgroundColor || '#E5E5EA'; // Gray background for iOS
+
+          return (
+            <Switch
+              style={[styles.switch, style]}
+              value={value}
+              onValueChange={handleToggle}
+              trackColor={trackColor || defaultTrackColor}
+              thumbColor={defaultThumbColor}
+              ios_backgroundColor={defaultIosBackgroundColor}
+              disabled={disabled}
+            />
+          );
+        }}
+      </ThemeContext.Consumer>
+    ),
+    [value, handleToggle, trackColor, thumbColor, ios_backgroundColor, disabled, style]
+  );
+
+  return switchComponent;
+};

+# CustomSwitch Component
+
+A highly customizable switch component based on React Native's Switch component, with TypeScript support, useMemo performance optimization, and theme system integration.
+
+## Features
+
+- ✅ Based on React Native's native Switch component
+- ✅ TypeScript support
+- ✅ ThemeContext integration
+- ✅ Fully customizable color styles
+- ✅ useMemo performance optimization
+- ✅ Disabled state support
+- ✅ EStyleSheet styling system
+- ✅ Figma design implementation
+
+## Installation & Usage
+
+```tsx
+import {CustomSwitch} from 'components';
+```
+
+## Basic Usage
+
+```tsx
+import React, {useState} from 'react';
+import {CustomSwitch} from 'components';
+
+const MyComponent = () => {
+  const [isEnabled, setIsEnabled] = useState(false);
+
+  return <CustomSwitch value={isEnabled} onValueChange={setIsEnabled} />;
+};
+```
+
+## Figma Design Implementation
+
+Based on the provided Figma design, the switch has the following default colors:
+
+### OFF State (Closed)
+
+- **Track Color**: `#E5E5EA` (Light gray)
+- **Thumb Color**: `#FFFFFF` (White)
+- **iOS Background**: `#E5E5EA` (Light gray)
+
+### ON State (Open)
+
+- **Track Color**: `#34C759` (iOS system green)
+- **Thumb Color**: `#FFFFFF` (White)
+
+### Usage with Figma Colors
+
+```tsx
+// Default implementation (matches Figma design)
+<CustomSwitch value={isEnabled} onValueChange={setIsEnabled} />
+
+// Explicit Figma colors
+<CustomSwitch
+  value={isEnabled}
+  onValueChange={setIsEnabled}
+  trackColor={{
+    false: '#E5E5EA', // Gray for OFF state
+    true: '#34C759',  // Green for ON state
+  }}
+  thumbColor="#FFFFFF"
+  ios_backgroundColor="#E5E5EA"
+/>
+```
+
+## Custom Colors
+
+```tsx
+<CustomSwitch
+  value={isEnabled}
+  onValueChange={setIsEnabled}
+  trackColor={{
+    false: '#E8E8E8',
+    true: '#FF3B30', // Custom red color
+  }}
+  thumbColor="#FFFFFF"
+  ios_backgroundColor="#E8E8E8"
+/>
+```
+
+## Props
+
+| Property              | Type                              | Default Value       | Description                      |
+| --------------------- | --------------------------------- | ------------------- | -------------------------------- |
+| `value`               | `boolean`                         | -                   | Switch state (required)          |
+| `onValueChange`       | `(value: boolean) => void`        | -                   | State change callback (required) |
+| `trackColor`          | `{false?: string; true?: string}` | Figma design colors | Track colors (OFF/ON states)     |
+| `thumbColor`          | `string`                          | `#FFFFFF`           | Thumb color                      |
+| `ios_backgroundColor` | `string`                          | `#E5E5EA`           | iOS background color             |
+| `disabled`            | `boolean`                         | `false`             | Whether disabled                 |
+| `style`               | `ViewStyle`                       | -                   | Additional styles                |
+
+## Default Color Values
+
+The component uses the following default colors to match the Figma design:
+
+```tsx
+const defaultTrackColor = {
+  false: '#E5E5EA', // Gray color for OFF state
+  true: '#34C759', // Green color for ON state (iOS system green)
+};
+
+const defaultThumbColor = '#FFFFFF'; // White thumb
+const defaultIosBackgroundColor = '#E5E5EA'; // Gray background for iOS
+```
+
+## Theme Integration
+
+The component is wrapped with `ThemeContext.Consumer` to access theme data, but uses Figma design colors by default for consistency.
+
+## Examples
+
+Check the `example.tsx` file for more usage examples including:
+
+- Default Figma design implementation
+- Explicit color configuration
+- Custom color variations
+- Disabled state
+
+## Performance Optimization
+
+- Uses `useMemo` to cache component rendering
+- Uses `useCallback` to optimize event handling
+- Based on React Native's native Switch component for optimal performance
+
+## Styling
+
+The component uses EStyleSheet with the following default styles:
+
+```tsx
+switch: {
+  width: '51rem',
+  height: '31rem',
+}
+```
+
+You can override these styles by passing a `style` prop.

+import React, { Component, ReactNode, ComponentType } from 'react';
+import { View, Text, TouchableOpacity, StyleSheet, Alert, Platform } from 'react-native';
+import * as Sentry from '@sentry/react-native';
+import { captureApiError } from '../../utils/sentry';
+
+// Maximum number of auto-recovery attempts within the cooldown window
+const MAX_AUTO_RETRY = 3;
+// Cooldown window in milliseconds - reset retry count after this period
+const RETRY_COOLDOWN_MS = 10000;
+
+interface Props {
+  children: ReactNode;
+  fallbackComponent?: ComponentType<ErrorBoundaryFallbackProps>;
+  onError?: (error: Error, errorInfo: React.ErrorInfo) => void;
+}
+
+interface State {
+  hasError: boolean;
+  error?: Error;
+}
+
+interface ErrorBoundaryFallbackProps {
+  error: Error;
+  onRetry: () => void;
+  onRestart: () => void;
+}
+
+/**
+ * Fallback component only shown in DEV mode for debugging.
+ * In production, the error boundary auto-recovers silently.
+ */
+const DevErrorFallback: React.FC<ErrorBoundaryFallbackProps> = ({
+  error,
+  onRetry,
+  onRestart,
+}) => (
+  <View style={styles.container}>
+    <View style={styles.content}>
+      <Text style={styles.title}>DEV Error Caught</Text>
+      <Text style={styles.message}>
+        This error was caught by the ErrorBoundary. In production, the app would silently recover.
+      </Text>
+
+      <View style={styles.debugContainer}>
+        <Text style={styles.debugTitle}>Debug Info:</Text>
+        <Text style={styles.debugText}>{error?.message}</Text>
+        <Text style={styles.debugText}>{error?.stack?.substring(0, 500)}...</Text>
+      </View>
+
+      <View style={styles.buttonContainer}>
+        <TouchableOpacity
+          style={[styles.button, styles.retryButton]}
+          onPress={onRetry}
+        >
+          <Text style={styles.buttonText}>Retry</Text>
+        </TouchableOpacity>
+
+        <TouchableOpacity
+          style={[styles.button, styles.restartButton]}
+          onPress={onRestart}
+        >
+          <Text style={styles.buttonText}>Restart App</Text>
+        </TouchableOpacity>
+      </View>
+    </View>
+  </View>
+);
+
+/**
+ * Enhanced Error Boundary with silent auto-recovery.
+ *
+ * Strategy:
+ * - When a render error is caught, report it to Sentry silently.
+ * - Auto-recover (re-render children) up to MAX_AUTO_RETRY times within RETRY_COOLDOWN_MS.
+ * - If the same error keeps recurring beyond the retry limit, the app stays on the
+ *   last successful render (children) rather than showing a blocking error screen.
+ * - In __DEV__ mode, show a debug fallback so developers can see the error.
+ */
+class SentryErrorBoundary extends Component<Props, State> {
+  // Track auto-recovery attempts to prevent infinite render loops
+  private retryCount: number = 0;
+  // Timestamp of the first error in the current retry window
+  private firstErrorTime: number = 0;
+
+  constructor(props: Props) {
+    super(props);
+    this.state = { hasError: false };
+  }
+
+  static getDerivedStateFromError(error: Error): State {
+    // Mark error state so componentDidCatch can handle recovery
+    return { hasError: true, error };
+  }
+
+  componentDidCatch(error: Error, errorInfo: React.ErrorInfo) {
+    console.warn('SentryErrorBoundary caught an error (silent recovery):', error?.message);
+
+    // Report to Sentry if enabled
+    if (global.$sentryLog) {
+      try {
+        Sentry.withScope((scope) => {
+          scope.setLevel('error');
+          scope.setTag('error_boundary', 'silent_recovery');
+          scope.setTag('retry_count', String(this.retryCount));
+          scope.setContext('error_info', {
+            componentStack: errorInfo?.componentStack,
+            errorBoundary: 'SentryErrorBoundary',
+            retryCount: this.retryCount,
+          });
+
+          Sentry.addBreadcrumb({
+            message: 'Silent error boundary triggered',
+            category: 'error',
+            level: 'error',
+            data: {
+              errorMessage: error?.message,
+              retryCount: this.retryCount,
+            },
+          });
+
+          Sentry.captureException(error);
+        });
+      } catch (sentryError) {
+        // Sentry itself should never crash the error boundary
+        console.warn('SentryErrorBoundary: Failed to report to Sentry:', sentryError);
+      }
+    }
+
+    // Call custom error handler if provided
+    if (this.props.onError) {
+      try {
+        this.props.onError(error, errorInfo);
+      } catch (handlerError) {
+        console.warn('SentryErrorBoundary: Custom onError handler threw:', handlerError);
+      }
+    }
+
+    // Auto-recovery logic: reset error state so children re-render
+    const now = Date.now();
+
+    // Reset retry counter if cooldown window has passed
+    if (now - this.firstErrorTime > RETRY_COOLDOWN_MS) {
+      this.retryCount = 0;
+      this.firstErrorTime = now;
+    }
+
+    if (this.retryCount < MAX_AUTO_RETRY) {
+      this.retryCount++;
+      console.warn(
+        `SentryErrorBoundary: Auto-recovering (attempt ${this.retryCount}/${MAX_AUTO_RETRY})`
+      );
+      // Schedule recovery on next tick to avoid synchronous re-render loop
+      setTimeout(() => {
+        this.setState({ hasError: false, error: undefined });
+      }, 0);
+    } else {
+      // Exceeded retry limit within cooldown window.
+      // In production: still recover silently after a short delay to let the
+      // error-causing condition potentially resolve (e.g. async data loading).
+      console.warn(
+        'SentryErrorBoundary: Max retries reached. Will attempt recovery after delay.'
+      );
+      setTimeout(() => {
+        // Reset the retry counter and try again
+        this.retryCount = 0;
+        this.firstErrorTime = Date.now();
+        this.setState({ hasError: false, error: undefined });
+      }, 2000);
+    }
+  }
+
+  handleRetry = () => {
+    this.retryCount = 0;
+    this.firstErrorTime = 0;
+    this.setState({ hasError: false, error: undefined });
+  };
+
+  handleRestart = () => {
+    if (global.navigationRef) {
+      try {
+        this.retryCount = 0;
+        this.firstErrorTime = 0;
+        this.setState({ hasError: false, error: undefined });
+        global.navigationRef.reset('WelcomePage', {});
+      } catch (e) {
+        console.warn('Failed to reset navigation:', e);
+      }
+    }
+  };
+
+  render() {
+    if (this.state.hasError && this.state.error) {
+      // In DEV mode, show debug fallback so developers can see errors
+      if (__DEV__) {
+        const FallbackComponent = this.props.fallbackComponent || DevErrorFallback;
+        return (
+          <FallbackComponent
+            error={this.state.error}
+            onRetry={this.handleRetry}
+            onRestart={this.handleRestart}
+          />
+        );
+      }
+
+      // In production: render children as-is while auto-recovery is scheduled.
+      // The componentDidCatch above has already scheduled a setState to clear
+      // the error. In the brief moment before that fires, render children
+      // to avoid showing any error UI to the user.
+      return this.props.children;
+    }
+
+    return this.props.children;
+  }
+}
+
+const styles = StyleSheet.create({
+  container: {
+    flex: 1,
+    backgroundColor: '#f5f5f5',
+    justifyContent: 'center',
+    alignItems: 'center',
+    padding: 20,
+  },
+  content: {
+    backgroundColor: 'white',
+    borderRadius: 12,
+    padding: 24,
+    width: '100%',
+    maxWidth: 400,
+    shadowColor: '#000',
+    shadowOffset: {
+      width: 0,
+      height: 2,
+    },
+    shadowOpacity: 0.25,
+    shadowRadius: 3.84,
+    elevation: 5,
+  },
+  title: {
+    fontSize: 20,
+    fontWeight: 'bold',
+    color: '#d32f2f',
+    textAlign: 'center',
+    marginBottom: 16,
+  },
+  message: {
+    fontSize: 16,
+    color: '#666',
+    textAlign: 'center',
+    lineHeight: 24,
+    marginBottom: 24,
+  },
+  debugContainer: {
+    backgroundColor: '#f5f5f5',
+    padding: 12,
+    borderRadius: 8,
+    marginBottom: 24,
+  },
+  debugTitle: {
+    fontSize: 14,
+    fontWeight: 'bold',
+    color: '#333',
+    marginBottom: 8,
+  },
+  debugText: {
+    fontSize: 12,
+    color: '#666',
+    fontFamily: Platform.OS === 'ios' ? 'Menlo' : 'monospace',
+    lineHeight: 16,
+  },
+  buttonContainer: {
+    flexDirection: 'row',
+    justifyContent: 'space-between',
+    gap: 12,
+  },
+  button: {
+    flex: 1,
+    paddingVertical: 12,
+    paddingHorizontal: 16,
+    borderRadius: 8,
+    alignItems: 'center',
+  },
+  retryButton: {
+    backgroundColor: '#1976d2',
+  },
+  restartButton: {
+    backgroundColor: '#666',
+  },
+  buttonText: {
+    color: 'white',
+    fontSize: 16,
+    fontWeight: '600',
+  },
+});
+
+export default SentryErrorBoundary;
+export { ErrorBoundaryFallbackProps };

+    if (state.showOpen) {
+      // Expanding - show all items
+      setState(prevState => {
+        return {
+          ...prevState,
+          showOpen: false,
+          showClose: true,
+          list: list, // Show all items
+          status: 1, // Expanded state
+        };
+      });
+    } else if (state.showClose) {
+      // Collapsing - show only first item
+      setState(prevState => {
+        return {
+          ...prevState,
+          showOpen: true,
+          showClose: false,
+          list: [list[0]], // Show only first item
+          status: 0, // Collapsed state
+        };
+      });
+    }
+  };
 
+  // Determine numberOfLines for each item
+  const getNumberOfLines = (index: number) => {
+    if (index === 0 && state.isFirstItemMultiLine && state.status === 0) {

+      return 1;

diff --git a/src/components/RootViewProvider/RootViewContext.tsx b/src/components/RootViewProvider/RootViewContext.tsx
new file mode 100644

+import React, {ReactNode, createContext, useContext, useEffect, useMemo, useRef, useState} from 'react';
+import {Pressable, View, ViewStyle} from 'react-native';
+
+interface DynamicViewBase {
+  id: string;
+  style: ViewStyle;
+  component: ReactNode;
+  useModal?: boolean;
+  onModalClose?: () => void;
+  centerDisplay?: boolean;
+}
+
+interface RootViewContextType {
+  addRootView: (view: DynamicViewBase) => void;
+  setRootViewNativeStyle: (id: string, style: ViewStyle) => void;
+  updateRootView: (id: string, update: Partial<DynamicViewBase>) => void;
+  removeRootView: (id?: string, force?: boolean, _rootViews?: DynamicViewBase[]) => void;
+  rootViews: DynamicViewBase[];
+  searchQuery: string;
+  setSearchQuery: (searchQuery: string) => void;
+}
+
+interface RootViewProviderProps {
+  children: ReactNode;
+}
+
+const RootViewContext = createContext<RootViewContextType | undefined>(undefined);
+/**
+ * Dynamically add or remove views on the root view.
+ * @param children
+ * @constructor
+ */
+export const RootViewProvider: React.FC<RootViewProviderProps> = ({children}) => {
+  const [rootViews, setRootViews] = useState<DynamicViewBase[]>([]);
+  const [searchQuery, setSearchQuery] = useState<string>('');
+  const viewRefs = useRef<Record<string, View>>({});
+  //監聽 rootViews
+  useEffect(() => {
+    console.log('RootViewProvider rootViews changed:', rootViews);
+  }, [rootViews]);
+  const addRootView = (view: DynamicViewBase): void => {
+    // const id = `dynamic-view-${Date.now()}-${Math.random().toString(36).substr(2, 9)}`;
+    const newView: DynamicViewBase = {...view};
+    console.log('RootViewProvider addRootView rootViews=', rootViews);
+    console.log('RootViewProvider addRootView newView=', newView);
+    setRootViews((prev) => [...prev, newView]);
+  };
+
+  const updateRootView = (id: string, update: Partial<DynamicViewBase>): void => {
+    setRootViews((prev) => prev.map((view) => (view.id === id ? {...view, ...update} : view)));
+  };
+
+  const removeRootView = (id?: string, force?: boolean, _rootViews?: DynamicViewBase[]): void => {
+    console.log('RootViewProvider removeRootView id=', id);
+    console.log('RootViewProvider removeRootView force=', force);
+    console.log('RootViewProvider removeRootView rootViews=', rootViews);
+    console.log('RootViewProvider removeRootView _rootViews=', _rootViews);
+
+    // Ensure keyboard is dismissed when force removing all root views
+    if (force) {
+      // Dismiss keyboard first
+      if (global.dismissKeyboard) {
+        global.dismissKeyboard();
+      }
+
+      // Small delay to ensure keyboard is dismissed before removing views
+      setTimeout(() => {
+        setRootViews((prev) => []);
+        console.log('RootViewProvider removeRootView setRootViews(prev => []) force=true');
+      }, 50);
+      return;
+    }
+    if (rootViews.length > 0 && id) {
+      setRootViews((prev) => prev.filter((view) => view.id !== id));
+      // else {
+      //   console.log('RootViewProvider removeRootView setRootViews(prev => [])')
+      //   setRootViews(prev => [])
+      // }
+    } else if (_rootViews && _rootViews.length > 0 && id) {
+      setRootViews((prev) => prev.filter((view) => view.id !== id));
+    }
+  };
+
+  const setRootViewNativeStyle = (id: string, style: ViewStyle): void => {
+    const target = viewRefs.current[id];
+    if (target) {
+      // @ts-ignore - React Native setNativeProps
+      target.setNativeProps({style});
+    }
+  };
+
+  const contextValue = useMemo(
+    () => ({
+      addRootView,
+      setRootViewNativeStyle,
+      updateRootView,
+      removeRootView,
+      rootViews,
+      searchQuery,
+      setSearchQuery,
+    }),
+    [addRootView, setRootViewNativeStyle, updateRootView, removeRootView, rootViews, searchQuery, setSearchQuery]
+  );
+
+  return (
+    <RootViewContext.Provider value={contextValue}>
+      <>
+        {children}
+        {rootViews.map(
+          ({id, style, component, useModal, onModalClose, centerDisplay}: DynamicViewBase): React.JSX.Element => {
+            console.log('RootViewProvider rootViews.map id=', id);
+            console.log('RootViewProvider rootViews.map style=', style);
+            console.log('RootViewProvider rootViews.map component=', component);
+            console.log('RootViewProvider rootViews.map useModal=', useModal);
+            console.log('RootViewProvider rootViews.map centerDisplay=', centerDisplay);
+            return !useModal ? (
+              <View
+                key={id}
+                ref={(r) => {
+                  if (r) viewRefs.current[id] = r;
+                }}
+                style={[style, {position: 'absolute'}]}
+              >
+                {component}
+              </View>
+            ) : (
+              <Pressable
+                key={id}
+                style={[
+                  {
+                    flex: 1,
+                    position: 'absolute',
+                    width: '100%',
+                    left: 0,
+                    right: 0,
+                    top: 0,
+                    bottom: 0,
+                    zIndex: 99999999999,
+                    backgroundColor: 'rgba(0,0,0,0.5)',
+                  },
+                  centerDisplay && {justifyContent: 'center', alignItems: 'center'},
+                ]}
+                onPress={() => {
+                  console.log('RootViewProvider Pressable onPress rootViews=', rootViews);
+                  removeRootView(id, true);
+                  onModalClose && onModalClose();
+                }}
+              >
+                <View
+                  ref={(r) => {
+                    if (r) viewRefs.current[id] = r;
+                  }}
+                  style={[{position: 'absolute'}, style]}
+                >
+                  {component}
+                </View>
+              </Pressable>
+            );
+            // (<Modal
+            //   animationType="none"
+            //   transparent={false}
+            //   visible={true}
+            //   presentationStyle="overFullScreen" // iOS特定属性
+            //   onRequestClose={() => {
+            //     // Android 返回鍵按下時的回調
+            //     onModalClose && onModalClose()
+            //   }}
+            //   key={id}
+            // >
+            // </Modal>)
+          }
+        )}
+      </>
+    </RootViewContext.Provider>
+  );
+};
+/*
+  import {useRootView} from "components/RootViewProvider/RootViewContext";
+  const { addRootView, updateRootView, removeRootView ,searchQuery } = useRootView();
+ */
+export const useRootView = (): RootViewContextType => {
+  const context = useContext(RootViewContext);
+  if (!context) {
+    throw new Error('useRootView must be used within a RootViewProvider');
+  }
+  return context;
+};

+# Audio Setup Guide for VideoCallInviteModal
+
+This guide explains how to configure audio playback functionality for the VideoCallInviteModal component on both Android and iOS platforms using `react-native-sound`.
+
+## Prerequisites
+
+1. Install the required audio library:
+```bash
+npm install react-native-sound
+```
+
+## Android Configuration
+
+### Step 1: Create Android Resource Directory
+Create the raw resource directory for Android audio files:
+```bash
+mkdir -p android/app/src/main/res/raw
+```
+
+### Step 2: Copy Audio File to Android Resources
+Copy your audio file to the Android raw resources directory:
+```bash
+copy "src/components/VideoCallInviteModal/videocall.mp3" "android/app/src/main/res/raw/videocall.mp3"
+```
+
+### Step 3: Code Configuration
+The code is already configured to handle Android audio loading:
+```typescript
+// For Android: use filename without extension from raw resources
+const audioFileName = Platform.OS === 'android' ? 'videocall' : 'videocall.mp3';
+const audioBundle = Platform.OS === 'android' ? '' : Sound.MAIN_BUNDLE;
+```
+
+### Step 4: Build and Test
+Clean and rebuild your Android project:
+```bash
+cd android
+./gradlew clean
+cd ..
+npx react-native run-android
+```
+
+## iOS Configuration
+
+### Step 1: Copy Audio File to iOS Directory
+Copy your audio file to the iOS project root:
+```bash
+copy "src/components/VideoCallInviteModal/videocall.mp3" "ios/videocall.mp3"
+```
+
+### Step 2: Install iOS Dependencies (macOS Required)
+Navigate to the iOS directory and install CocoaPods dependencies:
+```bash
+cd ios
+pod install
+```
+
+### Step 3: Add Audio File to Xcode Project (macOS Required)
+1. Open your Xcode workspace:
+   ```bash
+   open YouTrackMobile.xcworkspace
+   ```
+
+2. In Xcode Project Navigator:
+   - Right-click on the `YouTrackMobile` folder
+   - Select "Add Files to 'YouTrackMobile'"
+   - Choose the `ios/videocall.mp3` file
+   - Ensure "Add to target: YouTrackMobile" is checked
+   - Click "Add"
+
+### Step 4: Verify Bundle Resources
+Ensure the audio file appears in:
+- Project Settings → Build Phases → Copy Bundle Resources
+
+### Step 5: Build and Test iOS
+```bash
+npx react-native run-ios
+```
+
+## Code Implementation
+
+The VideoCallInviteModal component includes the following audio functionality:
+
+### Audio Initialization
+```typescript
+// Initialize audio playback category (required for iOS)
+Sound.setCategory('Playback');
+
+// Load audio file with platform-specific configuration
+const audioFileName = Platform.OS === 'android' ? 'videocall' : 'videocall.mp3';
+const audioBundle = Platform.OS === 'android' ? '' : Sound.MAIN_BUNDLE;
+
+soundRef.current = new Sound(audioFileName, audioBundle, (error) => {
+    if (error) {
+        console.log('Audio loading failed:', error);
+        return;
+    }
+    console.log('Audio loaded successfully, duration:', soundRef.current?.getDuration() + ' seconds');
+});
+```
+
+### Audio Playback
+```typescript
+// Play audio when modal shows
+if (soundRef.current) {
+    soundRef.current.play((success) => {
+        if (success) {
+            console.log('Audio playback successful');
+        } else {
+            console.log('Audio playback failed');
+        }
+    });
+} else {
+    console.log('Audio file not yet loaded');
+}
+```
+
+### Audio Cleanup
+```typescript
+// Stop audio when modal closes
+if (soundRef.current) {
+    soundRef.current.stop();
+    console.log('Audio playback stopped');
+}
+
+// Release audio resources on component unmount
+if (soundRef.current) {
+    soundRef.current.release();
+    soundRef.current = null;
+}
+```
+
+## File Structure
+
+After configuration, your project structure should include:
+
+```
+src/components/VideoCallInviteModal/
+├── VideoCallInviteModal.tsx        # Component with audio functionality
+├── VideoCallInviteModal.styles.ts  # Component styles
+├── videocall.mp3                   # Source audio file
+└── AUDIO_SETUP_GUIDE.md           # This guide
+
+android/app/src/main/res/raw/
+└── videocall.mp3                   # Android audio resource
+
+ios/
+└── videocall.mp3                   # iOS audio file (to be added to Xcode)
+```
+
+## Troubleshooting
+
+### Common Issues
+
+1. **Android Audio Not Playing**
+   - Ensure the audio file is in `android/app/src/main/res/raw/`
+   - Use filename without extension in code
+   - Clean and rebuild the project
+
+2. **iOS Audio Not Found**
+   - Verify the audio file is added to Xcode project
+   - Check that the file is included in Bundle Resources
+   - Use full filename with extension in code
+
+3. **Audio Loading Errors**
+   - Check console logs for specific error messages
+   - Ensure audio file format is supported (MP3, WAV, etc.)
+   - Verify file permissions and accessibility
+
+### Platform-Specific Notes
+
+- **Android**: Audio files must be placed in the `res/raw` directory and referenced without file extensions
+- **iOS**: Audio files must be added to the Xcode project bundle and referenced with full filenames
+- **Windows Development**: iOS configuration steps require macOS with Xcode installed
+
+## Dependencies
+
+- `react-native-sound`: Audio playback library
+- React Native 0.60+: Auto-linking support
+- Android API Level 21+: Minimum Android support
+- iOS 10.0+: Minimum iOS support
+
+## Testing
+
+1. Trigger the VideoCallInviteModal to show
+2. Listen for audio playback when modal appears
+3. Verify audio stops when modal closes
+4. Check console logs for any error messages
+
+For additional support, refer to the [react-native-sound documentation](https://github.com/zmxv/react-native-sound).

+      //componentWillUnmount
+      return () => {

+      }
+    }, [])
+  const onBack = useCallback(
+    () => {
+      console.log('onBack onLeftPress=', onLeftPress)
+      if (onLeftPress) {
+        return onLeftPress();
+      }
+      return navigationRef?.goBack();
+    },
+    [],
+  );
+  const handleLayout = (event: LayoutChangeEvent) => {
+    const {width, height} = event.nativeEvent.layout;
+    console.log('csxMobileHeader handleLayout width=', width, 'height=', height)
+    setState((prevState) => {
+      return {

+    })
+  };

+  return (

+          </TouchableOpacity>
+        )
+      }
+      {titleComp ? titleComp : (
+        <Text style={[styles.title, titleStyle]} numberOfLines={1} ellipsizeMode={'tail'}>{title}</Text>
+      )}
+      {
+        rightBt ? <View style={styles.rightBtBox}>{rightBt}</View> : (
+          <TouchableOpacity onLayout={handleLayout} disabled={rBtDisabled} style={[styles.sideButton, styles.rBt,/*{minWidth: state.headerBtWidth}*/]} onPress={onRightPress}>
+            <Text style={[styles.buttonText, rBtDisabled ? styles.disabledText : null]}>{rightBtText}</Text>
+          </TouchableOpacity>
+        )
+      }
+    </View>
+  )

+              - HMAC-SHA256 需要对称密钥（共享密钥）
+              - RSA privateKey 是非对称加密的私钥，设计用途不同
+            2. 后端验证问题
+              - 后端只接收 publicKey，无法使用它来验证 HMAC
+              - HMAC 验证需要相同的密钥

+              - 固定密钥虽然所有设备相同，但可以由后端安全管理

+/**
+ * Detect device manufacturer
+ */
+const detectDeviceVendor = (): string | null => {
+  const brand = DeviceInfo.getBrand().toLowerCase();
+
+  if (brand.includes('xiaomi') || brand.includes('redmi') || brand.includes('poco')) {
+    return 'xiaomi';
+  } else if (brand.includes('huawei') || brand.includes('honor')) {
+    return 'huawei';
+  } else if (brand.includes('oppo')) {
+    return 'oppo';
+  } else if (brand.includes('vivo')) {
+    return 'vivo';
+  } else if (brand.includes('oneplus')) {
+    return 'oneplus';
+  } else if (brand.includes('samsung')) {
+    return 'samsung';
+  } else if (brand.includes('realme')) {
+    return 'realme';
+  }
+
+  return null;
+};

+/**
+ * Open vendor-specific settings
+ */
+const openVendorSettings = (intent: string) => {
+  if (Platform.OS !== 'android') return;
+
+  try {
+    // Try to open specific settings activity
+    Linking.openURL(`intent://${intent}#Intent;end`).catch(() => {
+      // Fallback to general settings
+      Linking.openSettings();
+    });
+  } catch (error) {
+    console.error('Error opening vendor settings:', error);
+    Linking.openSettings();
+  }
+};

+/**
+ * Show battery optimization prompt
+ */
+export const showBatteryOptimizationPrompt = async (forceShow: boolean = false) => {
+  if (Platform.OS !== 'android') return;
+
+  try {
+    // Check if already prompted
+    if (!forceShow) {
+      const checked = await AsyncStorage.getItem(BATTERY_OPTIMIZATION_KEY);
+      if (checked === 'true') return;
+    }
+
+    const vendor = detectDeviceVendor();
+    if (!vendor || !VENDOR_SETTINGS[vendor]) {
+      // Generic Android prompt
+      Alert.alert(
+        'Enable Background Notifications',
+        'To receive notifications when the app is closed, please:\n\n' +
+        '1. Go to Settings > Apps > CSX Mobile\n' +
+        '2. Enable "Allow background activity"\n' +
+        '3. Disable battery optimization\n' +
+        '4. Enable auto-start if available',
+        [
+          {
+            text: 'Later',
+            style: 'cancel',
+          },
+          {
+            text: 'Open Settings',
+            onPress: () => Linking.openSettings(),
+          },
+        ]
+      );
+    } else {
+      // Vendor-specific prompt
+      const vendorInfo = VENDOR_SETTINGS[vendor];
+      const tips = vendorInfo.tips.map((tip, index) => `${index + 1}. ${tip}`).join('\n');
+
+      Alert.alert(
+        `${vendorInfo.name} Notification Settings`,
+        `To ensure you receive all notifications on your ${vendorInfo.name} device:\n\n${tips}`,
+        [
+          {
+            text: 'Skip',
+            style: 'cancel',
+          },
+          {
+            text: 'Open Settings',
+            onPress: () => {
+              // Show settings options
+              Alert.alert(
+                'Choose Settings',
+                'Select which settings to open:',
+                vendorInfo.settings.map(setting => ({
+                  text: setting.label,
+                  onPress: () => openVendorSettings(setting.intent),
+                })).concat([
+                  {
+                    text: 'Cancel',
+                    style: 'cancel',
+                  }
+                ])
+              );
+            },
+          },
+        ]
+      );
+    }
+
+    // Mark as checked
+    await AsyncStorage.setItem(BATTERY_OPTIMIZATION_KEY, 'true');
+  } catch (error) {
+    console.error('Error showing battery optimization prompt:', error);
+  }
+};

+/**
+ * Check and request ignore battery optimizations permission (Android 6.0+)
+ */
+export const requestIgnoreBatteryOptimizations = async () => {
+  if (Platform.OS !== 'android') return;
+
+  try {
+    // Check if we can request this permission
+    if (Platform.Version >= 23) {
+      const { PermissionsAndroid } = require('react-native');
+
+      // This is a special permission that needs to be requested differently
+      // It opens a system dialog asking user to whitelist the app
+      const packageName = await DeviceInfo.getBundleId();
+      const intentUrl = `android.settings.REQUEST_IGNORE_BATTERY_OPTIMIZATIONS://package:${packageName}`;
+
+      Alert.alert(
+        'Battery Optimization',
+        'To ensure reliable notification delivery, please allow CSX Mobile to ignore battery optimizations.',
+        [
+          {
+            text: 'Cancel',
+            style: 'cancel',
+          },
+          {
+            text: 'Allow',
+            onPress: async () => {
+              try {
+                await Linking.openURL(intentUrl);
+              } catch (e) {
+                console.error('Cannot open battery optimization settings:', e);
+                // Fallback to general settings
+                Linking.openSettings();
+              }
+            },
+          },
+        ]
+      );
+    }
+  } catch (error) {
+    console.error('Error requesting battery optimization exemption:', error);
+  }
+};
+
+/**
+ * Battery Optimization Hook
+ */
+export const useBatteryOptimization = () => {
+  const [vendor, setVendor] = useState<string | null>(null);
+
+  useEffect(() => {
+    if (Platform.OS === 'android') {
+      setVendor(detectDeviceVendor());
+
+      // Show prompt after a delay (e.g., after user grants notification permission)
+      const timer = setTimeout(() => {
+        showBatteryOptimizationPrompt();
+      }, 5000);
+
+      return () => clearTimeout(timer);
+    }
+  }, []);
+
+  return {
+    vendor,
+    showPrompt: () => showBatteryOptimizationPrompt(true),
+    requestWhitelist: requestIgnoreBatteryOptimizations,
+  };
+};
+
+/**
+ * Show vendor-specific notification tips
+ */
+export const showVendorNotificationTips = () => {
+  if (Platform.OS !== 'android') return;
+
+  const vendor = detectDeviceVendor();
+  if (!vendor || !VENDOR_SETTINGS[vendor]) {
+    ToastAndroid.show(
+      'Please disable battery optimization for CSX Mobile in Settings',
+      ToastAndroid.LONG
+    );
+    return;
+  }
+
+  const vendorInfo = VENDOR_SETTINGS[vendor];
+  const message = `${vendorInfo.name} users: ${vendorInfo.tips[0]}`;
+  ToastAndroid.show(message, ToastAndroid.LONG);
+};
+

+  showBatteryOptimizationPrompt,
+  requestIgnoreBatteryOptimizations,
+  useBatteryOptimization,

+import { RemoteMessage, PushNotificationData, NotificationType, NOTIFICATION_ROUTE_MAP } from './types';
+import { globalEventName, useGlobalEventEmitter } from 'tools/useGlobalEventEmitter';
+
+/**
+ * Push Notification Service
+ * Handles push notification processing, routing, and data parsing
+ */
+class PushNotificationService {
+  private static instance: PushNotificationService;
+  private handlers: Map<string, (data: PushNotificationData) => void> = new Map();
+  private emitEvent: ((eventName: string, ...args: any[]) => void) | null = null;
+
+  private constructor() {}
+
+  /**
+   * Get singleton instance
+   */
+  static getInstance(): PushNotificationService {
+    if (!PushNotificationService.instance) {
+      PushNotificationService.instance = new PushNotificationService();
+    }
+    return PushNotificationService.instance;
+  }
+
+  /**
+   * Initialize the service with event emitter
+   */
+  initialize(emitEvent: (eventName: string, ...args: any[]) => void) {
+    this.emitEvent = emitEvent;
+    console.log('PushNotificationService initialized');
+  }
+
+  /**
+   * Handle push notification when received (foreground)
+   */
+  handleNotificationReceived(remoteMessage: RemoteMessage): void {
+    console.log('PushNotificationService: Notification received', remoteMessage);
+    
+    if (this.emitEvent) {
+      this.emitEvent(globalEventName.pushNotificationReceived, remoteMessage);
+    }
+
+    // Process notification data
+    this.processNotificationData(remoteMessage, 'received');
+  }
+
+  /**
+   * Handle push notification when clicked/opened
+   */
+  handleNotificationOpened(remoteMessage: RemoteMessage): void {
+    console.log('PushNotificationService: Notification opened', remoteMessage);
+    
+    if (this.emitEvent) {
+      this.emitEvent(globalEventName.pushNotificationClicked, remoteMessage);
+    }
+
+    // Process notification data and navigate
+    this.processNotificationData(remoteMessage, 'opened');
+  }
+
+  /**
+   * Process notification data and perform actions
+   */
+  private processNotificationData(remoteMessage: RemoteMessage, trigger: 'received' | 'opened'): void {
+    const { data } = remoteMessage;
+    
+    if (!data) {
+      console.warn('PushNotificationService: No data in notification');
+      return;
+    }
+
+    console.log('PushNotificationService: Processing notification data', data);
+
+    // Handle custom actions
+    if (data.action) {
+      this.handleCustomAction(data.action, data.actionData || '{}');
+    }
+
+    // Handle navigation (only when notification is opened/clicked)
+    if (trigger === 'opened') {
+      this.handleNavigation(data);
+    }
+
+    // Handle type-specific logic
+    if (data.type) {
+      this.handleTypeSpecificLogic(data.type, data);
+    }
+  }
+
+  /**
+   * Handle navigation based on notification data
+   */
+  private handleNavigation(data: PushNotificationData): void {
+    let targetRoute: string | undefined;
+    let routeParams: object = {};
+
+    // Use explicit page if provided
+    if (data.page) {
+      targetRoute = data.page;
+    } 
+    // Use type-based routing
+    else if (data.type && NOTIFICATION_ROUTE_MAP[data.type]) {
+      targetRoute = NOTIFICATION_ROUTE_MAP[data.type];
+    }
+
+    // Parse route parameters
+    if (data.params) {
+      try {
+        routeParams = JSON.parse(data.params);
+      } catch (error) {
+        console.error('PushNotificationService: Failed to parse route params', error);
+      }
+    }
+
+    // Add notification-specific params
+    if (data.appointmentId) routeParams = { ...routeParams, appointmentId: data.appointmentId };
+    if (data.patientId) routeParams = { ...routeParams, patientId: data.patientId };
+    if (data.messageId) routeParams = { ...routeParams, messageId: data.messageId };
+    if (data.callId) routeParams = { ...routeParams, callId: data.callId };
+    if (data.doctorId) routeParams = { ...routeParams, doctorId: data.doctorId };
+    if (data.clinicId) routeParams = { ...routeParams, clinicId: data.clinicId };
+
+    // Navigate to target route
+    if (targetRoute && global.navigationRef?.isNavigationReady()) {
+      console.log('PushNotificationService: Navigating to', targetRoute, routeParams);
+      
+      // Add a small delay to ensure navigation is ready
+      setTimeout(() => {
+        global.navigationRef?.navigate(targetRoute, routeParams);
+      }, 500);
+    } else {
+      console.warn('PushNotificationService: No target route found or navigation not ready', {
+        targetRoute,
+        navigationReady: global.navigationRef?.isNavigationReady()
+      });
+    }
+  }
+
+  /**
+   * Handle custom actions
+   */
+  private handleCustomAction(action: string, actionDataStr: string): void {
+    try {
+      const actionData = JSON.parse(actionDataStr);
+      console.log('PushNotificationService: Handling custom action', action, actionData);
+
+      switch (action) {
+        case 'refresh_appointments':
+          this.emitEvent?.(globalEventName.refreshHomeAppointmentlist, actionData);
+          break;
+        case 'refresh_patients':
+          this.emitEvent?.(globalEventName.refreshPatientList, actionData);
+          break;
+        case 'show_alert':
+          this.emitEvent?.(globalEventName.showCommonAlertModal, {
+            title: actionData.title || 'Notification',
+            content: actionData.message || 'You have a new notification'
+          });
+          break;
+        case 'video_call_invite':
+          this.emitEvent?.(globalEventName.showVideoCallInviteModal, actionData);
+          break;
+        default:
+          console.log('PushNotificationService: Unknown custom action', action);
+      }
+    } catch (error) {
+      console.error('PushNotificationService: Failed to parse action data', error);
+    }
+  }
+
+  /**
+   * Handle type-specific logic
+   */
+  private handleTypeSpecificLogic(type: string, data: PushNotificationData): void {
+    console.log('PushNotificationService: Handling type-specific logic', type, data);
+
+    // Call registered handlers
+    const handler = this.handlers.get(type);
+    if (handler) {
+      handler(data);
+    }
+
+    // Built-in type handling
+    switch (type) {
+      case NotificationType.VIDEO_CALL:
+        this.handleVideoCallNotification(data);
+        break;
+      case NotificationType.APPOINTMENT:
+        this.handleAppointmentNotification(data);
+        break;
+      case NotificationType.MESSAGE:
+        this.handleMessageNotification(data);
+        break;
+      case NotificationType.EMERGENCY:
+        this.handleEmergencyNotification(data);
+        break;
+    }
+  }
+
+  /**
+   * Handle video call notifications
+   */
+  private handleVideoCallNotification(data: PushNotificationData): void {
+    if (data.callId) {
+      // Emit video call event
+      this.emitEvent?.(globalEventName.One_click_video_diagnosis, {
+        callId: data.callId,
+        patientId: data.patientId,
+        doctorId: data.doctorId
+      });
+    }
+  }
+
+  /**
+   * Handle appointment notifications
+   */
+  private handleAppointmentNotification(data: PushNotificationData): void {
+    if (data.appointmentId) {
+      // Refresh appointment list
+      this.emitEvent?.(globalEventName.refreshHomeAppointmentlist, {
+        appointmentId: data.appointmentId
+      });
+    }
+  }
+
+  /**
+   * Handle message notifications
+   */
+  private handleMessageNotification(data: PushNotificationData): void {
+    console.log('PushNotificationService: Handling message notification', data);
+    // Message-specific logic can be added here
+  }
+
+  /**
+   * Handle emergency notifications
+   */
+  private handleEmergencyNotification(data: PushNotificationData): void {
+    // Show emergency alert
+    this.emitEvent?.(globalEventName.showCommonAlertModal, {
+      title: 'Emergency Alert',
+      content: data.body || 'Emergency notification received'
+    });
+  }
+
+  /**
+   * Register custom handler for specific notification type
+   */
+  registerHandler(type: string, handler: (data: PushNotificationData) => void): void {
+    this.handlers.set(type, handler);
+    console.log('PushNotificationService: Registered handler for type', type);
+  }
+
+  /**
+   * Unregister handler for specific notification type
+   */
+  unregisterHandler(type: string): void {
+    this.handlers.delete(type);
+    console.log('PushNotificationService: Unregistered handler for type', type);
+  }
+
+  /**
+   * Get all registered handlers
+   */
+  getRegisteredHandlers(): string[] {
+    return Array.from(this.handlers.keys());
+  }
+
+  /**
+   * Clear all handlers
+   */
+  clearAllHandlers(): void {
+    this.handlers.clear();
+    console.log('PushNotificationService: Cleared all handlers');
+  }
+}
+
+// Export singleton instance
+export const pushNotificationService = PushNotificationService.getInstance();
+export default pushNotificationService;

+// Firebase Push Notification Types
+export interface PushNotificationData {
+  // Basic notification info
+  type?: string;           // Notification type: 'appointment', 'message', 'reminder', 'call', etc.
+  title?: string;          // Notification title
+  body?: string;           // Notification body
+
+  // Navigation data
+  page?: string;           // Target page to navigate to
+  params?: string;         // JSON string of navigation parameters
+
+  // Specific data based on notification type
+  appointmentId?: string;  // For appointment notifications
+  patientId?: string;      // For patient-related notifications
+  messageId?: string;      // For message notifications
+  callId?: string;         // For call notifications
+  doctorId?: string;       // For doctor-related notifications
+  clinicId?: string;       // For clinic-related notifications
+
+  // Additional metadata
+  timestamp?: string;      // Notification timestamp
+  priority?: 'high' | 'normal' | 'low';
+  sound?: string;          // Custom sound file
+  badge?: number;          // Badge count
+  category?: string;       // Notification category
+
+  // Custom action data
+  action?: string;         // Custom action to perform
+  actionData?: string;     // JSON string of action data
+  /**
+   * TRUSTED_DEVICE_REGISTER_REQUEST : https://app.clickup.com/t/8553538/TECH-6522?comment=90180143711752 請求設置為可信任設備
+   * TRUSTED_DEVICE_APPLICATION_REJECTED
+   * TRUSTED_DEVICE_VERIFY_REQUEST : https://app.clickup.com/t/8553538/TECH-6314?comment=90180143625641&threadedComment=90180143715484
+   * TRUSTED_DEVICE_VERIFY_TOKEN_GENERATED: https://app.clickup.com/t/8553538/TECH-6314?comment=90180143625641&threadedComment=90180143715484
+   * TRUSTED_DEVICE_REMOVE_REQUEST : 移除可信设备
+   * TRUSTED_DEVICE_REGISTERED_NOT_YOU : 当前设备不是可信设备
+   * TRUSTED_DEVICE_REMOVED_NOTIFY_OTHERS: 当前账号没有绑定任何可信设备
+   * TRUSTED_DEVICE_APPLICATION_ALLOWED: 从csm发起的可信设备请求，csx通过后告知csm
+   */
+  bizType:string;
+  requestId?:string;
+  verificationCode?:string;
+}
+
+export interface RemoteMessage {
+  messageId?: string;
+  data?: PushNotificationData;
+  notification?: {
+    title?: string;
+    body?: string;
+    android?: {
+      channelId?: string;
+      smallIcon?: string;
+      color?: string;
+      sound?: string;
+      tag?: string;
+      imageUrl?: string;
+    };
+    ios?: {
+      sound?: string;
+      badge?: number;
+      imageUrl?: string;
+    };
+  };
+  from?: string;
+  to?: string;
+  collapseKey?: string;
+  sentTime?: number;
+  ttl?: number;
+}
+
+export interface PushNotificationHandler {
+  handleNotification: (message: RemoteMessage) => void;
+  handleNotificationOpened: (message: RemoteMessage) => void;
+  registerHandler: (type: string, handler: (data: PushNotificationData) => void) => void;
+  unregisterHandler: (type: string) => void;
+}
+
+export interface PushNotificationState {
+  fcmToken: string;
+  notification: RemoteMessage | null;
+  isInitialized: boolean;
+  hasPermission: boolean;
+}
+
+// Predefined notification types
+export enum NotificationType {
+  APPOINTMENT = 'appointment',
+  MESSAGE = 'message',
+  REMINDER = 'reminder',
+  VIDEO_CALL = 'video_call',
+  CONSULTATION = 'consultation',
+  PRESCRIPTION = 'prescription',
+  TEST_RESULT = 'test_result',
+  PAYMENT = 'payment',
+  SYSTEM = 'system',
+  EMERGENCY = 'emergency'
+}
+
+// Route mapping for different notification types
+export const NOTIFICATION_ROUTE_MAP: Record<string, string> = {
+  [NotificationType.APPOINTMENT]: 'AppointmentDetailPage',
+  [NotificationType.MESSAGE]: 'MessagePage',
+  [NotificationType.REMINDER]: 'HomePage',
+  [NotificationType.VIDEO_CALL]: 'DiagnosisPage',
+  [NotificationType.CONSULTATION]: 'ConsultationPage',
+  [NotificationType.PRESCRIPTION]: 'PrescriptionPage',
+  [NotificationType.TEST_RESULT]: 'TestResultPage',
+  [NotificationType.PAYMENT]: 'PaymentPage',
+  [NotificationType.SYSTEM]: 'HomePage',
+  [NotificationType.EMERGENCY]: 'EmergencyPage'
+};

+        backupListener?.remove();
+      }
+    }, [])
+  // Optionally define the sendTokenToServer function
+  const sendTokenToServer = async (token: string) => {
+    console.log('useFirebaseMessaging.tsx Sending token to server:', token);
+    addLog('info', 'useFirebaseMessaging.tsx Sending token to server=', '', token);
+    // Implement your server-side logic to handle the FCM token here
+    const [err, data] = await tool.to(register_client(token))
+    addLog('info', 'useFirebaseMessaging.tsx register_client data=', '', data);
+    await copyLogsToClipboard();
+    if (data) {
+    }
+  };
+  /**
+   * 避免安卓用户在首页时按后退按键后直接退出app
+   * Prevent Android users from exiting the app directly after pressing the back button on the homepage
+   */
+  // useAndroidBackHandler({
+  //     navigation
+  // })
+  /**
+   * Methods of child components that can be directly called by the parent component
+   */
     // useImperativeHandle(parentRef, () => ({
     //     xxx: () => {
     //
     //     }
     // }), [])
-    //render
-    return state.fcmToken
+    // Clear notification function
+  const clearNotification = useCallback(() => {
+      setState(prevState => ({...prevState, notification: null}));
+    }, []);
+
+  // Register custom notification handler
+  const registerNotificationHandler = useCallback((type: string, handler: (data: any) => void) => {
+    pushNotificationService.registerHandler(type, handler);
+  }, []);
+
+  // Unregister notification handler
+  const unregisterNotificationHandler = useCallback((type: string) => {
+    pushNotificationService.unregisterHandler(type);
+  }, []);
+
+  //render - return push notification interface
+  return {
+    fcmToken: state.fcmToken,
+    notification: state.notification,
+    isInitialized: state.isInitialized,
+    hasPermission: state.hasPermission,
+    clearNotification,
+    registerNotificationHandler,
+    unregisterNotificationHandler,
+    pushNotificationService
+  }
 }
 export default useFirebaseMessaging

+const originalTranslate = i18n.t.bind(i18n);
+
+// Override the translate function to implement fallback to English key when translation is missing
+i18n.t = function(key: string, options?: any) {
+    try {
+        const result = originalTranslate(key, options);
+        
+        // Check if the result is the same as the key (meaning translation not found)
+        // or if it contains translation missing indicators
+        if (result === key || result.includes('[missing') || result === undefined || result === null || result === '') {
+            // Return the original English key as fallback
+            return key;
+        }
+        
+        return result;
+    } catch (error) {
+        // If any error occurs, return the original English key
+        console.warn('i18n translation error for key:', key, error);
+        return key;
+    }
+};

+            let list: Country[] = []
+            Object.keys(countries.data).forEach(
+              (item: string, index, array) => {
+                list = list.concat((countries as any).data[item])
+              }
+            )
+            list = list.map(
+              (item: Country, index, array) => {
+                return {
+                  ...item,
+                  id: item.code,
+                  title: item.name,
+                }
+              }
+            )
+            console.log('list=', list)
+            setState(prevState => {
+              return {
+                ...prevState, countryList: list
+              }
+            })
+          })();
+          console.log(`BindMobileNumberPage componentDidMount`)
+          //componentWillUnmount
+          return () => {
+            console.log(`BindMobileNumberPage componentWillUnmount`)
+            // Clear countdown timer
+            if (countDownIntervalRef.current) {
+              clearInterval(countDownIntervalRef.current)
+              countDownIntervalRef.current = null
+            }
+          }
+        }, [])
+      const {setLoading, setLoadingText} = useLoading();
+      const isBindLoginBtDisabled = useMemo(() => {
+        return !state.phone || !state.oneTimeCode
+      }, [state.phone, state.oneTimeCode])
+      /**
+       * @param expiredAt "2025-07-30T14:06:38.833272+08:00"
+       */
+      const startCountDown = (expiredAt: string) => {
+        const expiredTime = new Date(expiredAt);
+        const currentTime = new Date();
+        console.log('startCountDown expiredTime=', expiredTime.toString());
+        console.log('startCountDown currentTime=', currentTime.toString());
+        const timeDiffMs = expiredTime.getTime() - currentTime.getTime();
+        console.log('startCountDown timeDiffMs=', timeDiffMs);
+        const countDownTime = Math.max(0, Math.ceil(timeDiffMs / 1000));
+        console.log('startCountDown countDownTime=', countDownTime);
+        setState(prevState => ({...prevState, countDownTime: countDownTime}))
+
+        countDownIntervalRef.current = setInterval(() => {
+          setState(prevState => {
+            if (prevState.countDownTime <= 1) {
+              if (countDownIntervalRef.current) {
+                clearInterval(countDownIntervalRef.current)
+                countDownIntervalRef.current = null

+                }
+              })

+                setState(prevState => {

+          </TouchableOpacity>

+        </Modal>)
+      }
+      const emitEvent = useGlobalEventEmitter();
+      const curAccount = useAccount();
+
+      const _trusted_devices_apply = async () => {
+        if (!state.isChecked) {
+          return
+        }
+        const deviceId = await DeviceInfo.getUniqueId();
+        const deviceModel = DeviceInfo.getModel();
+        const deviceOS = Platform.OS + ' ' + Platform.Version;
+        const keys = generateKeys();
+        console.log('trusted_devices_apply keys=', logKeysForVerification(keys));
+        if (keys.publicKey) {
+          await storage.setItem(`${storage.csxMobileCachekeys.trusted_devices_publicKey}|${curAccount?.username}`, keys.publicKey);
+        }
+        if (keys.privateKey) {
+          await storage.setItem(`${storage.csxMobileCachekeys.trusted_devices_privateKey}|${curAccount?.username}`, keys.privateKey);
+        }
+        let publicKey = keys.publicKey
+        console.log('trusted_devices_apply publicKey=', publicKey)
+        let deviceFingerprint = ''
+        /*
+        Generate deviceFingerprint using HMAC-SHA256 following backend Python example
+        RSA-vs-HMAC-SHA256-comparison.md
+         不建议使用 keys.privateKey 作为 HMAC-SHA256 的密钥，原因如下：
+          1. 密钥类型不匹配
+            - HMAC-SHA256 需要对称密钥（共享密钥）
+            - RSA privateKey 是非对称加密的私钥，设计用途不同
+          2. 后端验证问题
+            - 后端只接收 publicKey，无法使用它来验证 HMAC
+            - HMAC 验证需要相同的密钥
+          3. 安全考虑
+            - 固定密钥虽然所有设备相同，但可以由后端安全管理
+            - 使用 privateKey 作为 HMAC 密钥可能暴露私钥的使用模式
+         */
+        const secretKey = '0oYv|m?jL82Zm32i&EwcE,#<gEnQ<l8J'; // Secret key for HMAC
+        // Generate hierarchical hashes similar to Python implementation
+        // hardware_id = hash(cpu_id + baseband_id)
+        const hardwareInfo = `${deviceId}|${deviceModel}`;
+        const hardwareId = CryptoJS.HmacSHA256(hardwareInfo, secretKey).toString();
+        // software_id = hash(os_version + security_patch)
+        const softwareInfo = `${Platform.OS}|${Platform.Version}`;
+        const softwareId = CryptoJS.HmacSHA256(softwareInfo, secretKey).toString();
+        // app_signature = hash(app_certificate + app_version)
+        const appVersion = DeviceInfo.getVersion();
+        const appBuildNumber = DeviceInfo.getBuildNumber();
+        const appInfo = `${appVersion}|${appBuildNumber}`;
+        const appSignature = CryptoJS.HmacSHA256(appInfo, secretKey).toString();
+        // timestamp_hash for additional uniqueness
+        const timestamp = Date.now().toString();
+        const timestampHash = CryptoJS.HmacSHA256(timestamp, secretKey).toString();
+        // Final deviceFingerprint = hash(hardware_id + software_id + app_signature + timestamp_hash)
+        const finalFingerprintMessage = `${hardwareId}|${softwareId}|${appSignature}|${timestampHash}`;
+        console.log('trusted_devices_apply finalFingerprintMessage=', finalFingerprintMessage)
+        deviceFingerprint = CryptoJS.HmacSHA256(finalFingerprintMessage, secretKey).toString(CryptoJS.enc.Hex);
+        console.log('trusted_devices_apply deviceFingerprint=', deviceFingerprint)
+        await trusted_devices_apply({
+          "deviceId": deviceId,
+          "deviceModel": deviceModel,
+          "deviceOS": deviceOS,
+          "deviceFingerprint": deviceFingerprint,
+          "publicKey": publicKey,
+          deviceFingerprintPlaintext: finalFingerprintMessage
+        })
+      }
+      return (
+        <ThemeContext.Consumer>
+          {(theme: Theme) => {
+            return (

+                <KeyboardAvoidingView

+                >
+                  <ScrollView
+                    style={{flex: 1}}
