+                          <View style={[styles.progressRow]}>
+                            <View style={[styles.progressRowItem]}>
+                              {CheckGray()}
+                              <Text style={[styles.progressRowItemText, {color: theme.uiTheme.colors.$grayText}]}>{global.i18n.t('Verify account password')}</Text>
+                            </View>
+                            <View style={[styles.progressRowItem]}>
+                              {/*横线*/}
+                              <View style={[styles.progressRowItemLine]}>
+                              </View>
+                            </View>
+                            <View style={[styles.progressRowItem]}>
+                              <View style={[styles.progressRowItemIcon]}>
+                                <Text style={[styles.progressRowItemText0]}>2</Text>
+                              </View>
+                              <Text style={[styles.progressRowItemText]}>{global.i18n.t('Bind mobile number')}</Text>
+                            </View>
+                          </View>
+                          {BindMobileNumber()}
+                          <Text style={[styles.FirstloginCSMtext]}>{global.i18n.t('Your CSM account is not currently linked to a mobile number')}</Text>
+                          <Text style={[styles.FirstloginCSMtext1]}>{global.i18n.t('Please enter your mobile number and verify the one-time password to bind')}</Text>
+                          <CommonSearchBar style={styles.searchBar} inputStyle={styles.inputStyle}
+                            placeholderStyle={styles.placeholderStyle}
+                                           LeftIcon={() => {
+                                             return (props) => {
+                                               return <View style={styles.LeftIconBox}>

+                                                   {PhoneBlack()}
+                                                 </View>
+                                                 {renderAreaCodeButton(theme)}
+                                               </View>
+                                             }
+                                           }}
+                                           searchQuery={state.phone} keyboardType={'numeric'}
+                                           changeSearchQuery={(searchQuery: string, editing: boolean) => {
+                                             console.log(' changeSearchQuery=', searchQuery, ' editing=', editing)
+                                             setState(prevState => {
+                                               return {
+                                                 ...prevState, phone: searchQuery.replace(/\n/g, '')
+                                               }
+                                             })
+                                           }} placeholder={global.i18n.t('Please_enter_mobile_number')} showSearchIcon={false} realTimeChangeSearchQuery={true}
+                                           useSearchQueryForShow={false}>
+                          </CommonSearchBar>
+
+                          <CommonSearchBar style={styles.searchBar} inputStyle={styles.inputStyle}
+                            placeholderStyle={styles.placeholderStyle}
+                                           LeftIcon={() => {
+                                             return (props) => {
+                                               return <View style={styles.oneTowThreeBox}>
+                                                 <Text style={styles.oneTowThreeText}>123</Text>
+                                               </View>
+                                             }
+                                           }}
+                                           RightIcon={() => {

+                                               return <TouchableOpacity onPress={async () => {

+                                                   const res = await SendBindPhoneVerificationCode(state.areaCode.replace('+', ''), state.phone)
+                                                   console.log('SendBindPhoneVerificationCode res=', res)
+                                                   setTimeout(async () => {

+                                                   }, 2000);
+                                                   if (res) {
+                                                     startCountDown(res.expiredAt)
+                                                   }
+                                                 } catch (e) {
+                                                   setTimeout(async () => {
+                                                     await copyLogsToClipboard();
+                                                   }, 2000);
+                                                 }
+                                               }} style={styles.oneTimeCodeBt} disabled={state.countDownTime > 0 || !state.phone}>
+                                                 <Text style={[styles.oneTimeCodeText, (!state.phone && {color: uiTheme.colors.$disabledBtnText})]}>
+                                                   {state.countDownTime > 0 ? `${state.countDownTime}s` : global.i18n.t('get_one_time_password')}
+                                                 </Text>
+                                               </TouchableOpacity>
+                                             }
+                                           }}
+                                           searchQuery={state.oneTimeCode} keyboardType={'numeric'}

+interface MedicationNotesCustomRowProps {
+  children?: React.ReactNode;
+  selectedMedicationNotes?: SelectedItem | RNSelectedItem | undefined;
+  medicationNotesModalList?: string[];
+  onAddMedicationNote?: (textToAdd: string) => void;
+  clearSelectedItem?: () => void;
+}
 
-    loading: boolean;
-    suggestionsList: [];
+interface DiagnosisCustomRowProps extends RNAutoPositionedPopupCustomRowProps {
+  diagnosisSelectList?: string[];
+  onAddDiagnosis?: (textToAdd: string) => void;
 }
 
+const MedicationNotesCustomRow: React.FC<MedicationNotesCustomRowProps> = memo(({
+                                                                                  children,
+                                                                                  selectedMedicationNotes,
+                                                                                  medicationNotesModalList,
+                                                                                  onAddMedicationNote,
+                                                                                  clearSelectedItem
+                                                                                }: MedicationNotesCustomRowProps) => {
+  const {uiTheme} = useThemeProvider();
+  const [searchQuery, setSearchQuery] = useState<string>('');
+  const emitEvent = useGlobalEventEmitter();
+  useGlobalEventListener(
+    AutoPositionedPopupEventNames.searchQueryChange,
+    useCallback(({tag, searchQuery: newQuery}: { tag: string; searchQuery: string }): void => {
+      console.log('MedicationNotesCustomRow searchQueryChange event received=', {tag, searchQuery: newQuery});
+      if (tag === global.i18n.t('Medication_notes')) {
+        setSearchQuery(newQuery);
+      }
+    }, [])
+  );
+  const handleAddPress = useCallback((): void => {
+    console.log('MedicationNotesCustomRow handleAddPress=', {searchQuery, selectedMedicationNotes})
+    if (searchQuery === '' && !selectedMedicationNotes) {
+      return;
+    }
+    // Use searchQuery text if no item selected from dropdown
+    const textToAdd: string | undefined = searchQuery || selectedMedicationNotes?.title;
+    console.log('MedicationNotesCustomRow textToAdd=', textToAdd)
+    if (textToAdd && medicationNotesModalList && medicationNotesModalList.indexOf(textToAdd) === -1) {
+      onAddMedicationNote && onAddMedicationNote(textToAdd);
+      setSearchQuery(''); // Clear local search query after adding
+      clearSelectedItem && clearSelectedItem();
+      emitEvent(AutoPositionedPopupEventNames.searchQueryChange, {
+        tag: global.i18n.t('Medication_notes'),
+        searchQuery: ''
+      })
+    }
+  }, [searchQuery, selectedMedicationNotes, medicationNotesModalList, onAddMedicationNote, clearSelectedItem]);
+  const disabled = useMemo(() => {
+    return searchQuery === '' && !selectedMedicationNotes
+  }, [searchQuery, selectedMedicationNotes]);
+  return (
+    <View style={styles.usageRow}>
+      {children}
+      <ArrowUpDown />
+      <TouchableOpacity
+        disabled={disabled}
+        style={[
+          styles.medicationNotesInputRowAddBt,
+          disabled && {backgroundColor: uiTheme.colors.$disabledBtn}
+        ]}
+        onPress={handleAddPress}
+      >
+        <Text style={[
+          styles.medicationNotesInputRowAddBtText,
+          disabled && {color: uiTheme.colors.$disabledBtnText}
+        ]}>
+          + {global.i18n.t('join')}
+        </Text>
+      </TouchableOpacity>
+    </View>
+  );
+});
+const MedicationNotesBtChildren: React.FC<MedicationNotesCustomRowProps> = memo(({
+                                                                                   selectedMedicationNotes,
+                                                                                 }: MedicationNotesCustomRowProps) => {
+  const {uiTheme} = useThemeProvider();
+  const [searchQuery, setSearchQuery] = useState<string>('');
+  useGlobalEventListener(
+    AutoPositionedPopupEventNames.searchQueryChange,
+    useCallback(({tag, searchQuery: newQuery}: { tag: string; searchQuery: string }): void => {
+      console.log('MedicationNotesBtChildren searchQueryChange event received=', {tag, searchQuery: newQuery});
+      if (tag === global.i18n.t('Medication_notes')) {
+        setSearchQuery(newQuery);
+      }
+    }, [])
+  );
+  console.log('MedicationNotesBtChildren render=', {
+    selectedMedicationNotes, searchQuery
+  })
+  return (
+    <>
+      <Text
+        style={[styles.selectBtText, ((selectedMedicationNotes || searchQuery) && {color: uiTheme.colors.$text})]}>{searchQuery ? searchQuery : (selectedMedicationNotes ? selectedMedicationNotes.title : global.i18n.t('Please_enter'))}</Text>
+    </>
+  );
+});

+  const emitEvent = useGlobalEventEmitter();

+    useCallback(({tag, searchQuery: newQuery}: { tag: string; searchQuery: string }): void => {

+    }
+    const textToAdd: string | undefined = searchQuery || selectedItem?.title;
+    console.log('MedicalProceduresCustomRow textToAdd=', textToAdd)
+    if (textToAdd && selectList && selectList.indexOf(textToAdd) === -1) {
+      onAdded && onAdded(textToAdd);
+      setSearchQuery(''); // Clear local search query after adding
+      clearSelectedItem && clearSelectedItem();
+      emitEvent(AutoPositionedPopupEventNames.searchQueryChange, {
+        tag: i18n.t('Medical_procedures'),
+        searchQuery: ''
+      })
+    }
+  }, [searchQuery, selectedItem, selectList, onAdded, clearSelectedItem]);
+  const disabled = useMemo(() => {
+    return searchQuery === '' && !selectedItem
+  }, [searchQuery, selectedItem]);

+    <View style={styles.usageRow}>

+      {children}
+      <ArrowUpDown />

+        ]}>

+    pageIndex: number;

+    searchQuery?: string
+  }): Promise<AutoPositionedPopupData | null> => {
+    try {

+      if (state.get_consultation_setting?.enableDiagnosisCodeSystem) {
+        console.log('CreateConsultationPage.tsx diagnosis1 fetchData searchQuery=', searchQuery)
+        const data: List_hkctt_dxpx_terms | null = await list_hkctt_dxpx_terms({
+          pageIndex,
+          pageSize,
+          IsGetDiagnosis: true,
+          birthday: moment(new Date(pageData.patients.birthDate)).format('DD/MM/YYYY'),
+          gender: pageData.patients.gender,
+          keyWord: searchQuery
+        })

+            console.log('CreateConsultationPage.tsx diagnosis1 ref_diagnosis_valueAsJson.current=', ref_diagnosis_valueAsJson.current)
+          }
+          return Promise.resolve({
+            items: data.items.map((item: List_hkctt_dxpx_terms_Item, index) => {
+              let title = ''
+              if (item.coding.length >= 2) {
+                title = `${item.display} [${item.coding[0].code} / ${item.coding[1].code}]`
+              } else if (item.coding.length === 1) {
+                title = `${item.display} [${item.coding[0].code}]`
+              }
+              return {
+                ...item,
+                title,
+                id: title
+              }
+            }),
+            needLoadMore: data.items.length === pageSize,
+            pageIndex: pageIndex + 1,
+            totalCount: 0,
+            totalPage: 0,
+          })
+        }
+      } else {
+        const data: Data | null = await list_doctor_medical_terms({

+          category: 'Diagnosis',
+          keyWord: searchQuery
+        })

+  /**
+   * 根據幣種 生成不同的 小數點
+   * @param currencies
+   * @param rtType :0 返回數字 1 返回 字符串
+   */
+  const appropriateDecimal = (currencies: string, rtType: number): string | number => {
+    if (currencies === 'HKD' || currencies === 'PHP' || currencies === 'SGD' || currencies === 'MYR' || currencies === 'THB') {
+      return rtType === 0 ? 2 : '0.00'
+    } else {
+      return rtType === 0 ? 0 : '0'
+    }
+  }

+    console.log('CreateConsultationPage countTotal state.cached_expenseItems=', state.cached_expenseItems)

+      // const res = (parseFloat(state.Consultation_fees) + parseFloat(state.Medical_expenses) + parseFloat(state.Express_delivery_fee)).toFixed(2)
+      const num = (parseFloat(state.Consultation_fees) + parseFloat(state.Medical_expenses) + parseFloat(state.Express_delivery_fee));
+      console.log('CreateConsultationPage.tsx countTotal isNaN num=', num, 'numFixed=', num)
+      if (isNaN(num)) {
+        return appropriateDecimal(state.default_currency_code, 1)
+      } else {
+        //先將數字轉換為保留兩位小數的字符串形式，然後再將其轉換為帶有逗號的字符串
+        const numFixed = num.toFixed(appropriateDecimal(state.default_currency_code, 0));
+        const res = parseFloat(numFixed).toLocaleString('en-US', {
+          minimumFractionDigits: appropriateDecimal(state.default_currency_code, 0),
+          maximumFractionDigits: appropriateDecimal(state.default_currency_code, 0)
+        })
+        console.log('CreateConsultationPage countTotal=', res)
+        return res
+      }
+    }
+    return appropriateDecimal(state.default_currency_code, 1)

+  }
+  const {mode, uiTheme, setMode} = useThemeProvider();//mode='light' | 'dark'
+  const renderToolBar = () => {
+    return <View style={styles.scrollViewStyle}><ScrollView style={[scrollViewStyle.scrollViewStyle]} horizontal={true} showsHorizontalScrollIndicator={false}>
+      <TouchableOpacity style={styles.ToolBarBt} onPress={() => {
+        if (state.DropDownModalSelectIndex !== 0) {
+          setState((prevState) => {
+            return {
+              ...prevState,
+              showDropDownModal: true, DropDownModalSelectIndex: 0
+            }
+          })
+        } else {
+          setState((prevState) => {
+            return {
+              ...prevState,
+              showDropDownModal: false, DropDownModalSelectIndex: -1
+            }
+          })
+        }
+      }}>
+        <Hospital width={20} height={20} color={state.DropDownModalSelectIndex !== 0 ? uiTheme.colors.$grayText : uiTheme.colors.$blueBtn} />
+        <Text style={[styles.ToolBarBtText, (state.DropDownModalSelectIndex === 0 && { color: '#007AFF' })]}>
+          {state.cur_data_record_sharing_list_clinics ? state.cur_data_record_sharing_list_clinics.clinicCode : global.i18n.t('eHealth')}
+        </Text>
+        {state.DropDownModalSelectIndex !== 0 ? renderArrowDown() : renderArrowUp()}
+      </TouchableOpacity>
+      <TouchableOpacity style={styles.ToolBarBt} onPress={() => {
+        if (state.DropDownModalSelectIndex !== 1) {
+          setState((prevState) => {
+            return {
+              ...prevState,
+              showDropDownModal: true, DropDownModalSelectIndex: 1
+            }
+          })
+        } else {
+          setState((prevState) => {
+            return {
+              ...prevState,
+              showDropDownModal: false, DropDownModalSelectIndex: -1
+            }
+          })
+        }
+      }}>
+        <DoctorCode width={20} height={20} color={state.DropDownModalSelectIndex !== 1 ? uiTheme.colors.$grayText : uiTheme.colors.$blueBtn} />
+        <Text style={[styles.ToolBarBtText, (state.DropDownModalSelectIndex === 1 && { color: '#007AFF' })]}>
+          {state.selected_Data_record_sharing_list_clinics_Doctor ? state.selected_Data_record_sharing_list_clinics_Doctor?.doctorCode : global.i18n.t('DoctorCode')}
+        </Text>
+        {state.DropDownModalSelectIndex !== 1 ? renderArrowDown() : renderArrowUp()}
+      </TouchableOpacity>
+      <TouchableOpacity style={styles.ToolBarBt} onPress={() => {
+        if (state.DropDownModalSelectIndex !== 2) {
+          setState((prevState) => {
+            return {
+              ...prevState,
+              showDropDownModal: true, DropDownModalSelectIndex: 2
+            }
+          })
+        } else {
+          setState((prevState) => {
+            return {
+              ...prevState,
+              showDropDownModal: false, DropDownModalSelectIndex: -1
+            }
+          })
+        }
+      }}>
+        <PatientData width={20} height={20} color={state.DropDownModalSelectIndex !== 2 ? uiTheme.colors.$grayText : uiTheme.colors.$blueBtn} />
+        <Text style={[styles.ToolBarBtText, (state.DropDownModalSelectIndex === 2 && { color: '#007AFF' })]}>
+          {state.selectedPatient ? state.selectedPatient?.enName : global.i18n.t('PatientData')}
+        </Text>
+        {state.DropDownModalSelectIndex !== 2 ? renderArrowDown() : renderArrowUp()}
+      </TouchableOpacity>
+      <TouchableOpacity style={styles.ToolBarBt} onPress={() => {
+        if (state.DropDownModalSelectIndex !== 3) {
+          setState((prevState) => {
+            return {
+              ...prevState,
+              showDropDownModal: true, DropDownModalSelectIndex: 3
+            }
+          })
+        } else {
+          setState((prevState) => {
+            return {
+              ...prevState,
+              showDropDownModal: false, DropDownModalSelectIndex: -1
+            }
+          })
+        }
+      }}>
+        <Date width={20} height={20} color={state.DropDownModalSelectIndex !== 3 ? uiTheme.colors.$grayText : uiTheme.colors.$blueBtn}></Date>
+        <Text style={[styles.ToolBarBtText, (state.DropDownModalSelectIndex === 3 && {color: '#007AFF'})]}>{global.i18n.t('date')}</Text>
+        {state.DropDownModalSelectIndex !== 3 ? renderArrowDown() : renderArrowUp()}
+      </TouchableOpacity>
+    </ScrollView>
+    </View>
+  }
+  const updateState = (key: string, value: number) => {
+    console.log('updateState key=', key, ' value=', value);
+    setState(prevState => ({
+      ...prevState,
+      [key]: value,
+    }));
+  };
+  const renderCsxMobileHeader = () => {
+    return <CsxMobileHeader style={styles.header} backBtText={global.i18n.t('Mine')}
+                            title={global.i18n.t('DataSharingRecord')} navigation={navigation} rightBtText={''}
+    />
+  }
+  //render
+  return (
+    <ThemeContext.Consumer>
+      {(theme: Theme) => {
+        return (
+          <SafeView>
+            <View style={[styles.pageContainer, {paddingHorizontal: 0}]}>
+              {renderCsxMobileHeader()}
+              {renderToolBar()}
+              {/*{renderTopBar(theme)}*/}
+              {renderList()}
+              {render_eHealth_model()}
+              {render_DoctorCode_model()}
+              {render_startDateModal()}
+              {render_endDateModal()}
+              <DropDownModal updateState={updateState}
+                showDropDownModal={state.showDropDownModal}
+                renderCsxMobileHeader={renderCsxMobileHeader}
+                renderToolBar={renderToolBar}
+                refCsxFlatList={refCsxFlatList}
+                DropDownModalSelectIndex={state.DropDownModalSelectIndex}
+                data_record_sharing_list_clinics={state.data_record_sharing_list_clinics}
+                cur_data_record_sharing_list_clinics={state.cur_data_record_sharing_list_clinics}
+                selected_Data_record_sharing_list_clinics_Doctor={state.selected_Data_record_sharing_list_clinics_Doctor}
+                selectedPatient={state.selectedPatient}
+                ref_startDate={ref_startDate}
+                ref_endDate={ref_endDate}
+              ></DropDownModal>
+            </View>
+          </SafeView>
+        );
+      }}
+    </ThemeContext.Consumer>
+  )
 }

+  // Helper function to generate safe filename for Android
+  const generateSafeFileNameForAndroid = (file) => {
+    let fileName = '';
+
+    // First try to use the name property from DocumentPicker
+    if (file.name && file.name.trim() !== '') {
+      fileName = file.name;
+    } else {
+      // Fallback: generate filename based on type and timestamp
+      const timestamp = Date.now();
+      if (file.type) {
+        if (file.type.includes('pdf')) {
+          fileName = `document_${timestamp}.pdf`;
+        } else if (file.type.includes('image')) {
+          const imageExt = file.type.split('/')[1] || 'jpg';
+          fileName = `image_${timestamp}.${imageExt}`;
+        } else {
+          // Try to get extension from MIME type
+          const mimeToExt = {
+            'application/pdf': 'pdf',
+            'image/jpeg': 'jpg',
+            'image/jpg': 'jpg',
+            'image/png': 'png',
+            'application/msword': 'doc',
+            'application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document': 'docx',
+            'application/vnd.ms-excel': 'xls',
+            'application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet': 'xlsx'
+          };
+          const ext = mimeToExt[file.type] || 'bin';
+          fileName = `file_${timestamp}.${ext}`;
+        }
+      } else {
+        fileName = `file_${timestamp}.bin`;
+      }
+    }
+
+    // Sanitize filename - remove invalid characters for file systems
+    fileName = fileName.replace(/[\/\\?%*:|"<>]/g, '_');
+    // Ensure filename is not empty and has reasonable length
+    if (fileName.length === 0) {
+      fileName = `file_${Date.now()}.bin`;
+    } else if (fileName.length > 255) {
+      const ext = fileName.split('.').pop();
+      const nameWithoutExt = fileName.substring(0, fileName.lastIndexOf('.'));
+      fileName = nameWithoutExt.substring(0, 250 - ext.length) + '.' + ext;
+    }
+
+    return fileName;

+import React, { useEffect, useRef, useState, useMemo, memo, useCallback, forwardRef } from 'react'
+import {
+  Image,
+  View,
+  Text,
+  TouchableOpacity,
+  FlatList,
+  Dimensions,
+} from 'react-native'
+import { useCommonAlertModal } from 'components/CommonAlertModal/CommonAlertModalContext'
+import { pageProps } from 'csxRoutes/csxRouter'
+import { SafeView } from 'components'
+import tool from 'tools/tool'
+import styles from "./ManageCalendarPage.styles";
+import CsxMobileHeader from "components/csxMobileHeader/CsxMobileHeader";
+import { ThemeContext } from "components/theme/theme-context";
+import type { Theme } from "types/Theme";
+import { useThemeProvider } from "components/theme/theme-provider";
+import { useCalendarEvents } from 'useHooks/useCalendarEvents';
+import { useAccount } from 'useHooks/useAccount';
+import commonModalStyle from "components/commonModal/CommonModal.styles";
+import CommonModal from "components/commonModal/CommonModal";
+
+const { width } = Dimensions.get('window');
+
+/**
+ * 日历事件管理页面
+ * @param props
+ * @param parentRef
+ * @returns {*}
+ * @constructor
+ */
+const ManageCalendarPage: React.FC<pageProps> = (props: pageProps, parentRef) => {
+  const { navigation, scene, route } = props
+  const {
+    showCommonAlertModal, setShowCommonAlertModal, commonAlertModalTitle, setCommonAlertModalTitle, commonAlertModalContent,
+    setCommonAlertModalContent, setCommonAlertModalCancelTxt, setCommonAlertModalConfirmTxt, refOnConfirm
+  } = useCommonAlertModal();
+  const { mode, uiTheme, setMode } = useThemeProvider();
+  const {
+    syncEvents,
+    fetchCalendarEvents,
+    removeAllEvents,
+    removeExpiredEvents,
+    checkPermission,
+    currentUserId,
+  } = useCalendarEvents();
+
+  const [events, setEvents] = useState<any[]>([]);
+  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
+  const curAccount = useAccount(); // 使用 useAccount 获取当前账户信息
+  const userId = curAccount && `${curAccount?.username}-${curAccount?.InstallationID}`; // 组合用户名和安装ID作为用户标识
+  const [groupedEvents, setGroupedEvents] = useState<{ [date: string]: any[] }>({});
+  const [expandedDates, setExpandedDates] = useState<{ [date: string]: boolean }>({});
+
+  // ✅ 添加删除 Modal 状态
+  const [showDeleteModal, setShowDeleteModal] = useState(false);
+
+  // 添加分组函数
+  const groupEventsByDate = useCallback((eventList: any[]) => {
+    const groups: { [date: string]: any[] } = {};
+    eventList.forEach(event => {
+      const dateKey = new Date(event.startDate).toDateString();
+      if (!groups[dateKey]) {
+        groups[dateKey] = [];
+      }
+      groups[dateKey].push(event);
+    });
+    return groups;
+  }, []);
+
+  // 展开/收起切换函数
+  const toggleDateGroup = useCallback((date: string) => {
+    setExpandedDates(prev => {
+      if (prev[date]) {
+        return {};
+      }
+      return { [date]: true };
+    });
+  }, []);
+
+  const loadEvents = async () => {
+    setLoading(true);
+    try {
+      const startDate = new Date();
+      startDate.setFullYear(startDate.getFullYear() - 2);
+
+      const endDate = new Date();
+      endDate.setMonth(endDate.getMonth() + 1);
+
+      const calendarEvents = await fetchCalendarEvents(startDate, endDate);
+      const grouped = groupEventsByDate(calendarEvents);
+      setGroupedEvents(grouped);
+      setEvents(calendarEvents);
+    } catch (error) {
+      console.error('Failed to load events:', error);
+    } finally {
+      setLoading(false);
+    }
+  };
+
+  const handleRemoveAll = async () => {
+    const success = await removeAllEvents();
+    if (success) {
+      setEvents([]);
+      loadEvents();
+      setShowDeleteModal(false);
+    }
+  };
+
+  const handleRemoveExpired = async () => {
+    const success = await removeExpiredEvents();
+    if (success) {
+      loadEvents();
+      setShowDeleteModal(false);
+    }
+  };
+
+  // 组件挂载时加载事件
+  useEffect(() => {
+    if (!userId) {
+      return;
+    }
+    loadEvents();
+  }, [userId]);
+
+  // ✅ 关闭删除 Modal
+  const handleCloseDeleteModal = useCallback(() => {
+    setShowDeleteModal(false);
+  }, []);
+
+  const renderRightBt = useCallback(
+    () => {
+      return (
+        <TouchableOpacity
+          style={styles.deleteBtn}
+          onPress={() => setShowDeleteModal(true)}
+        >
+          <Text style={styles.deleteText}>{global.i18n.t('Delete')}</Text>
+        </TouchableOpacity>
+      )
+    },
+    [],
+  );
+
+  return (
+    <ThemeContext.Consumer>
+      {(theme: Theme) => {
+        return (
+          <SafeView>
+            <View style={styles.pageContainer}>
+              <CsxMobileHeader
+                style={styles.headerStyle}
+                title={global.i18n.t('manage_calendar_schedule')}
+                navigation={navigation}
+                rightBt={renderRightBt()}
+              />
+
+              {/* 显示事件列表 */}
+              <FlatList
+                style={{ flex: 1 }}
+                contentContainerStyle={{ paddingBottom: 20 }}
+                data={Object.keys(groupedEvents)}
+                keyExtractor={(date) => date}
+                ListEmptyComponent={() => (
+                  <View style={{ padding: 20, alignItems: 'center' }}>
+                    <Text>暂无日历事件</Text>
+                  </View>
+                )}
+                renderItem={({ item: date }) => {
+                  const isExpanded = expandedDates[date] || false;
+                  const eventsForDate = groupedEvents[date] || [];
+
+                  const formatTime = (dateString: string) => {
+                    return new Date(dateString).toLocaleTimeString('zh-CN', {
+                      hour: '2-digit',
+                      minute: '2-digit',
+                      hour12: false
+                    });
+                  };
+
+                  return (
+                    <View key={date} style={{
+                      backgroundColor: isExpanded ? '#FFFFFF' : '#f0f0f0',
+                      paddingHorizontal: 16,
+                      paddingTop: isExpanded ? 10 : 0,
+                    }}>
+                      <TouchableOpacity
+                        activeOpacity={0.7}
+                        style={[styles.dateTitleView, {
+                          borderBottomWidth: isExpanded ? 1 : 0
+                        }]}
+                        onPress={() => toggleDateGroup(date)}
+                      >
+                        <Text style={[styles.dateTitle, isExpanded && { color: 'red' }]}>
+                          {new Date(date).toLocaleDateString()}
+                        </Text>
+                        <Text>{isExpanded ? '收起' : '展开'} ({eventsForDate.length})</Text>
+                      </TouchableOpacity>
+
+                      {isExpanded && eventsForDate.map((event, index) => (
+                        <View
+                          key={event.id}
+                          style={{
+                            width: '100%',
+                            flexDirection: 'row',
+                            paddingVertical: 10,
+                            minHeight: 60,
+                            borderBottomWidth: index < eventsForDate.length - 1 ? 1 : 0,
+                            borderBottomColor: '#ccc'
+                          }}
+                        >
+                          <View style={{ width: 8, height: 40, borderRadius: 4, backgroundColor: '#3A93F7' }} />
+                          <View style={{ flex: 1, marginLeft: 8 }}>
+                            <Text>{event.title}</Text>
+                            <Text>建议位置：{event.location}</Text>
+                          </View>
+
+                          <View style={{ maxWidth: 60 }}>
+                            <Text>{formatTime(event.startDate)}</Text>
+                            <Text>{formatTime(event.endDate)}</Text>
+                          </View>
+                        </View>
+                      ))}
+                    </View>
+                  );
+                }}
+              />
+
+              {/* ✅ 删除 Modal - 样式与 LanguageModal 保持一致 */}
+              {showDeleteModal && (
+                <CommonModal
+                  visible={showDeleteModal}
+                  slide={true}
+                  onClose={handleCloseDeleteModal}
+                  modalOverlayStyle={[commonModalStyle.blackModalOverlay, { top: 0 }]}
+                  outSafeAreaTopStyle={{
+                    flex: 0,
+                    backgroundColor: 'rgba(0,0,0,0.6)',
+                  }}
+                >
+                  <View style={[commonModalStyle.modalViewStyle, {
+                    minHeight: '20%',
+                    width: width,
+                    alignItems: 'center',
+                    backgroundColor: 'transparent',
+                    maxHeight: 'auto',
+                  }]}>
+                    {/* 选项列表 - 使用 deleteModalStyles 保持与 LanguageModal 一致 */}
+                    <View style={[styles.modalViewStyle, theme.mode === 'dark' && styles.modalView_backgroundColor_dark]}>
+                      <Text style={[styles.modalTitle, theme.mode === 'dark' && styles.modalTitle_dark]}>
+                        {global.i18n.t('delete_calendar_events')}
+                      </Text>
+
+                      {/* 仅删除过期日程 */}
+                      <TouchableOpacity
+                        style={styles.modalViewRow}
+                        onPress={handleRemoveExpired}
+                      >
+                        <Text style={styles.modalViewText} numberOfLines={1}>
+                          {global.i18n.t('delete_expired_only')}
+                        </Text>
+                      </TouchableOpacity>
+
+                      {/* 删除所有同步日程 */}
+                      <TouchableOpacity
+                        style={styles.modalViewRow}
+                        onPress={handleRemoveAll}
+                      >
+                        <Text style={[styles.modalViewText, styles.deleteAllText]} numberOfLines={1}>
+                          {global.i18n.t('delete_all_events')}
+                        </Text>
+                      </TouchableOpacity>
+                    </View>
+
+                    {/* 取消按钮 */}
+                    <TouchableOpacity
+                      style={[styles.modalViewRow1, (theme.mode === 'dark' && styles.modalView_backgroundColor_dark)]}
+                      onPress={handleCloseDeleteModal}
+                    >
+                      <Text style={[styles.modalViewText, { color: 'rgba(0, 122, 255, 1)', fontWeight: '700' }]}
+                        numberOfLines={1}>
+                        {global.i18n.t('cancel')}
+                      </Text>
+                    </TouchableOpacity>
+                  </View>
+                </CommonModal>
+              )}
+            </View>
+          </SafeView>
+        );
+      }}
+    </ThemeContext.Consumer>
+  )
+}
+const ManageCalendarPageComp = memo(forwardRef(ManageCalendarPage));
+export default ManageCalendarPageComp;

+import React, {useEffect, useState, memo, forwardRef} from 'react';
+import {View, TouchableOpacity, ActivityIndicator, Platform, Alert, Text, Linking, NativeModules} from 'react-native';
+import {ThemeContext} from 'components/theme/theme-context';
+import type {Theme} from 'types/Theme';
+import {SafeView} from 'components';
+import CsxMobileHeader from 'components/csxMobileHeader/CsxMobileHeader';
+import Pdf from 'react-native-pdf';
+import * as RNFS from 'react-native-fs';
+import Share from 'react-native-share';
+import FileViewer from 'react-native-file-viewer';
+import dayjs from 'dayjs';
+import {Props} from './PDFScreen.props';
+import styles from './PDFScreen.styles';
+import {Download} from 'assets/svg/index';
+
+interface StateProps {
+  loading: boolean;
+  error: string | null;
+  saving: boolean;
+}
+
+/**
+ * PDF Screen - Enhanced version with ECG PDF support
+ * Compatible with both web PDFs and locally generated ECG PDFs
+ *
+ * Usage Scenarios:
+ * 1. ECG PDF Flow (Current Implementation):
+ *    - PDF is generated and saved to Downloads by ECGPDFGenerator service
+ *    - Native PDFDownloadModule handles saving with automatic overwrite
+ *    - alreadySavedToDownloads flag is true
+ *    - User can open, share, or access the PDF from Downloads
+ *
+ * 2. Generic PDF Flow (Future Support):
+ *    - PDF loaded from web or other sources
+ *    - alreadySavedToDownloads flag is false
+ *    - User can save/share PDF using Share API
+ *
+ * Note: Due to Android Scoped Storage restrictions (Android 10+),
+ * apps cannot directly access Downloads folder paths. The component
+ * uses app-accessible source paths for viewing while maintaining
+ * copies in Downloads for user access.
+ */
+const PDFScreen: React.FC<Props> = (props: Props) => {
+  console.log('PDFScreen props=', props);
+  const {navigation, route} = props;
+  const {title, source, local, saveToDevice, filePath, alreadySavedToDownloads} = route?.params?.pageData ?? {};
+
+  const [state, setState] = useState<StateProps>({
+    loading: !local,
+    error: null,
+    saving: false,
+  });
+
+  useEffect(() => {
+    console.log('PDFScreen componentDidMount');
+    console.log('PDFScreen source:', source);
+
+    return () => {
+      console.log('PDFScreen componentWillUnmount');
+    };
+  }, [source]);
+
+  const handleLoadProgress = (progress: number) => {
+    console.log(`PDFScreen Loading: ${progress * 100}%`);
+  };
+
+  const handleLoadComplete = (numberOfPages: number, filePath: string) => {
+    console.log(`PDF loaded successfully. Number of pages: ${numberOfPages}, File path: ${filePath}`);
+    setState(prev => ({...prev, loading: false, error: null}));
+  };
+
+  const handleError = (error: any) => {
+    console.error('PDFScreen Error loading PDF:', error);
+    setState(prev => ({...prev, loading: false, error: 'Failed to load PDF'}));
+  };
+
+  const handlePageChanged = (page: number, totalPages: number) => {
+    console.log(`PDFScreen Page ${page} of ${totalPages}`);
+  };
+
+  const savePDFToDevice = async () => {
+    try {
+      if (!filePath) {
+        Alert.alert(global.i18n.t('Error'), 'No PDF file to save');
+        return;
+      }
+
+      // Extract filename from filePath for better UX
+      const fileName = filePath.split('/').pop() || 'ECG_Report.pdf';
+
+      setState(prev => ({...prev, saving: true}));
+      console.log('Starting PDF save process for file:', filePath);
+
+      const timestamp = dayjs().format('YYYY-MM-DD_HH-mm-ss');
+      const suggestedFileName = fileName.includes('ECG_') ? fileName : `ECG_Report_${timestamp}.pdf`;
+
+      if (Platform.OS === 'ios') {
+        // iOS: Use Share functionality for better user experience
+        await savePDFToiOS(filePath, title || suggestedFileName);
+      } else {
+        // Android: Use DocumentPicker to let user choose save location
+        await savePDFToAndroid(filePath, title || suggestedFileName);
+      }
+
+    } catch (error) {
+      console.error('Save PDF failed:', error);
+      setState(prev => ({...prev, saving: false}));
+
+      if (error instanceof Error && error.message.includes('cancelled')) {
+        // User cancelled the operation, no need to show error
+        console.log('User cancelled PDF save operation');
+        return;
+      }
+
+      Alert.alert(
+        global.i18n.t('Error'),
+        `Failed to save PDF: ${error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'Unknown error'}`
+      );
+    }
+  };
+
+  const savePDFToiOS = async (sourceFilePath: string, fileName: string) => {
+    try {
+      console.log('iOS: Starting PDF save process');
+
+      // Method 1: Try using React Native Share for better UX
+      const shareResult = await Share.open({
+        url: `file://${sourceFilePath}`,
+        type: 'application/pdf',
+        title: 'Save ECG PDF Report',
+        subject: 'ECG PDF Report',
+        filename: fileName,
+        saveToFiles: true, // This allows saving to Files app
+        showAppsToView: true,
+      });
+
+      console.log('iOS: Share result:', shareResult);
+
+      setState(prev => ({...prev, saving: false}));
+
+      if (shareResult.success) {
+        Alert.alert(
+          global.i18n.t('Success'),
+          'PDF saved successfully! You can find it in your Files app.',
+          [
+            {
+              text: 'Open Files App',
+              onPress: () => {
+                // Open Files app
+                Linking.openURL('shareddocuments://').catch(() => {
+                  console.log('Could not open Files app');
+                });
+              }
+            },
+            {text: 'OK', style: 'default'}
+          ]
+        );
+      }
+
+    } catch (error) {
+      console.error('iOS save failed:', error);
+
+      // Fallback: Try copying to Documents directory and open with FileViewer
+      try {
+        console.log('iOS: Trying fallback method - copy to Documents');
+        const documentsPath = RNFS.DocumentDirectoryPath;
+        const destinationPath = `${documentsPath}/${fileName}`;
+
+        await RNFS.copyFile(sourceFilePath, destinationPath);
+        console.log('iOS: File copied to Documents:', destinationPath);
+
+        // Try to open with FileViewer
+        await FileViewer.open(destinationPath, {
+          displayName: fileName,
+          showOpenWithDialog: true,
+          showAppsSuggestions: true,
+        });
+
+        setState(prev => ({...prev, saving: false}));
+
+        Alert.alert(
+          global.i18n.t('Success'),
+          'PDF saved to Documents folder and opened for preview.'
+        );
+
+      } catch (fallbackError) {
+        console.error('iOS fallback save failed:', fallbackError);
+        throw fallbackError;
+      }
+    }
+  };
+
+  const savePDFToAndroid = async (sourceFilePath: string, fileName: string) => {
+    try {
+      console.log('Android: Opening PDF with FileViewer');
+      console.log('Source path:', sourceFilePath);
+      console.log('File name:', fileName);
+      
+      setState(prev => ({...prev, saving: true}));
+      
+      // Ensure the file exists before trying to open
+      const fileExists = await RNFS.exists(sourceFilePath);
+      if (!fileExists) {
+        throw new Error('PDF file not found at specified path');
+      }
+      
+      // FileViewer.open works on all Android versions (API 16+)
+      // It will:
+      // 1. On Android 4.1-6.0: Use Intent.ACTION_VIEW with file:// URI
+      // 2. On Android 7.0-9.0: Use FileProvider with content:// URI
+      // 3. On Android 10+: Handle Scoped Storage restrictions automatically
+      await FileViewer.open(sourceFilePath, {
+        displayName: fileName,
+        showOpenWithDialog: true, // Shows app chooser if multiple PDF viewers
+        showAppsSuggestions: true, // Suggests compatible apps from Play Store
+      });
+      
+      console.log('PDF opened successfully with FileViewer');
+      setState(prev => ({...prev, saving: false}));
+      
+    } catch (error) {
+      console.error('Failed to open PDF:', error);
+      setState(prev => ({...prev, saving: false}));
+
+      if (error instanceof Error) {
+        if (error.message.includes('cancelled')) {
+          // User cancelled the operation - no need to show error
+          console.log('User cancelled PDF operation');
+          return;
+        }
+        
+        if (error.message.includes('No app found') || error.message.includes('No application')) {
+          // No PDF viewer installed
+          Alert.alert(
+            global.i18n.t('Error'),
+            'No PDF viewer app found. Please install a PDF viewer from Play Store.',
+            [
+              {
+                text: 'Open Play Store',
+                onPress: () => {
+                  // Open Play Store to search for PDF viewers
+                  Linking.openURL('market://search?q=pdf+viewer&c=apps');
+                }
+              },
+              {text: 'Cancel', style: 'cancel'}
+            ]
+          );
+          return;
+        }
+      }
+
+      // Generic error handling
+      Alert.alert(
+        global.i18n.t('Error'),
+        `Failed to open PDF: ${error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'Unknown error'}`,
+        [{text: 'OK', style: 'default'}]
+      );
+    }
+  };
+
+  const openAndroidFileManager = async () => {
+    try {
+      // Use native module for Android to directly open Downloads folder
+      if (Platform.OS === 'android' && NativeModules.PDFDownloadModule) {
+        console.log('Using native module to open Downloads folder');
+        const result = await NativeModules.PDFDownloadModule.openDownloadsFolder();
+        console.log('Native module opened Downloads folder successfully');
+      } else {
+        // iOS or fallback behavior
+        console.log('Native module not available, using fallback');
+
+        // Fallback: Try to use Linking to open file manager
+        const tryOpenIntent = async (intent: string) => {
+          try {
+            const supported = await Linking.canOpenURL(intent);
+            if (supported) {
+              await Linking.openURL(intent);
+              return true;
+            }
+          } catch (error) {
+            console.log(`Failed to open intent ${intent}:`, error);
+          }
+          return false;
+        };
+
+        // Try different file manager intents
+        const intents = [
+          'content://com.android.externalstorage.documents/tree/primary%3ADownload',
+          'file:///storage/emulated/0/Download',
+        ];
+
+        let opened = false;
+        for (const intent of intents) {
+          if (await tryOpenIntent(intent)) {
+            opened = true;
+            break;
+          }
+        }
+
+        if (!opened) {
+          Alert.alert(
+            'Open File Manager',
+            'Please open your file manager app and navigate to the Downloads folder to find your PDF files.',
+            [{text: 'OK', style: 'default'}]
+          );
+        }
+      }
+    } catch (error) {
+      console.error('Failed to open Downloads folder:', error);
+      Alert.alert(
+        global.i18n.t('Error'),
+        'Failed to open Downloads folder. Please open your file manager manually.',
+        [{text: 'OK', style: 'default'}]
+      );
+    }
+  };
+
+  // Construct proper PDF source
+  const getPdfSource = () => {
+    if (source) {
+      return source;
+    }
+
+    if (!filePath) {
+      return null;
+    }
+
+    // Check if it's an absolute path
+    if (filePath.startsWith('/')) {
+      // Absolute path - use as is
+      console.log('Using absolute path:', filePath);
+      return {uri: `file://${filePath}`, cache: true};
+    }
+
+    // Relative path - try to construct full path
+    // If it starts with "Download/" or "Downloads/", it's likely meant to be in system Downloads
+    if (filePath.startsWith('Download/') || filePath.startsWith('Downloads/')) {
+      const fileName = filePath.split('/').pop();
+      const fullPath = `/storage/emulated/0/Download/${fileName}`;
+      console.log('Constructing full Downloads path:', fullPath);
+
+      // First try the constructed Downloads path
+      return {uri: `file://${fullPath}`, cache: true};
+    }
+
+    // Otherwise, assume it's a relative path that needs file:// prefix
+    console.log('Using relative path with file:// prefix:', filePath);
+    return {uri: `file://${filePath}`, cache: true};
+  };
+
+  const pdfSource = getPdfSource();
+  console.log('pdfSource=',pdfSource)
+  return (
+    <ThemeContext.Consumer>
+      {(theme: Theme) => {
+        return (
+          <SafeView>
+            <View style={[styles.pageContainer, {paddingHorizontal: 0,}]}>
+              <CsxMobileHeader
+                title={title || 'PDF Report'}
+                navigation={navigation}
+                // rightBtText={saveToDevice ? global.i18n.t('save') : ''}
+                // onRightPress={saveToDevice ? savePDFToDevice : undefined}
+              />
+
+              {state.error ? (
+                <View style={styles.errorContainer}>
+                  <Text style={styles.errorText}>
+                    {state.error}
+                  </Text>
+                </View>
+              ) : pdfSource ? (
+                <Pdf
+                  style={styles.pdf}
+                  source={pdfSource}
+                  onLoadProgress={handleLoadProgress}
+                  onLoadComplete={handleLoadComplete}
+                  onError={handleError}
+                  onPageChanged={handlePageChanged}
+                  trustAllCerts={false}
+                  enablePaging={true}
+                  spacing={0}
+                  minScale={1}
+                  maxScale={3.0}
+                  scale={1}
+                  horizontal={false}
+                  enableDoubleTapZoom={true}
+                  fitPolicy={0}
+                  enableAntialiasing={true}
+                  enableAnnotationRendering={false}
+                />
+              ) : (
+                <View style={styles.loadingContainer}>
+                  <ActivityIndicator size="large" color={theme.uiTheme.colors.$blue} />
+                  <Text style={styles.loadingText}>
+                    Loading PDF...
+                  </Text>
+                </View>
+              )}
+
+              {/*{state.loading && (*/}
+              {/*  <View style={styles.loadingContainer}>*/}
+              {/*    <ActivityIndicator size="large" color={theme.uiTheme.colors.$blue} />*/}
+              {/*    <Text style={styles.loadingText}>Loading PDF...</Text>*/}
+              {/*  </View>*/}
+              {/*)}*/}
+
+              {
+                saveToDevice &&
+                <View style={styles.saveButtonRow}>
+                  <TouchableOpacity
+                    style={[styles.saveButton, state.saving && styles.saveButtonDisabled]}
+                    onPress={savePDFToDevice}
+                    disabled={state.saving}
+                  >
+                    {state.saving ? (
+                      <ActivityIndicator size="small" color="rgba(255, 255, 255, 1)" />
+                    ) : (
+                      Download({color: 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 1)'})
+                    )}
+                    <Text style={styles.saveButtonText}>
+                      {state.saving
+                        ? `${global.i18n.t('Saving')}...`
+                        : `${global.i18n.t('save')} ${global.i18n.t('electrocardiogram')} ECG ${global.i18n.t('upload_document')} (PDF)`
+                      }
+                    </Text>
+                  </TouchableOpacity>
+                </View>
+              }
+            </View>
+          </SafeView>
+        );
+      }}
+    </ThemeContext.Consumer>
+  );
+};

+          {/* Mask layer with transparent scanning area */}
+          <View style={styles.maskContainer} pointerEvents="none">
+            <View style={styles.maskRow} />
+            <View style={styles.maskCenter}>
+              <View style={styles.maskSide} />
+              <View style={{width: 240, height: 240}} />
+              <View style={styles.maskSide} />
+            </View>
+            <View style={styles.maskRow} />
+          </View>
+
+          {/* Scanning frame with white border */}
+          <View style={styles.overlayContainer} pointerEvents="none">
+            <View style={styles.scanningFrameContainer}>
+              <View style={styles.scanningFrame}>
+              </View>
+            </View>
+            <Text style={styles.instructionText}>
+              {global.i18n.t('Scan the QR code displayed on CSX to log in')}
+            </Text>
+          </View>
+        </>
+      );
+    };
+
+    // Render camera not authorized view
+    const renderNotAuthorizedView = () => {
+      return (
+        <View style={styles.centerContainer}>
+          <Text style={styles.notAuthorizedText}>
+            camera_not_authorized
+          </Text>
+          <Text style={styles.notAuthorizedSubText}>
+            please_grant_camera_permission
+          </Text>
+        </View>
+      );
+    };
+
+    // Render loading view while initializing
+    const renderLoadingView = () => {
+      return (
+        <View style={styles.centerContainer}>
+          <ActivityIndicator size="large" color="#FFF" />
+        </View>
+      );
+    };
+
+    // Render camera view
+    const renderCameraView = () => {
+      if (!device) {
+        return (
+          <View style={styles.centerContainer}>
+            <Text style={styles.notAuthorizedText}>
+              no_camera_device_found
+            </Text>
+          </View>
+        );
+      }
+      console.log('renderCameraView state.isActive=', state.isActive, ` state.zoom=`, state.zoom)
+      return (
+        <View style={styles.container}>
+          <Camera
+            ref={cameraRef}
+            style={styles.cameraStyle}
+            device={device}
+            isActive={state.isActive}
+            codeScanner={codeScanner}
+            // Basic zoom support
+            zoom={state.zoom}
+            enableZoomGesture={true}
+            // Torch control
+            torch={state.torchOn ? 'on' : 'off'}
+            // Enable photo and video capture
+            photo={true}
+            video={true}
+            onError={(error) => {
+              console.error('Camera error:', error);
+            }}
+            onInitialized={handleCameraInitialized}
+          />
+          {renderScanningOverlay()}
+        </View>
+      );
+    };
+
+    return (
+      <ThemeContext.Consumer>
+        {(theme: Theme) => {
+          return (
+            <>
+              {!state.isInitialized ? (
+                renderLoadingView()
+              ) : state.hasPermission ? (
+                renderCameraView()
+              ) : (
+                renderNotAuthorizedView()
+              )}
+              {renderNavigationBar()}
+            </>
+          );
+        }}
+      </ThemeContext.Consumer>
+    );
+  })
+);
+
+export default ScanQRCodeLoginScreen;

+const MedicationNotesCustomRow: React.FC<RNAutoPositionedPopupCustomRowProps> = memo(({
+                                                                                  children,
+                                                                                  selectedItem,
+                                                                                  selectList,
+                                                                                  onAdded,
+                                                                                  clearSelectedItem
+                                                                                }: RNAutoPositionedPopupCustomRowProps) => {
+  const {uiTheme} = useThemeProvider();
+  const [searchQuery, setSearchQuery] = useState<string>('');
+  const emitEvent = useGlobalEventEmitter();
+  useGlobalEventListener(
+    AutoPositionedPopupEventNames.searchQueryChange,
+    useCallback(({tag, searchQuery: newQuery}: { tag: string; searchQuery: string }): void => {
+      console.log('MedicationNotesCustomRow searchQueryChange event received=', {tag, searchQuery: newQuery});
+      if (tag === i18n.t('Medication_notes')) {
+        setSearchQuery(newQuery);
+      }
+    }, [])
+  );
+  const handleAddPress = useCallback((): void => {
+    console.log('MedicationNotesCustomRow handleAddPress=', {searchQuery, selectedItem,selectList})
+    if (searchQuery === '' && !selectedItem) {
+      return;
+    }
+    const textToAdd: string | undefined = searchQuery || selectedItem?.title;
+    console.log('MedicationNotesCustomRow textToAdd=', textToAdd)
+    if (textToAdd && selectList && selectList.indexOf(textToAdd) === -1) {
+      onAdded && onAdded(textToAdd);
+      setSearchQuery(''); // Clear local search query after adding
+      clearSelectedItem && clearSelectedItem();
+      emitEvent(AutoPositionedPopupEventNames.searchQueryChange, {
+        tag: i18n.t('Medication_notes'),
+        searchQuery: ''
+      })
+    }
+  }, [searchQuery, selectedItem, selectList, onAdded, clearSelectedItem]);
+  const disabled = useMemo(() => {
+    return searchQuery === '' && !selectedItem
+  }, [searchQuery, selectedItem]);
+  return (
+    <View style={[styles.CustomRow]}>
+      {children}
+      <ArrowUpDown />
+      <TouchableOpacity
+        disabled={disabled}
+        style={[
+          styles.medicationNotesInputRowAddBt,
+          disabled && {backgroundColor: uiTheme.colors.$disabledBtn}
+        ]}
+        onPress={handleAddPress}
+      >
+        <Text style={[
+          styles.medicationNotesInputRowAddBtText,
+          disabled && {color: uiTheme.colors.$disabledBtnText}
+        ]}>
+          + {global.i18n.t('join')}
+        </Text>
+      </TouchableOpacity>
+    </View>
+  );
+});

+// ECG PDF Generator Service
+
+import RNHTMLtoPDF from 'react-native-html-to-pdf';
+import * as RNFS from 'react-native-fs';
+import {Platform, PermissionsAndroid, NativeModules} from 'react-native';
+import dayjs from "dayjs";
+import {
+  LinktopHealthDataDetail,
+  ElectrocardiogramData,
+  ECGPDFConfig,
+  PatientInfo,
+  PDFGenerationOptions,
+  PDFGenerationResult
+} from './types';
+import {generateECGPDFTemplate} from './templateGenerator';
+
+/**
+ * Main ECG PDF Generator Service
+ */
+export class ECGPDFGenerator {
+  private static defaultConfig: ECGPDFConfig = {
+    paperSpeed: 25, // mm/s
+    gain: 10, // mm/mV
+    sampleRate: 512, // Hz
+    lead: 'Lead I',
+    deviceName: `CDV ${global.i18n.t('Health')} ${global.i18n.t('Monitor')}`,
+    duration: 30 // Will be calculated from data
+  };
+
+  /**
+   * Generate ECG PDF from LinktopHealthDataDetail or electrocardiogram data
+   * @param data - ECG measurement data
+   * @param patientInfo - Patient information
+   * @param customConfig - Custom ECG configuration
+   * @param pdfOptions - PDF generation options
+   * @returns Promise with generation result
+   */
+  static async generateECGPDF(
+    data: ElectrocardiogramData,
+    patientInfo: Partial<PatientInfo>,
+    customConfig?: Partial<ECGPDFConfig>,
+    pdfOptions?: Partial<PDFGenerationOptions>
+  ): Promise<PDFGenerationResult> {
+    try {
+      console.log('Starting ECG PDF generation...', {electrocardiogram: 'direct_data'});
+
+      // Use direct ElectrocardiogramData format
+      const ecgData = data;
+
+      // Validate waveData
+      if (!ecgData.waveData || ecgData.waveData.length === 0) {
+        throw new Error('Invalid ECG data: waveData is empty or missing');
+      }
+
+      // Calculate duration from wave data
+      const calculatedDuration = Math.floor(ecgData.waveData.length / this.defaultConfig.sampleRate);
+
+      // Merge configurations
+      const config: ECGPDFConfig = {
+        ...this.defaultConfig,
+        ...customConfig,
+        duration: calculatedDuration
+      };
+
+      // Set responsive PDF dimensions based on device type
+      const responsivePDFOptions: PDFGenerationOptions = global.isTablet ? {
+        width: 297, // A4 width for tablet (297mm)
+        height: 420, // A4 height for tablet (420mm)
+        format: 'A4' as 'A4' | 'Letter',
+        quality: 100
+      } : {
+        width: 190, // Optimized mobile width for better fit
+        height: 270, // Optimized mobile height for better fit
+        format: 'A4' as 'A4' | 'Letter',
+        quality: 95
+      };
+
+      const options: PDFGenerationOptions = {
+        ...responsivePDFOptions,
+        ...pdfOptions
+      };
+
+      // Prepare patient info (ElectrocardiogramData doesn't have createdAt, use current time)
+      const recordTime = dayjs(data.recordTime).format('DD/MM/YYYY HH:mm');
+      const patient: PatientInfo = {
+        ...patientInfo,
+        name: patientInfo.name || 'N/A',
+        birthday: patientInfo.birthday || 'N/A',
+        age: patientInfo.age || 'N/A',
+        recordTime,
+      };
+
+      console.log('PDF Config:', config);
+      console.log('Patient Info:', patient);
+
+      // Generate HTML template with device type
+      const htmlContent = generateECGPDFTemplate(ecgData, config, patient, global.isTablet);
+      console.log('HTML template generated, length:', htmlContent.length);
+
+      // Generate filename (without .pdf extension, RNHTMLtoPDF will add it automatically)
+      const timestamp = dayjs(data.recordTime).format('DD-MM-YYYY_HH_mm');
+      const fileName = `ECG_${timestamp}`;
+
+      // Request permissions for Android
+      if (Platform.OS === 'android') {
+        await this.requestAndroidPermissions();
+      }
+
+      // For Android, generate to cache directory first, then move to Downloads
+      const outputDirectory = Platform.OS === 'android' ? 'Documents' : await this.getOutputDirectory();
+
+      console.log('Generating PDF with directory:', outputDirectory, 'fileName:', fileName);
+
+      // Debug module availability
+      console.log('RNHTMLtoPDF module debug:', {
+        moduleExists: !!RNHTMLtoPDF,
+        moduleType: typeof RNHTMLtoPDF,
+        convertExists: !!(RNHTMLtoPDF && RNHTMLtoPDF.convert),
+        convertType: typeof (RNHTMLtoPDF && RNHTMLtoPDF.convert),
+        moduleKeys: RNHTMLtoPDF ? Object.keys(RNHTMLtoPDF) : 'module is null/undefined'
+      });
+
+      // Check if RNHTMLtoPDF module is available
+      if (!RNHTMLtoPDF || typeof RNHTMLtoPDF.convert !== 'function') {
+        throw new Error('react-native-html-to-pdf module is not available or not properly installed');
+      }
+
+      // Generate PDF
+      const htmlToPdfOptions = {
+        html: htmlContent,
+        fileName: fileName, // Just the filename without extension (react-native-html-to-pdf adds .pdf)
+        directory: outputDirectory, // 'Downloads' for Android, 'Documents' for iOS
+        width: options.width,
+        height: options.height,
+        type: 'pdf',
+        quality: options.quality,
+        color: true,
+        base64: false
+      };
+
+      console.log('HTML to PDF options:', {
+        fileName: htmlToPdfOptions.fileName,
+        directory: htmlToPdfOptions.directory,
+        width: htmlToPdfOptions.width,
+        height: htmlToPdfOptions.height
+      });
+
+      let pdfResult;
+
+      try {
+        // Try to generate PDF with specified directory
+        pdfResult = await RNHTMLtoPDF.convert(htmlToPdfOptions);
+        console.log('PDF generation result:', pdfResult);
+      } catch (error) {
+        console.log('Failed to generate PDF to Downloads, trying Documents fallback:', error);
+
+        // If Downloads fails (permissions), fallback to Documents directory
+        if (Platform.OS === 'android' && outputDirectory === 'Downloads') {
+          const fallbackOptions = {
+            ...htmlToPdfOptions,
+            directory: 'Documents' // Fallback to app's documents directory
+          };
+
+          console.log('Retrying PDF generation with Documents directory');
+          pdfResult = await RNHTMLtoPDF.convert(fallbackOptions);
+          console.log('PDF generation result (fallback):', pdfResult);
+        } else {
+          throw error; // Re-throw if not Android Downloads issue
+        }
+      }
+
+      if (!pdfResult.filePath) {
+        throw new Error('PDF generation failed: no file path returned');
+      }
+
+      // For Android, use native module to save to Downloads
+      let finalPath = pdfResult.filePath;
+      let savedToDownloads = false;
+
+      // TEMPORARILY COMMENTED OUT: Save to Downloads functionality removed to comply with Google Play policy
+      // This feature requires MANAGE_EXTERNAL_STORAGE permission which Google Play no longer allows
+      // for medical apps. PDF will be saved to app's private directory only.
+      //https://app.clickup.com/t/8553538/TECH-7080?comment=90180155686908
+      // if (Platform.OS === 'android' && NativeModules.PDFDownloadModule) {
+      //   try {
+      //     console.log('Using native module to save PDF to Downloads...');
+      //     const saveResult = await NativeModules.PDFDownloadModule.savePDFToDownloads(
+      //       pdfResult.filePath,
+      //       `${fileName}.pdf`
+      //     );
+      //     console.log('Native module save result:', saveResult);
+      //
+      //     if (saveResult.success) {
+      //       // IMPORTANT: Always use the path returned by native module (should be source path)
+      //       // The downloadsPath is only for information, not for viewing
+      //       if (saveResult.path && saveResult.path.startsWith('/')) {
+      //         // Use the path from native module (should be source file path for viewing)
+      //         finalPath = saveResult.path;
+      //         console.log('Using path from native module for viewing:', finalPath);
+      //         if (saveResult.downloadsPath) {
+      //           console.log('File saved/overwritten to Downloads:', saveResult.downloadsPath);
+      //         }
+      //       } else {
+      //         // Fallback to original file path
+      //         console.log('Using original app path for viewing:', pdfResult.filePath);
+      //         finalPath = pdfResult.filePath;
+      //       }
+      //       savedToDownloads = true;
+      //       console.log('PDF successfully saved/overwritten to Downloads via native module');
+      //     }
+      //   } catch (nativeError) {
+      //     console.warn('Native module save failed, falling back to copy method:', nativeError);
+      //     // Fall back to the old copy method
+      //     await this.copyToDownloads(pdfResult.filePath, `${fileName}.pdf`);
+      //   }
+      // } else
+      {
+        // iOS or no native module available
+        await this.copyToDownloads(pdfResult.filePath, `${fileName}.pdf`);
+      }
+
+      return {
+        success: true,
+        filePath: finalPath,
+        fileName: `${fileName}.pdf`,
+        savedToDownloads // Indicate if the file was saved to Downloads
+      };
+
+    } catch (error) {
+      console.error('ECG PDF generation failed:', error);
+      return {
+        success: false,
+        error: error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'Unknown error occurred'
+      };
+    }
+  }
+
+  /**
+   * Request necessary permissions for Android file system access
+   */
+  private static async requestAndroidPermissions(): Promise<void> {
+    if (Platform.OS !== 'android') return;
+
+    try {
+      const permissions = [
+        PermissionsAndroid.PERMISSIONS.WRITE_EXTERNAL_STORAGE,
+        PermissionsAndroid.PERMISSIONS.READ_EXTERNAL_STORAGE,
+      ];
+
+      console.log('Requesting Android permissions for PDF generation...', permissions);
+
+      const granted = await PermissionsAndroid.requestMultiple(permissions);
+      console.log('Android permissions status:', granted);
+
+      // Check if all permissions are granted
+      const allGranted = Object.values(granted).every(
+        (permission) => permission === PermissionsAndroid.RESULTS.GRANTED
+      );
+
+      if (!allGranted) {
+        console.warn('Some Android permissions were not granted:', granted);
+        console.warn('PDF may not be saved to Downloads folder');
+      } else {
+        console.log('All Android permissions granted successfully');
+      }
+
+      // For Android API 30+, additional MANAGE_EXTERNAL_STORAGE might be needed
+      // This would require special handling and is declared in AndroidManifest.xml
+      const androidVersion = Platform.Version;
+      if (androidVersion >= 30) {
+        console.log('Android API 30+ detected. MANAGE_EXTERNAL_STORAGE permission may be needed for full Downloads access');
+      }
+
+    } catch (error) {
+      console.warn('Failed to request Android permissions:', error);
+      console.warn('This may affect PDF saving to Downloads folder');
+    }
+  }
+
+  /**
+   * Get appropriate output directory for current platform
+   * For react-native-html-to-pdf, use relative directory names to avoid path duplication
+   */
+  private static async getOutputDirectory(): Promise<string> {
+    if (Platform.OS === 'ios') {
+      return 'Documents'; // Use relative path for iOS
+    } else {
+      // Android - Try to use Downloads directory directly
+      // For Android < 11, this should work without special permissions
+      // For Android 11+, we'll handle it differently in PDFScreen
+      console.log('Android: Setting output directory to Downloads');
+
+      // react-native-html-to-pdf on Android accepts these special directory names:
+      // 'Documents' - app's documents directory
+      // 'Downloads' - system Downloads directory (if accessible)
+      // Let's try 'Downloads' first
+      return 'Downloads';
+    }
+  }
+
+  /**
+   * Copy PDF file to Downloads folder for easy user access
+   */
+  private static async copyToDownloads(sourcePath: string, fileName: string): Promise<void> {
+    try {
+      console.log('Attempting to copy PDF to Downloads...', {sourcePath, fileName});
+
+      let downloadsPath: string;
+
+      if (Platform.OS === 'android') {
+        // For Android, use multiple fallback paths
+        const possiblePaths = [
+          RNFS.DownloadDirectoryPath,
+          '/storage/emulated/0/Download',
+          '/sdcard/Download',
+          `${RNFS.ExternalStorageDirectoryPath}/Download`
+        ].filter(Boolean); // Remove undefined/null paths
+
+        console.log('Possible Android download paths:', possiblePaths);
+
+        // Try each path until one works
+        let downloadDir = null;
+        for (const path of possiblePaths) {
+          try {
+            const exists = await RNFS.exists(path);
+            if (exists) {
+              downloadDir = path;
+              console.log('Using download directory:', downloadDir);
+              break;
+            }
+          } catch (error) {
+            console.log('Failed to access path:', path, error);
+            continue;
+          }
+        }
+
+        if (!downloadDir) {
+          throw new Error('No accessible Downloads directory found on Android');
+        }
+
+        downloadsPath = `${downloadDir}/${fileName}`;
+      } else {
+        // iOS
+        const downloadsDir = `${RNFS.DocumentDirectoryPath}/Downloads`;
+        const exists = await RNFS.exists(downloadsDir);
+        if (!exists) {
+          await RNFS.mkdir(downloadsDir);
+        }
+        downloadsPath = `${downloadsDir}/${fileName}`;
+      }
+
+      // Verify source file exists
+      const sourceExists = await RNFS.exists(sourcePath);
+      if (!sourceExists) {
+        throw new Error(`Source file does not exist: ${sourcePath}`);
+      }
+
+      // Copy the file
+      await RNFS.copyFile(sourcePath, downloadsPath);
+      console.log(`PDF successfully copied to Downloads: ${downloadsPath}`);
+
+      // Verify the copied file exists
+      const copiedExists = await RNFS.exists(downloadsPath);
+      if (copiedExists) {
+        console.log('Copied PDF file verified successfully');
+      } else {
+        console.warn('Warning: Copied file cannot be verified');
+      }
+
+    } catch (error) {
+      console.warn('Failed to copy PDF to Downloads:', error);
+      console.warn('PDF generation was successful, but file copy to Downloads failed');
+      // Don't throw error as main PDF generation succeeded
+    }
+  }
+
+  /**
+   * Calculate age from birthday string
+   */
+  private static calculateAge(birthday: string): number {
+    const birthDate = dayjs(birthday);
+    const now = dayjs();
+    return now.diff(birthDate, 'year');
+  }
+
+  /**
+   * Get current global ECG settings (PaperSpeed, Gain) from app context
+   * This should be called from components with access to useAppState
+   */
+  static getGlobalECGConfig(appState?: any): Partial<ECGPDFConfig> {
+    if (!appState) return {};
+
+    return {
+      paperSpeed: appState.PaperSpeed || this.defaultConfig.paperSpeed,
+      gain: appState.Gain || this.defaultConfig.gain,
+      deviceName: `CDV ${global.i18n.t('Health')} ${global.i18n.t('Monitor')}`,
+    };
+  }
+}

+/**
+ * Generate HTML template for ECG PDF
+ * Based on the reference PDF format with patient info, ECG strips, and measurements
+ */
+export const generateECGPDFTemplate = (
+  ecgData: ElectrocardiogramData,
+  config: ECGPDFConfig,
+  patientInfo: PatientInfo,
+  isTablet: boolean = false
+): string => {
+  // Fixed duration to 30 seconds as per requirement
+  const totalDuration = 30;
+
+  // Split waveform into 3 strips (matching reference PDF)
+  const strips = splitWaveDataIntoStrips(ecgData.waveData, config, 3);
+
+  // SVG dimensions for each strip - responsive to device type
+  const stripWidth = isTablet ? 1200 : 720;  // Even smaller width for mobile optimal viewing
+  const stripHeight = isTablet ? 180 : 80;  // Further reduced height for single-page PDF fit
+
+  // Generate SVG for each strip
+  const stripSVGs = strips.map((strip, index) => {
+    const pathData = convertWaveDataToSVG(
+      strip.data,
+      { ...config, sampleRate: config.sampleRate },
+      stripWidth,
+      stripHeight
+    );
+
+    const gridLines = generateECGGrid(stripWidth, stripHeight);
+
+    // Generate time markers for this strip
+    const timeMarkers = [];
+
+    // Fixed 10-second strips for 30-second total duration
+    const stripDuration = 10;
+    const pixelsPerSecond = stripWidth / stripDuration;
+
+    // Determine the correct time range for this strip
+    const stripStartTime = index * 10; // 0, 10, 20 for each strip
+    const stripEndTime = stripStartTime + 9; // 9, 19, 29 for each strip
+
+    // Generate time markers from start to end (inclusive)
+    // Add 10px offset to prevent leftmost time label from being cut off
+    for (let t = 0; t <= 9; t++) {
+      const x = t * pixelsPerSecond + 10; // Add 10px offset for better visibility
+      const timeLabel = stripStartTime + t;
+      timeMarkers.push(`
+        <line x1="${x}" y1="${stripHeight}" x2="${x}" y2="${stripHeight + 15}" stroke="#000" stroke-width="1"/>
+        <text x="${x}" y="${stripHeight + 30}" text-anchor="middle" font-size="${isTablet ? '14' : '10'}" fill="#000" font-weight="bold">${timeLabel} ${global.i18n.t(`sec`)}</text>
+      `);
+    }
+
+    const svgHeight = isTablet ? 220 : 120;
+    return `

+        <svg width="100%" height="${svgHeight}" viewBox="0 0 ${stripWidth} ${stripHeight + 50}">

+          border-bottom: 1px solid #333;

+        }
+        
+        .patient-info {
+          flex: 1;
+        }
+        
+        .patient-info h2 {
+          margin: 0 0 ${isTablet ? '8px' : '2px'} 0;
+          font-size: ${isTablet ? '16px' : '11px'};
+          font-weight: bold;
+        }
+        
+        .patient-details {
+          font-size: ${isTablet ? '11px' : '7px'};
+          line-height: 1.2;
+        }

+        .record-info {

+          font-size: ${isTablet ? '11px' : '7px'};

+          background-color: #f5f5f5;

+          </div>

+/**
+ * Convert mood score to descriptive text
+ * Handles both string and number types for backward compatibility
+ */
+const getMoodDescription = (mood: string | number): string => {
+  // If mood is already a descriptive string, return it directly
+  if (typeof mood === 'string' && isNaN(Number(mood))) {
+    return mood;
+  }
+
+  // Convert to number for scoring
+  const moodScore = typeof mood === 'string' ? Number(mood) : mood;
+
+  if (moodScore >= 80) return 'Excellent';
+  if (moodScore >= 60) return 'Good';
+  if (moodScore >= 40) return 'Fair';
+  if (moodScore >= 20) return 'Poor';
+  return 'Very Poor';
+};
