+// ECG Waveform SVG Conversion Utilities
+
+import { ECGPDFConfig } from './types';
+
+/**
+ * Generate SVG grid background for ECG display
+ * Matches medical ECG paper standard with major and minor grid lines
+ */
+export const generateECGGrid = (width: number, height: number): string => {
+  const majorGridSpacing = 20; // 5mm intervals at 4 pixels per mm
+  const minorGridSpacing = 4; // 1mm intervals at 4 pixels per mm
+  
+  let gridLines = '';
+  
+  // Minor grid lines (1mm)
+  for (let x = 0; x <= width; x += minorGridSpacing) {
+    gridLines += `<line x1="${x}" y1="0" x2="${x}" y2="${height}" stroke="#333333" stroke-width="0.5"/>`;
+  }
+  for (let y = 0; y <= height; y += minorGridSpacing) {
+    gridLines += `<line x1="0" y1="${y}" x2="${width}" y2="${y}" stroke="#333333" stroke-width="0.5"/>`;
+  }
+  
+  // Major grid lines (5mm)
+  for (let x = 0; x <= width; x += majorGridSpacing) {
+    gridLines += `<line x1="${x}" y1="0" x2="${x}" y2="${height}" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1"/>`;
+  }
+  for (let y = 0; y <= height; y += majorGridSpacing) {
+    gridLines += `<line x1="0" y1="${y}" x2="${width}" y2="${y}" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1"/>`;
+  }
+  
+  return gridLines;
+};
+
+/**
+ * Convert ECG wave data to SVG path with medical-grade scaling
+ * Based on ECGWaveformViewer component implementation
+ * @param waveData - Array of ECG data points
+ * @param config - ECG configuration (paper speed, gain, etc.)
+ * @param containerWidth - Width of SVG container in pixels
+ * @param containerHeight - Height of SVG container in pixels
+ * @returns SVG path string
+ */
+export const convertWaveDataToSVG = (
+  waveData: number[],
+  config: ECGPDFConfig,
+  containerWidth: number,
+  containerHeight: number
+): string => {
+  if (!waveData || waveData.length < 2) {
+    return '';
+  }
+
+  // Calculate data range (same as ECGWaveformViewer)
+  const maxValue = Math.max(...waveData);
+  const minValue = Math.min(...waveData);
+  const range = maxValue - minValue || 1;
+
+  // Medical ECG scaling with dynamic range handling
+  let scaledHeight = containerHeight;
+  let yOffset = 0;
+
+  // Apply medical-grade scaling based on data range
+  // This logic mirrors ECGWaveformViewer's scaling algorithm
+  if (range > 800) {
+    // Super large range - ultra-high gain scenarios
+    scaledHeight = containerHeight * 0.20;
+    yOffset = containerHeight * 0.40;
+  } else if (range > 400) {
+    // Very large range - high gain scenarios  
+    scaledHeight = containerHeight * 0.25;
+    yOffset = containerHeight * 0.375;
+  } else if (range > 200) {
+    // Large range - medium-high gain
+    scaledHeight = containerHeight * 0.30;
+    yOffset = containerHeight * 0.35;
+  } else if (range > 100) {
+    // Medium-large range - moderate gain enhancement
+    scaledHeight = containerHeight * 0.35;
+    yOffset = containerHeight * 0.325;
+  } else if (range > 80) {
+    // Medium range - baseline gain scenarios
+    scaledHeight = containerHeight * 0.40;
+    yOffset = containerHeight * 0.30;
+  } else if (range > 40) {
+    // Small-medium range - low data variation
+    scaledHeight = containerHeight * 0.50;
+    yOffset = containerHeight * 0.25;
+  } else if (range > 20) {
+    // Expected range for optimized ECG signals
+    scaledHeight = containerHeight * 0.75;
+    yOffset = containerHeight * 0.125;
+  } else if (range > 12) {
+    // Small-medium amplitude signals
+    scaledHeight = containerHeight * 0.80;
+    yOffset = containerHeight * 0.10;
+  } else {
+    // Small signals - maximize visibility
+    scaledHeight = containerHeight * 0.85;
+    yOffset = containerHeight * 0.075;
+  }
+
+  // Apply light smoothing filter to reduce noise while preserving ECG features
+  const smoothedData = waveData.map((value, index, array) => {
+    if (index === 0 || index === array.length - 1) {
+      return value; // Keep first and last points unchanged
+    }
+
+    // Detect ECG features with enhanced sensitivity
+    const prev = array[index - 1];
+    const curr = value;
+    const next = array[index + 1];
+
+    // Calculate local gradient  
+    const gradientPrev = Math.abs(curr - prev);
+    const gradientNext = Math.abs(next - curr);
+    const maxGradient = Math.max(gradientPrev, gradientNext);
+
+    // Preserve ECG features (valleys, peaks, intervals)
+    if (maxGradient > range * 0.04) {
+      // NO smoothing for ECG features - preserve original morphology
+      return curr;
+    } else {
+      // Ultra-minimal smoothing only for baseline segments
+      return (prev * 0.03 + curr * 0.94 + next * 0.03);
+    }
+  });
+
+  // Generate coordinates with proper scaling to fill the container width
+  // while maintaining medical ECG characteristics
+  const coordinates = smoothedData.map((value, index) => {
+    // Scale X coordinate to fill the entire container width
+    // This ensures the waveform occupies the full grid width
+    const x = (index / (smoothedData.length - 1)) * containerWidth;
+    
+    // Medical ECG amplitude calculation
+    const normalizedValue = (value - minValue) / range;
+    const y = yOffset + scaledHeight - (normalizedValue * scaledHeight);
+
+    // Ensure coordinates are valid
+    const safeX = isFinite(x) ? x : 0;
+    const safeY = isFinite(y) ? y : containerHeight / 2;
+
+    return { x: safeX, y: safeY };
+  });
+
+  // Generate SVG path using linear segments to preserve sharp ECG features
+  let pathData = '';
+  if (coordinates.length > 0) {
+    pathData = `M ${coordinates[0].x.toFixed(1)},${coordinates[0].y.toFixed(1)}`;
+
+    // Use linear segments to preserve sharp ECG features (valleys, peaks)
+    for (let i = 1; i < coordinates.length; i++) {
+      const curr = coordinates[i];
+      pathData += ` L ${curr.x.toFixed(1)},${curr.y.toFixed(1)}`;
+    }
+  }
+
+  return pathData;
+};
+
+/**
+ * Generate time labels for ECG strips
+ * @param duration - Total duration in seconds
+ * @param stripCount - Number of strips to generate
+ * @returns Array of time label objects
+ */
+export const generateTimeLabels = (duration: number, stripCount: number = 3) => {
+  const labels: Array<{ time: number; label: string }> = [];
+  const stripDuration = duration / stripCount;
+  
+  for (let strip = 0; strip < stripCount; strip++) {
+    const startTime = strip * stripDuration;
+    for (let i = 0; i <= stripDuration; i++) {
+      const time = startTime + i;
+      if (time <= duration) {
+        labels.push({
+          time,
+          label: `${time} sec`
+        });
+      }
+    }
+  }
+  
+  return labels;
+};
+
+/**
+ * Split ECG waveform data into multiple strips for PDF display
+ * Matches the reference PDF format with 3 strips of 10 seconds each
+ */
+export const splitWaveDataIntoStrips = (
+  waveData: number[],
+  config: ECGPDFConfig,
+  stripCount: number = 3
+): Array<{ data: number[]; startTime: number; endTime: number }> => {
+  const totalSamples = waveData.length;
+  const samplesPerStrip = Math.ceil(totalSamples / stripCount);
+  const strips: Array<{ data: number[]; startTime: number; endTime: number }> = [];
+  
+  // Fixed time ranges for 30-second total duration
+  const timeRanges = [
+    { startTime: 0, endTime: 10 },
+    { startTime: 10, endTime: 20 },
+    { startTime: 20, endTime: 30 }
+  ];
+  
+  for (let i = 0; i < stripCount; i++) {
+    const startSample = i * samplesPerStrip;
+    const endSample = Math.min(startSample + samplesPerStrip, totalSamples);
+    const stripData = waveData.slice(startSample, endSample);
+    
+    strips.push({
+      data: stripData,
+      startTime: timeRanges[i].startTime,
+      endTime: timeRanges[i].endTime
+    });
+  }
+  
+  return strips;
+};

+ *   在 RSA 加密体系中：

+export const encryptWithPublicKeyPKCS1 = (publicKey: string, data: string) => {
+    console.log('encryptWithPublicKeyPKCS1 publicKey:', publicKey);
+    console.log('encryptWithPublicKeyPKCS1 data:', data);

+        publicKeyPEM = publicKey;

+        // Base64 encoded, convert to PEM format

+            return hextob64(enc);
+        } catch (fallbackError) {
+            console.error('encryptWithPublicKeyPKCS1 fallback error:', fallbackError);
+            throw error;
+        }
+    }

+// Use private key for encryption (special case - normally private keys are used for signing)
+export const encryptWithPrivateKey = (privateKey: string, data: string) => {
+    try {
+        // In RSA, using private key to "encrypt" is actually performing the signing operation
+        // We'll use the sign method but without hashing, just the raw RSA operation
+
+        // Get RSA key object
+        const key = KEYUTIL.getKey(privateKey) as RSAKey;
+
+        // Convert string to bytes and then to BigInteger
+        const dataBytes = KJUR.crypto.Util.utf8tohex(data);
+        const m = new KJUR.BigInteger(dataBytes, 16);
+
+        // Perform RSA private key operation: m^d mod n
+        const c = key.doPrivate(m);
+
+        // Convert result to hex and then to base64
+        const hexResult = c.toString(16);
+        // Ensure even length hex string
+        const paddedHex = hexResult.length % 2 === 0 ? hexResult : '0' + hexResult;
+
+        return hextob64(paddedHex);
+    } catch (error) {
+        console.error('encryptWithPrivateKey error:', error);
+        // If the above method fails, try using sign without hash as a fallback
+        try {
+            // Alternative approach: use signString with no hash
+            const key = KEYUTIL.getKey(privateKey);
+            const sig = new KJUR.crypto.Signature({alg: 'NONEwithRSA'});
+            sig.init(key);
+            sig.updateString(data);
+            const sigHex = sig.sign();
+            return hextob64(sigHex);
+        } catch (fallbackError) {
+            console.error('encryptWithPrivateKey fallback error:', fallbackError);
+            throw error;
+        }
+    }
+};

+import React, { useEffect, useState, useRef } from 'react';
+import { Keyboard, EmitterSubscription, Platform } from 'react-native';
+
+// 防抖函數
+const debounce = (func: Function, delay: number) => {
+  let timer: NodeJS.Timeout;
+  return (...args: any[]) => {
+    clearTimeout(timer);
+    timer = setTimeout(() => func(...args), delay);
+  };
+};
+
+export const useKeyboardStatus = () => {
+  const [isKeyboardFullyShown, setIsKeyboardFullyShown] = useState(false);
+
+  // 添加状态缓存，避免重复设置相同状态
+  const currentKeyboardStatusRef = useRef<boolean>(false);
+  const lastUpdateTimeRef = useRef<number>(0);
+  const pendingValueRef = useRef<boolean | null>(null);
+
+  // 包装函数：在 debounce 之前先进行状态检查
+  const safeSetKeyboardShown = useRef((value: boolean) => {
+    const currentTime = Date.now();
+    const timeSinceLastUpdate = currentTime - lastUpdateTimeRef.current;
+
+    // ✅ FIX: 在 debounce 之前就检查状态
+    if (currentKeyboardStatusRef.current === value) {
+      console.log('KeyboardManager: 跳过 - 键盘状态未变化（debounce前）', { value, timeSinceLastUpdate });
+      return;
+    }
+
+    // ✅ FIX: 如果有相同的值正在等待处理，跳过
+    if (pendingValueRef.current === value) {
+      console.log('KeyboardManager: 跳过 - 已有相同值在处理队列中', { value });
+      return;
+    }
+
+    // ✅ FIX: 标记正在处理的值
+    pendingValueRef.current = value;
+
+    // 调用真正的更新函数
+    debouncedSetKeyboardShownInternal(value, currentTime, timeSinceLastUpdate);
+  }).current;
+
+  // 内部 debounce 函数
+  const debouncedSetKeyboardShownInternal = useRef(
+    debounce((value: boolean, currentTime: number, timeSinceLastUpdate: number) => {
+      // ✅ FIX: 再次检查状态（防止 debounce 期间状态已更新）
+      if (currentKeyboardStatusRef.current === value) {
+        console.log('KeyboardManager: 跳过 - 键盘状态未变化（debounce后）', { value, timeSinceLastUpdate });
+        pendingValueRef.current = null;
+        return;
+      }
+
+      console.log('KeyboardManager: Setting keyboard status to', value, {
+        previousValue: currentKeyboardStatusRef.current,
+        timeSinceLastUpdate
+      });
+
+      currentKeyboardStatusRef.current = value;
+      lastUpdateTimeRef.current = currentTime;
+      pendingValueRef.current = null;
+      setIsKeyboardFullyShown(value);
+    }, 300)
+  ).current;
+
+  // 使用包装后的函数
+  const debouncedSetKeyboardShown = safeSetKeyboardShown;
+
+  useEffect(() => {
+    let keyboardDidShowListener: EmitterSubscription;
+    let keyboardDidHideListener: EmitterSubscription;
+
+    // ✅ FIX: iOS 和 Android 使用相同的逻辑 - 只监听 Did 事件
+    // 移除 Will 事件监听器以避免重复触发和状态竞争
+    keyboardDidShowListener = Keyboard.addListener(
+      'keyboardDidShow',
+      () => {
+        // ✅ FIX: 在事件监听器层面增加保护 - 如果键盘已经打开则跳过
+        if (currentKeyboardStatusRef.current === true) {
+          console.log('KeyboardManager: 跳过 keyboardDidShow 事件 - 键盘已经打开');
+          return;
+        }
+        debouncedSetKeyboardShown(true);
+      }
+    );
+    keyboardDidHideListener = Keyboard.addListener(
+      'keyboardDidHide',
+      () => {
+        // ✅ FIX: 在事件监听器层面增加保护 - 如果键盘已经关闭则跳过
+        if (currentKeyboardStatusRef.current === false) {
+          console.log('KeyboardManager: 跳过 keyboardDidHide 事件 - 键盘已经关闭');
+          return;
+        }
+        debouncedSetKeyboardShown(false);
+      }
+    );
+
+    return () => {
+      keyboardDidShowListener?.remove();
+      keyboardDidHideListener?.remove();
+    };
+  }, []);
+
+  return isKeyboardFullyShown;
+};

+/**
+ * Safe base64 encoding utility for handling Unicode characters
+ * This utility resolves the "characters outside of the Latin1 range" error
+ */
+
+/**
+ * Safely encode a string to base64, supporting Unicode characters
+ * @param str - The string to encode (can contain Unicode characters like Chinese)
+ * @returns Base64 encoded string
+ */
+export const safeBase64Encode = (str: string): string => {
+  try {
+    // First, encode the string to handle Unicode characters
+    // This converts Unicode characters to percent-encoded UTF-8 sequences
+    const utf8Encoded = encodeURIComponent(str);
+    
+    // Then convert the percent-encoded string to actual UTF-8 bytes
+    // and encode to base64
+    const base64 = btoa(utf8Encoded.replace(/%([0-9A-F]{2})/g, (match, p1) => {
+      return String.fromCharCode(parseInt(p1, 16));
+    }));
+    
+    return base64;
+  } catch (error) {
+    // console.error('safeBase64Encode error:', error);
+    throw new Error('Failed to encode string to base64');
+  }
+};
+
+/**
+ * Smart base64 encode that maintains compatibility with base-64 library
+ * For ASCII strings: behaves exactly like base-64 library
+ * For Unicode strings: uses UTF-8 encoding instead of throwing error
+ * @param str - The string to encode
+ * @returns Base64 encoded string
+ */
+export const smartBase64Encode = (str: string): string => {
+  try {
+    // First try direct base64 encoding (same as base-64 library)
+    // This will work for ASCII/Latin1 characters and produce identical results
+    return btoa(str);
+  } catch (error) {
+    // If it fails (contains characters outside Latin1 range),
+    // fall back to UTF-8 encoding method
+    // console.warn('String contains non-Latin1 characters, using UTF-8 encoding');
+    return safeBase64Encode(str);
+  }
+};
+
+/**
+ * Safely decode a base64 string, supporting Unicode characters
+ * @param base64 - The base64 string to decode
+ * @returns Decoded string
+ */
+export const safeBase64Decode = (base64: string): string => {
+  try {
+    // First decode from base64
+    const decoded = atob(base64);
+    
+    // Convert each character to its hex representation
+    const percentEncoded = decoded.split('').map(c => {
+      const hex = c.charCodeAt(0).toString(16).toUpperCase();
+      return `%${hex.length === 1 ? `0${hex}` : hex}`;
+    }).join('');
+    
+    // Finally decode from percent-encoding to get the original Unicode string
+    return decodeURIComponent(percentEncoded);
+  } catch (error) {
+    // console.error('safeBase64Decode error:', error);
+    throw new Error('Failed to decode base64 string');
+  }
+};

+/**
+ * Navigation Service - Global Navigation Functions
+ * 
+ * Usage Examples:
+ * 
+ * 1. Direct import and use:
+ *    import { navigate, goBack } from '@/tools/navigationService';
+ *    navigate('HomePage');
+ *    goBack();
+ * 
+ * 2. Use global navigationRef (available anywhere in the project):
+ *    global.navigationRef.navigate('HomePage');
+ *    global.navigationRef.goBack();
+ *    global.navigationRef.push('SearchPatients', { patientId: '123' });
+ *    global.navigationRef.replace('LoginPage');
+ *    global.navigationRef.reset('WelcomePage');
+ * 
+ * 3. Check navigation status:
+ *    if (global.navigationRef.isNavigationReady()) {
+ *      global.navigationRef.navigate('HomePage');
+ *    }

+ *    const routeName = global.navigationRef.getCurrentRouteName();
+ *    const route = global.navigationRef.getCurrentRoute();
+ *    const state = global.navigationRef.getNavigationState();
+ */
+
+// Global navigation reference
+export const navigationRef = React.createRef<NavigationContainerRef<ParamListBase>>();
+
+/**
+ * Get current route name from global navigation reference
+ * @returns Current route name or null if navigation is not available
+ */
+export function getCurrentRouteName(): string | null {
+  if (navigationRef.current) {

+    return currentRoute?.name || null;
+  }
+  return null;

+  return null;

+ */
+export function navigate(routeName: string, params?: object): void {

+export function push(routeName: string, params?: object): void {

+    console.log('navigationService.ts push routeName=', routeName, ' params=', params);
+    // Type assertion needed for push method
+    (navigationRef.current as any).push(routeName, params);
+  } else {
+    console.warn('Navigation is not ready');
+  }
+}
+
+/**
+ * Go back to the previous screen using global navigation reference
+ */
+export function goBack(): void {
+  if (navigationRef.current?.isReady()) {
+    console.log('navigationService.ts goBack');
+    navigationRef.current.goBack();
+  } else {
+    console.warn('Navigation is not ready');
+  }
+}
+
+/**
+ * Replace the current route with a new one using global navigation reference
+ * @param routeName - Name of the route to replace with
+ * @param params - Optional parameters to pass to the route
+ */
+export function replace(routeName: string, params?: object): void {
+  if (navigationRef.current?.isReady()) {
+    console.log('navigationService.ts replace routeName=', routeName, ' params=', params);
+    // Use StackActions.replace for React Navigation v6
+    navigationRef.current.dispatch(StackActions.replace(routeName, params));
+  } else {
+    console.warn('Navigation is not ready');
+  }
+}
+
+/**
+ * Reset the navigation stack and set it to a new state using global navigation reference
+ * This is useful for clearing navigation history after completing a login flow
+ * @param routeName - Name of the route to reset to
+ * @param params - Optional parameters to pass to the route
+ */
+export function reset(routeName: string, params?: object): void {
+  if (navigationRef.current?.isReady()) {
+    console.log('navigationService.ts reset routeName=', routeName, ' params=', params);
+    navigationRef.current.reset({
+      index: 0,
+      routes: [
+        {
+          name: routeName,
+          params: params,
+        },
+      ],
+    });
+  } else {
+    console.warn('Navigation is not ready');
+  }
+}
+
+// Navigation functions object for global access
+const navigationFunctions = {
+  navigate,
+  push,
+  goBack,
+  replace,
+  reset,
+  getCurrentRouteName,
+  getCurrentRoute,
+  getNavigationState,
+  isNavigationReady,
+};
+
+// Set global navigationRef
+(global as any).navigationRef = navigationFunctions;
+
+// Export default object with all navigation functions and route names for compatibility
+export default {
+  navigate,
+  push,
+  goBack,
+  replace,
+  reset,
+};

+import { Platform } from 'react-native';
+import messaging from '@react-native-firebase/messaging';
+import { isHuaweiDevice, isXiaomiDevice, isVivoDevice } from './common';
+import { initHmsPush, setupHmsTokenListener, setupHmsMessageListener } from './hmsPush';
+import { register_client } from '@api/api';
+import tool from 'tools/tool';
+
+/**
+ * Unified Push Notification Manager
+ * Automatically detects device type and initializes appropriate push service:
+ * - Huawei/Honor devices: HMS Push Kit
+ * - Other devices: Firebase Cloud Messaging
+ */
+class PushManager {
+  private initialized = false;
+  private pushType: 'fcm' | 'hms' | null = null;
+  private currentToken: string | null = null;
+
+  /**
+   * Initialize push notification service
+   * Should be called once during app startup (after user login)
+   */
+  async initialize(): Promise<boolean> {
+    if (this.initialized) {
+      console.log('pushManager: Already initialized');
+      return true;
+    }
+
+    console.log('pushManager: Starting initialization...');
+
+    try {
+      // Detect device type and choose appropriate push service
+      const isHuawei = isHuaweiDevice();
+      
+      if (isHuawei) {
+        // Huawei/Honor device - Use HMS Push Kit
+        console.log('pushManager: Huawei device detected, using HMS Push Kit');
+        return await this.initializeHmsPush();
+      } else {
+        // Non-Huawei device - Use Firebase FCM
+        console.log('pushManager: Non-Huawei device detected, using Firebase FCM');
+        return await this.initializeFcmPush();
+      }
+    } catch (error) {
+      console.log('pushManager: Initialization failed:', error);
+      return false;
+    }
+  }
+
+  /**
+   * Initialize HMS Push for Huawei/Honor devices
+   */
+  private async initializeHmsPush(): Promise<boolean> {
+    try {
+      console.log('pushManager: Initializing HMS Push...');
+      
+      // Get HMS Push token
+      const hmsToken = await initHmsPush();
+      
+      if (!hmsToken) {
+        console.log('pushManager: Failed to get HMS Push token');
+        return false;
+      }
+
+      this.currentToken = hmsToken;
+      this.pushType = 'hms';
+      
+      console.log('pushManager: HMS Push token received, length=', hmsToken.length);
+
+      // Register token with backend server
+      const [err, data] = await tool.to(register_client(hmsToken, 'hms'));
+      
+      if (data?.status === 'SUCCESS') {
+        console.log('pushManager: HMS Push token registered successfully');
+        this.initialized = true;
+        
+        // Setup listener for token updates
+        setupHmsTokenListener(async (newToken: string) => {
+          console.log('pushManager: HMS token updated, registering with server...');
+          this.currentToken = newToken;
+          await tool.to(register_client(newToken, 'hms'));
+        });
+        
+        // Setup listener for foreground messages
+        setupHmsMessageListener((message: any) => {
+          console.log('pushManager: HMS foreground message received:', message);
+          this.handleForegroundMessage(message, 'hms');
+        });
+        
+        return true;
+      } else {
+        console.log('pushManager: Failed to register HMS token with server');
+        return false;
+      }
+    } catch (error) {
+      console.log('pushManager: HMS Push initialization error:', error);
+      return false;
+    }
+  }
+
+  /**
+   * Initialize Firebase FCM for non-Huawei devices
+   */
+  private async initializeFcmPush(): Promise<boolean> {
+    try {
+      console.log('pushManager: Initializing Firebase FCM...');
+
+      // Check if Firebase messaging is available
+      if (!messaging) {
+        console.log('pushManager: Firebase messaging not available');
+        return false;
+      }
+
+      // Request notification permissions
+      const authStatus = await messaging().requestPermission();
+      const enabled =
+        authStatus === messaging.AuthorizationStatus.AUTHORIZED ||
+        authStatus === messaging.AuthorizationStatus.PROVISIONAL;
+
+      if (!enabled) {
+        console.log('pushManager: FCM notification permission not granted');
+        return false;
+      }
+
+      console.log('pushManager: FCM notification permission granted');
+
+      // Get FCM token with timeout mechanism for Xiaomi and VIVO devices
+      const isXiaomi = isXiaomiDevice();
+      const isVivo = isVivoDevice();
+      const needsLongerTimeout = isXiaomi || isVivo;
+      const tokenTimeout = needsLongerTimeout ? 20000 : 8000;
+
+      console.log('pushManager: Getting FCM token with timeout=', tokenTimeout, 'ms');
+
+      const fcmToken = await this.withTimeout(
+        messaging().getToken(),
+        tokenTimeout,
+        null
+      );
+
+      if (!fcmToken) {
+        console.log('pushManager: Failed to get FCM token (timeout or error)');
+        return false;
+      }
+
+      this.currentToken = fcmToken;
+      this.pushType = 'fcm';
+      
+      console.log('pushManager: FCM token received, length=', fcmToken.length);
+
+      // Register token with backend server
+      const [err, data] = await tool.to(register_client(fcmToken, 'fcm'));
+      
+      if (data?.status === 'SUCCESS') {
+        console.log('pushManager: FCM token registered successfully');
+        this.initialized = true;
+        
+        // Setup listener for token refresh
+        messaging().onTokenRefresh(async (newToken: string) => {
+          console.log('pushManager: FCM token refreshed, registering with server...');
+          this.currentToken = newToken;
+          await tool.to(register_client(newToken, 'fcm'));
+        });
+        
+        // Setup listener for foreground messages
+        messaging().onMessage(async (remoteMessage: any) => {
+          console.log('pushManager: FCM foreground message received:', remoteMessage);
+          this.handleForegroundMessage(remoteMessage, 'fcm');
+        });
+        
+        return true;
+      } else {
+        console.log('pushManager: Failed to register FCM token with server');
+        return false;
+      }
+    } catch (error) {
+      console.log('pushManager: Firebase FCM initialization error:', error);
+      return false;
+    }
+  }
+
+  /**
+   * Handle push messages received when app is in foreground
+   */
+  private handleForegroundMessage(message: any, source: 'fcm' | 'hms'): void {
+    console.log('pushManager: Handling foreground message from', source);
+    
+    // Extract notification data
+    let title = '';
+    let body = '';
+    let data = {};
+
+    if (source === 'fcm') {
+      // Firebase FCM format
+      title = message.notification?.title || message.data?.title || 'CS Mobile';
+      body = message.notification?.body || message.data?.body || message.data?.message || '';
+      data = message.data || {};
+    } else {
+      // HMS Push format
+      title = message.notification?.title || message.dataOfMap?.title || 'CS Mobile';
+      body = message.notification?.body || message.dataOfMap?.body || message.dataOfMap?.message || '';
+      data = message.dataOfMap || {};
+    }
+
+    console.log('pushManager: Foreground notification - Title:', title, 'Body:', body);
+
+    // You can emit a global event here to show notification in app
+    // Or show a local notification using react-native-push-notification
+    // For now, just log it
+    if (body) {
+      // TODO: Implement custom in-app notification display
+      console.log('pushManager: Foreground notification should be displayed in-app');
+    }
+  }
+
+  /**
+   * Get current push token
+   */
+  getCurrentToken(): string | null {
+    return this.currentToken;
+  }
+
+  /**
+   * Get current push type
+   */
+  getPushType(): 'fcm' | 'hms' | null {
+    return this.pushType;
+  }
+
+  /**
+   * Check if push manager is initialized
+   */
+  isInitialized(): boolean {
+    return this.initialized;
+  }
+
+  /**
+   * Utility function to wrap promise with timeout
+   */
+  private withTimeout<T>(
+    promise: Promise<T>,
+    timeoutMs: number,
+    fallbackValue: T
+  ): Promise<T> {
+    return new Promise((resolve) => {
+      const timer = setTimeout(() => {
+        console.log('pushManager: Promise timed out after', timeoutMs, 'ms');
+        resolve(fallbackValue);
+      }, timeoutMs);
+
+      promise
+        .then((result) => {
+          clearTimeout(timer);
+          resolve(result);
+        })
+        .catch((error) => {
+          clearTimeout(timer);
+          console.log('pushManager: Promise rejected with error:', error);
+          resolve(fallbackValue);
+        });
+    });
+  }
+
+  /**
+   * Reset push manager state
+   * Useful for logout scenarios
+   */
+  reset(): void {
+    console.log('pushManager: Resetting push manager state');
+    this.initialized = false;
+    this.pushType = null;
+    this.currentToken = null;
+  }
+}
+
+// Export singleton instance
+export const pushManager = new PushManager();
+
+// Export default for convenience
+export default pushManager;

+  addMinutesToTimeString: (timeStr: string/*09:00'*/, interval: number): string => {

+   * 将任何12小时制的时间字符(03:30 PM)串转换为24小时制的格式
+   * @param time12h
+   */
+  convertTo24HourFormat: (time12h: string): string => {
+    // 分割字符串以获取小时、分钟和AM/PM
+    const [time, modifier] = time12h.split(' ');
+    // 分割小时和分钟
+    let [hours, minutes] = time.split(':');
+    // 将小时转换为数字以便进行计算
+    let hoursNumeric = parseInt(hours, 10);
+    // 根据AM/PM调整小时数
+    if (modifier === 'PM' && hoursNumeric < 12) {
+      hoursNumeric += 12;
+    } else if (modifier === 'AM' && hoursNumeric === 12) {
+      hoursNumeric = 0;
+    }
+    // 如果小时数小于10，添加前导0
+    hours = hoursNumeric < 10 ? `0${hoursNumeric}` : `${hoursNumeric}`;
+    // 构造并返回24小时制的时间字符串
+    return `${hours}:${minutes}`;
+  },
+  /**
+   * 计算一个给定的24小时制时间字符串（如'19:10'）在往前推minutes分钟和往后推minutes分钟后的时间
+   * @param inputTime
+   * @param minutes
+   */
+  adjustTimeByMinutes: (inputTime: string, minutes: number): string => {
+    // 将输入的时间字符串转换为Date对象
+    const timeParts = inputTime.split(':');
+    const hours = parseInt(timeParts[0], 10);
+    const mins = parseInt(timeParts[1], 10);
+    // 使用当前日期创建一个Date对象，但是时间设置为输入时间
+    // 这里假设日期不重要，因为我们只关心时间的调整
+    const date = new Date();
+    date.setHours(hours, mins, 0, 0);
+    // 调整时间
+    date.setMinutes(date.getMinutes() + minutes);
+    // 将调整后的时间转换回字符串格式
+    const adjustedHours = date.getHours().toString().padStart(2, '0');
+    const adjustedMinutes = date.getMinutes().toString().padStart(2, '0');
+    return `${adjustedHours}:${adjustedMinutes}`;
+  },
+  /**
+   * 调整 hexColor 的透明度到原来的 opacityPercentage %，并保持RGB分量不变
+   * @param hexColor : #F85C4E
+   * @param opacityPercentage
+   */
+  adjustOpacity: (hexColor: string, opacityPercentage: number): string => {
+    // 计算透明度的十六进制值
+    const opacityHex = Math.round(opacityPercentage * 255 / 100).toString(16).padStart(2, '0');
+    // 返回带有新透明度的RGBA十六进制颜色值
+    return `${hexColor}${opacityHex}`;
+  },
+  /**
+   * 计算两个给定的12小时制时间字符串（如'7:30 PM'）之间的分钟差
+   * @param time1
+   * @param time2
+   */
+  calculateDifference: (time1: string, time2: string): number => {

+      if (modifier === 'PM' && hours < 12) {
+        hours += 12;
+      } else if (modifier === 'AM' && hours === 12) {
+        hours = 0;
+      }
+      return hours * 60 + minutes;
+    }
+    const minutes1 = convertToMinutes(time1);
+    const minutes2 = convertToMinutes(time2);
+    return minutes2 - minutes1;
+  },

+  /**
+   * 将输入的number 转换为英文格式
+   * 0-1000 显示为 0-1,000，保留零位小数
+   * 1000-10000 显示为 x.x K，保留一位小数
+   * >=10000 显示为 xx K，保留零位小数
+   * @param input
+   */
+  formatNumberToEnglish(input: number): string {
+    if (isNaN(input)) {
+      return '0';
+    }
+    if (input >= 0 && input < 1000) {
+      return new Intl.NumberFormat('en-US').format(Number(input.toFixed(0)));
+    } else if (input >= 1000 && input < 10000) {
+      return new Intl.NumberFormat('en-US').format(Number((input / 1000).toFixed(1))) + 'K';
+    } else if (input >= 10000) {
+      return new Intl.NumberFormat('en-US').format(Number((input / 1000).toFixed(0))) + 'K';
     }
+    return new Intl.NumberFormat('en-US').format(input);
+  },
+  /*
+   * 將日期從 'YYYY-MM-DD' 格式轉換成 'dd/MM/yyyy' 格式
+   * @param input
+   */
+  formatDateTo_ddMMyyyy(input: string): string {
+    // 解析輸入的 'YYYY-MM-DD' 字符串，並將其轉換為 Date 物件
+    const [year, month, day] = input.split('-');
+    const date = new Date(parseInt(year), parseInt(month) - 1, parseInt(day));
+    // 使用 Intl.DateTimeFormat 格式化日期
+    const formattedDate = new Intl.DateTimeFormat('en-GB').format(date);
+    return formattedDate;

diff --git a/src/useHooks/useAndroidBackHandler.ts b/src/useHooks/useAndroidBackHandler.ts
new file mode 100644
index 00000000..2b73240b
--- /dev/null
+++ b/src/useHooks/useAndroidBackHandler.ts
@@ -0,0 +1,45 @@
+import { useEffect } from 'react';
+import { BackHandler } from 'react-native';
+
+interface UseBackHandlerOptions {
+  /**
+   * The function to be executed when the "back" button is pressed:
+   * If it returns true, it indicates the event is intercepted and will not be handled by the system
+   * If it returns false, it means the event is not intercepted and will be processed by the system's default behavior (e.g., navigating to the previous page or closing the app).
+   * */
+  onBackPress?: () => boolean;
+
+  /**
+   * Whether to enable the listener, default is **true**.
+   * You can also use this property to dynamically enable or disable the listener.
+   */
+  enabled?: boolean;
+}
+
+/**
+ * Listen to the event of the Android device's built-in bottom "back" button.
+ * import {useAndroidBackHandler} from '@hooks/useAndroidBackHandler.ts';
+   useAndroidBackHandler({
+     onBackPress: () => {
+     return true;
+     },
+     enabled: true,
+   });
+ * @param options
+ */
+export function useAndroidBackHandler (options: UseBackHandlerOptions) {
+  const { onBackPress, enabled = true } = options;
+
+  useEffect(() => {
+    // If neither **onBackPress** nor **disabled** is passed in, the listener will not be registered.
+    if (!onBackPress || !enabled) {
+      return;
+    }
+    const subscription = BackHandler.addEventListener(
+      'hardwareBackPress',
+      onBackPress
+    );
+    // When the component is unmounted or re-rendered, remove the listener.
+    return () => subscription.remove();
+  }, [onBackPress, enabled]);
+}

+  };

+    setCommonAlertModalTitle(global.i18n.t('Change_calendar_permissions'));
+    setCommonAlertModalContent(global.i18n.t('Change_calendar_permissions1'));

     };

+    requestPermission,
+    addEvent,
+    openSettings,
+    alertUserAboutPermissions,
+    permissionStatus: state.permissionStatus,
+    checkingPermission: state.checkingPermission,
+    fetchCalendarEvents,

+    removeExpiredEvents,
+    currentUserId: state.currentUserId
+  };

+// useLogStorage.ts - Global log storage hook with clipboard support
+import {useState, useEffect, useCallback} from 'react';
+import Clipboard from '@react-native-clipboard/clipboard';
+import * as storage from 'components/storage/storage.ts';
+import {useGlobalEventListener} from 'tools/useGlobalEventEmitter.ts';
+
+// Log entry interface definition
+export interface LogEntry {
+  id: string;
+  timestamp: string;
+  level: 'info' | 'warn' | 'error' | 'debug';
+  message: string;
+  context?: string;
+  data?: any;
+}
+
+// Log storage hook return type
+export interface UseLogStorageReturn {
+  logs: LogEntry[];
+  addLog: (level: LogEntry['level'], message: string, context?: string, data?: any) => void;
+  clearLogs: () => void;
+  copyLogsToClipboard: () => Promise<boolean>;
+  getLogCount: () => number;
+  refreshLogs: () => void;
+  forceRefreshLogs: () => Promise<void>;
+}
+
+// Storage key for logs
+const LOG_STORAGE_KEY = 'csx_mobile_logs';
+
+// Maximum number of logs to keep in storage
+const MAX_LOGS = 1000;
+
+// Log storage configuration
+const LOG_CONFIG = {
+  AUTO_CLEAR_ON_RESTART: false, // Disable auto-clear on app restart
+  ENABLE_DEBUG_LOGS: __DEV__, // Show debug logs in development
+};
+
+// Global log event names
+export const LOG_EVENTS = {
+  ADD_LOG: 'LOG_ADD_LOG',
+  CLEAR_LOGS: 'LOG_CLEAR_LOGS',
+  REFRESH_LOGS: 'LOG_REFRESH_LOGS',
+};
+
+/**
+ * src\useHooks\useLogStorage_EXAMPLE.md
+ * Custom hook for global log storage management
+ * Supports adding logs from anywhere in the app and copying to clipboard
+ *
+ * Usage:
+ * const { logs, addLog, clearLogs, copyLogsToClipboard } = useLogStorage();
+ *
+ * // Add log from anywhere using global events:
+ * const emitEvent = useGlobalEventEmitter();
+ * emitEvent(LOG_EVENTS.ADD_LOG, { level: 'info', message: 'Test log', context: 'HomePage' });
+ */
+export const useLogStorage = (): UseLogStorageReturn => {
+  const [logs, setLogs] = useState<LogEntry[]>([]);
+
+  // Generate unique log ID
+  const generateLogId = useCallback((): string => {
+    return `log_${Date.now()}_${Math.random().toString(36).substr(2, 9)}`;
+  }, []);
+
+  // Format timestamp
+  const formatTimestamp = useCallback((): string => {
+    return new Date().toISOString();
+  }, []);
+
+  // Load logs from storage with session-based clearing
+  const loadLogs = useCallback(async (): Promise<void> => {
+    try {
+      // Simply load existing logs from storage without any session checking
+      const storedLogs = await storage.getItem(LOG_STORAGE_KEY, true);
+      const existingLogs = (storedLogs && Array.isArray(storedLogs)) ? storedLogs : [];
+
+      if (LOG_CONFIG.ENABLE_DEBUG_LOGS) {
+        // eslint-disable-next-line no-console
+        console.log(`useLogStorage loadLogs: Found ${existingLogs.length} existing logs in storage`);
+      }
+
+      setLogs(existingLogs);
+    } catch (error) {
+      if (LOG_CONFIG.ENABLE_DEBUG_LOGS) {
+        // eslint-disable-next-line no-console
+        console.error('useLogStorage loadLogs: Error loading logs from storage:', error);
+      }
+      // Error loading logs from storage, initialize with empty logs
+      setLogs([]);
+    }
+  }, []);
+
+  // Save logs to storage
+  const saveLogs = useCallback(async (logsToSave: LogEntry[]): Promise<void> => {
+    try {
+      await storage.setItem(LOG_STORAGE_KEY, logsToSave);
+    } catch (error) {
+      // Error saving logs to storage
+    }
+  }, []);
+
+  // Add new log entry
+  const addLog = useCallback((
+    level: LogEntry['level'],
+    message: string,
+    context?: string,
+    data?: any
+  ): void => {
+    const newLog: LogEntry = {
+      id: generateLogId(),
+      timestamp: formatTimestamp(),
+      level,
+      message,
+      context,
+      data,
+    };
+
+    setLogs(prevLogs => {
+      // Debug: Monitor state changes in development
+      if (LOG_CONFIG.ENABLE_DEBUG_LOGS) {
+        // eslint-disable-next-line no-console
+        // console.log(`useLogStorage addLog: newLog=`, newLog);
+      }
+
+      // Add new log at the beginning and limit total count
+      const updatedLogs = [newLog, ...prevLogs].slice(0, MAX_LOGS);
+
+      // Save to storage asynchronously
+      saveLogs(updatedLogs);
+
+      return updatedLogs;
+    });
+  }, [generateLogId, formatTimestamp, saveLogs]);
+
+  // Clear all logs
+  const clearLogs = useCallback((): void => {
+    setLogs([]);
+    saveLogs([]);
+  }, [saveLogs]);
+
+  // Copy logs to clipboard - Read directly from storage to avoid React state timing issues
+  const copyLogsToClipboard = useCallback(async (): Promise<boolean> => {
+    try {
+      // Read fresh logs directly from storage to avoid React state async issues
+      const storedLogs = await storage.getItem(LOG_STORAGE_KEY, true);
+      const freshLogs = (storedLogs && Array.isArray(storedLogs)) ? storedLogs : [];
+
+      // Debug: Monitor clipboard operation with fresh logs
+      if (LOG_CONFIG.ENABLE_DEBUG_LOGS) {
+        // eslint-disable-next-line no-console
+        console.log(`useLogStorage copyLogsToClipboard: React state logs.length=${logs.length}`);
+        // eslint-disable-next-line no-console
+        console.log(`useLogStorage copyLogsToClipboard: Fresh storage logs.length=${freshLogs.length}`);
+        // eslint-disable-next-line no-console
+        console.log('useLogStorage copyLogsToClipboard: freshLogs=', freshLogs);
+      }
+
+      if (freshLogs.length === 0) {
+        if (LOG_CONFIG.ENABLE_DEBUG_LOGS) {
+          // eslint-disable-next-line no-console
+          console.log('useLogStorage copyLogsToClipboard: No logs to copy');
+        }
+        return false;
+      }
+
+      // Format logs as readable text using fresh logs from storage
+      const logText = freshLogs
+        .map(log => {
+          const timestamp = new Date(log.timestamp).toLocaleString();
+          const contextStr = log.context ? ` [${log.context}]` : '';
+          const dataStr = log.data ? `\nData: ${JSON.stringify(log.data, null, 2)}` : '';
+          return `[${timestamp}] ${log.level.toUpperCase()}${contextStr}: ${log.message}${dataStr}`;
+        })
+        .join('\n\n');
+
+      // Add header with metadata
+      const header = `=== CSX Mobile Logs ===\nTotal: ${freshLogs.length} entries\nExported: ${new Date().toLocaleString()}\n\n`;
+      const finalText = header + logText;
+
+      if (LOG_CONFIG.ENABLE_DEBUG_LOGS) {
+        // eslint-disable-next-line no-console
+        console.log(`useLogStorage copyLogsToClipboard: Successfully formatted ${freshLogs.length} logs`);
+      }
+
+      //https://app.clickup.com/t/8553538/TECH-7025
+      if (global.env === 'poc') {
+        await Clipboard.setString(finalText);
+      }
+
+      // Auto-clear logs after successful copy
+      if (LOG_CONFIG.ENABLE_DEBUG_LOGS) {
+        // eslint-disable-next-line no-console
+        console.log('useLogStorage copyLogsToClipboard: Clearing logs after successful copy');
+      }
+
+      setLogs([]);
+      await saveLogs([]);
+
+      if (LOG_CONFIG.ENABLE_DEBUG_LOGS) {
+        // eslint-disable-next-line no-console
+        console.log('useLogStorage copyLogsToClipboard: Logs cleared successfully');
+      }
+
+      return true;
+    } catch (error) {
+      if (LOG_CONFIG.ENABLE_DEBUG_LOGS) {
+        // eslint-disable-next-line no-console
+        console.error('useLogStorage copyLogsToClipboard: Error copying logs:', error);
+      }
+      return false;
+    }
+  }, [logs, saveLogs]); // Keep logs for debug info, but main logic uses freshLogs from storage
+
+  // Get log count
+  const getLogCount = useCallback((): number => {
+    return logs.length;
+  }, [logs]);
+
+  // Refresh logs from storage with force reload option
+  const refreshLogs = useCallback((): void => {
+    if (__DEV__) {
+      // eslint-disable-next-line no-console
+      console.log('useLogStorage refreshLogs: Force reloading logs from storage');
+    }
+    loadLogs();
+  }, [loadLogs]);
+
+  // Force refresh logs from storage
+  const forceRefreshLogs = useCallback(async (): Promise<void> => {
+    try {
+      if (LOG_CONFIG.ENABLE_DEBUG_LOGS) {
+        // eslint-disable-next-line no-console
+        console.log('useLogStorage forceRefreshLogs: Force reloading logs from storage');
+      }
+
+      const storedLogs = await storage.getItem(LOG_STORAGE_KEY, true);
+      const existingLogs = (storedLogs && Array.isArray(storedLogs)) ? storedLogs : [];
+
+      if (LOG_CONFIG.ENABLE_DEBUG_LOGS) {
+        // eslint-disable-next-line no-console
+        console.log(`useLogStorage forceRefreshLogs: Found ${existingLogs.length} logs in storage`);
+      }
+
+      setLogs(existingLogs);
+    } catch (error) {
+      if (LOG_CONFIG.ENABLE_DEBUG_LOGS) {
+        // eslint-disable-next-line no-console
+        console.error('useLogStorage forceRefreshLogs: Error loading logs:', error);
+      }
+      setLogs([]);
+    }
+  }, []);
+
+  // Global event handlers for adding logs from anywhere
+  const handleGlobalAddLog = useCallback((params: {
+    level: LogEntry['level'];
+    message: string;
+    context?: string;
+    data?: any;
+  }) => {
+    addLog(params.level, params.message, params.context, params.data);
+  }, [addLog]);
+
+  const handleGlobalClearLogs = useCallback(() => {
+    clearLogs();
+  }, [clearLogs]);
+
+  const handleGlobalRefreshLogs = useCallback(() => {
+    refreshLogs();
+  }, [refreshLogs]);
+
+  // Set up global event listeners
+  useGlobalEventListener(LOG_EVENTS.ADD_LOG, handleGlobalAddLog);
+  useGlobalEventListener(LOG_EVENTS.CLEAR_LOGS, handleGlobalClearLogs);
+  useGlobalEventListener(LOG_EVENTS.REFRESH_LOGS, handleGlobalRefreshLogs);
+
+  // Load logs on mount
+  useEffect(() => {
+    loadLogs();
+  }, [loadLogs]);
+
+  return {
+    logs,
+    addLog,
+    clearLogs,
+    copyLogsToClipboard,
+    getLogCount,
+    refreshLogs,
+    forceRefreshLogs,
+  };
+};
+
+// Global utility functions for adding logs from anywhere without using the hook
+export const logUtils = {
+  /**
+   * Add log from anywhere in the app using global events
+   * Usage: logUtils.addLog('info', 'User logged in', 'LoginPage');
+   */
+  addLog: (level: LogEntry['level'], message: string, context?: string, data?: any) => {
+    // Import globalEventEmitter directly to avoid hook dependency
+    import('tools/globalEventEmitter.ts').then(({default: globalEventEmitter}) => {
+      globalEventEmitter.emit(LOG_EVENTS.ADD_LOG, {level, message, context, data});
+    });
+  },
+
+  /**
+   * Clear all logs from anywhere in the app
+   */
+  clearLogs: () => {
+    import('tools/globalEventEmitter.ts').then(({default: globalEventEmitter}) => {
+      globalEventEmitter.emit(LOG_EVENTS.CLEAR_LOGS);
+    });
+  },
+
+  /**
+   * Refresh logs from storage
+   */
+  refreshLogs: () => {
+    import('tools/globalEventEmitter.ts').then(({default: globalEventEmitter}) => {
+      globalEventEmitter.emit(LOG_EVENTS.REFRESH_LOGS);
+    });
+  },
+};
+
+export default useLogStorage;

+# useLogStorage Hook Usage Examples
+
+## Overview
+`useLogStorage` is a global log storage Hook that supports adding logs from anywhere in the application and provides the ability to copy logs to the clipboard.
+
+## Features
+- ✅ Global log storage and management
+- ✅ Support for multiple log levels (info, warn, error, debug)
+- ✅ Persistent storage (based on AsyncStorage)
+- ✅ Global event system integration, supports adding logs from anywhere
+- ✅ One-click copy all logs to clipboard
+- ✅ **Auto-clear logs after copying** (new feature)
+- ✅ Automatic log limit (maximum 1000 entries)
+- ✅ **Development environment debug monitoring** (new feature)
+- ✅ **Force refresh logs functionality** (new feature)  
+- ✅ Complete TypeScript support
+
+## Basic Usage
+
+### 1. Using Hook in Components
+
+```typescript
+import React from 'react';
+import { View, Button, Text, ScrollView } from 'react-native';
+import { useLogStorage } from 'useHooks';
+
+const LoggingComponent: React.FC = () => {
+  const { 
+    logs, 
+    addLog, 
+    clearLogs, 
+    copyLogsToClipboard, 
+    getLogCount,
+    forceRefreshLogs  // New: Force refresh logs functionality
+  } = useLogStorage();
+
+  const handleAddInfoLog = () => {
+    addLog('info', 'User clicked button', 'LoggingComponent', { buttonId: 'test-button' });
+  };
+
+  const handleAddErrorLog = () => {
+    addLog('error', 'Simulated error message', 'LoggingComponent', { errorCode: 500 });
+  };
+
+  const handleCopyLogs = async () => {
+    const success = await copyLogsToClipboard();
+    if (success) {
+      addLog('info', 'Logs successfully copied to clipboard', 'LoggingComponent');
+    } else {
+      addLog('error', 'Failed to copy logs to clipboard', 'LoggingComponent');
+    }
+  };
+
+  return (
+    <View style={{ padding: 20 }}>
+      <Text>Total logs: {getLogCount()}</Text>
+      
+      <Button title="Add Info Log" onPress={handleAddInfoLog} />
+      <Button title="Add Error Log" onPress={handleAddErrorLog} />
+      <Button title="Copy Logs to Clipboard" onPress={handleCopyLogs} />
+      <Button title="Clear All Logs" onPress={clearLogs} />
+      
+      <ScrollView style={{ height: 300, marginTop: 20 }}>
+        {logs.map(log => (
+          <View key={log.id} style={{ marginBottom: 10, padding: 10, backgroundColor: '#f5f5f5' }}>
+            <Text style={{ fontWeight: 'bold' }}>
+              [{log.level.toUpperCase()}] {log.context}
+            </Text>
+            <Text>{log.message}</Text>
+            <Text style={{ fontSize: 12, color: '#666' }}>
+              {new Date(log.timestamp).toLocaleString()}
+            </Text>
+            {log.data && (
+              <Text style={{ fontSize: 12, color: '#888' }}>
+                Data: {JSON.stringify(log.data)}
+              </Text>
+            )}
+          </View>
+        ))}
+      </ScrollView>
+    </View>
+  );
+};
+
+export default LoggingComponent;
+```
+
+### 2. Adding Logs from Anywhere (without using Hook)
+
+```typescript
+import { logUtils } from 'useHooks/useLogStorage';
+
+// Use in any function
+const handleUserLogin = async (username: string) => {
+  try {
+    logUtils.addLog('info', `User ${username} attempting login`, 'AuthService');
+    
+    const result = await loginAPI(username);
+    
+    logUtils.addLog('info', `User ${username} login successful`, 'AuthService', { userId: result.id });
+  } catch (error) {
+    logUtils.addLog('error', `User ${username} login failed`, 'AuthService', { error: error.message });
+  }
+};
+
+// Use in API calls
+const apiCall = async () => {
+  logUtils.addLog('debug', 'Starting API call', 'APIService', { endpoint: '/api/data' });
+  
+  try {
+    const response = await fetch('/api/data');
+    logUtils.addLog('info', 'API call successful', 'APIService', { status: response.status });
+  } catch (error) {
+    logUtils.addLog('error', 'API call failed', 'APIService', { error: error.message });
+  }
+};
+```

+### 3. Using Global Event System
+
+```typescript
+import { useGlobalEventEmitter, globalEventName } from 'tools/useGlobalEventEmitter';
+import { LOG_EVENTS } from 'useHooks/useLogStorage';
+
+const SomeComponent: React.FC = () => {
+  const emitEvent = useGlobalEventEmitter();
+
+  const handleSomeAction = () => {
+    // Add log using global events
+    emitEvent(LOG_EVENTS.ADD_LOG, {
+      level: 'info',
+      message: 'Executed some action',
+      context: 'SomeComponent',
+      data: { actionType: 'button_click' }
+    });
+  };
+
+  const handleClearAllLogs = () => {
+    // Clear all logs
+    emitEvent(LOG_EVENTS.CLEAR_LOGS);
+  };
+
+  return (
+    <View>
+      <Button title="Execute Action and Log" onPress={handleSomeAction} />
+      <Button title="Clear All Logs" onPress={handleClearAllLogs} />
+    </View>
+  );
+};
+```

+## Log Level Description
+
+| Level | Purpose | Example Scenarios |
+|-------|---------|-------------------|
+| `info` | General information | User actions, state changes |
+| `warn` | Warning information | Non-fatal errors, performance warnings |
+| `error` | Error information | API failures, exception handling |
+| `debug` | Debug information | Development debugging, detailed flow |

+## Auto-Clear Logs After Copy
+
+### 🆕 Feature Description
+Starting from the current version, the `copyLogsToClipboard` function of the `useLogStorage` Hook adds the functionality to automatically clear logs after successful copying. This means:
+
+- **Every time logs are successfully copied to the clipboard, all logs will be automatically cleared**
+- **Ensures that after users get log backups, storage space is freed**
+- **Avoids duplicating the same log content**
+- **Provides a cleaner debugging experience**
+
+### 🔍 How It Works
+1. **Log Copying**: `copyLogsToClipboard` formats all logs and copies them to the system clipboard
+2. **Copy Success**: Confirms that the clipboard operation completed successfully
+3. **Auto Clear**: Clears log state in memory (`setLogs([])`)
+4. **Clear Cache**: Also clears log cache in storage (`saveLogs([])`)
+5. **Debug Output**: Outputs detailed logs of clear operations in development environment
+
+### 📝 Usage Notes
+- **No Manual Operation Required**: This feature runs completely automatically, developers need no additional code
+- **Data Safety**: Important log information should be copied via `copyLogsToClipboard()` before app closure
+- **Debug Friendly**: Each restart provides a clean log environment for problem identification
+
+### 🧪 Testing Method
+```typescript
+// Steps to test app restart log clearing functionality:
+// 1. Add some logs in the app
+const { addLog, logs } = useLogStorage();
+addLog('info', 'Test log 1', 'TestComponent');
+addLog('warn', 'Test log 2', 'TestComponent');
+console.log('Current log count:', logs.length); // Should display 2
+
+// 2. Completely close the app (not switch to background)
+// 3. Restart the app
+// 4. Check log count
+console.log('Log count after restart:', logs.length); // Should display 0
+```
+
+## Performance Considerations
+
+1. **Log Count Limit**: Automatically limited to a maximum of 1000 logs, automatically deletes oldest logs when exceeded
+2. **Async Storage**: All storage operations are asynchronous and do not block UI
+3. **Memory Management**: Uses useCallback to optimize performance, avoiding unnecessary re-renders
+4. **Session Detection**: Session detection only executes once during Hook initialization, does not affect runtime performance
+
+## Best Practices
+
+1. **Reasonable Use of Log Levels**: Choose appropriate log levels based on information importance
+2. **Provide Context**: Always provide context parameter for easier problem identification
+3. **Structured Data**: Use data parameter to pass structured information
+4. **Avoid Sensitive Information**: Do not record passwords, tokens, or other sensitive information in logs
+5. **Moderate Recording**: Avoid excessive log recording that affects performance
+
+## Troubleshooting
+
+If you encounter problems, you can:
+
+1. Check console output, the Hook will print debug information
+2. Confirm that the Hook is correctly imported and used
+3. Verify that the global event system is working normally
+4. Check AsyncStorage permission settings
+
+## Type Definitions
+
+```typescript
+interface LogEntry {
+  id: string;
+  timestamp: string;
+  level: 'info' | 'warn' | 'error' | 'debug';
+  message: string;
+  context?: string;
+  data?: any;
+}
+
+interface UseLogStorageReturn {
+  logs: LogEntry[];
+  addLog: (level: LogEntry['level'], message: string, context?: string, data?: any) => void;
+  clearLogs: () => void;
+  copyLogsToClipboard: () => Promise<boolean>;
+  getLogCount: () => number;
+  refreshLogs: () => void;
+  forceRefreshLogs: () => Promise<void>;  // New: Force refresh functionality
+}
+```

+## 🔧 Problem Fixes and Optimizations
+
+### Fixed Issues
+
+#### ❌ Problem: logs is empty array in copyLogsToClipboard
+**Symptoms**: Although `addLog` was called multiple times, the `logs` in the `copyLogsToClipboard` function was always an empty array `[]`.
+
+**Root Causes**:
+1. ~~Session detection too aggressive~~: Session detection executed every Hook initialization (deprecated)
+2. ~~Component re-rendering triggers clearing~~: React component re-rendering caused logs to be accidentally cleared (deprecated)
+3. ~~Storage read failure~~: Default to clear logs when storage access errors occur (deprecated)
+4. **🎯 React State Async Update Issue**: When `copyLogsToClipboard` executes immediately after `addLog` calls `setLogs`, React state has not finished updating
+
+#### ✅ Final Solution
+
+**🚀 Complete Fix: Read Logs Directly from Storage**
+```typescript
+const copyLogsToClipboard = useCallback(async (): Promise<boolean> => {
+  try {
+    // Read fresh logs directly from storage to avoid React state async issues
+    const storedLogs = await storage.getItem(LOG_STORAGE_KEY, true);
+    const freshLogs = (storedLogs && Array.isArray(storedLogs)) ? storedLogs : [];
+
+    if (freshLogs.length === 0) {
+      return false;
+    }
+
+    // Format logs using fresh logs from storage
+    const logText = freshLogs.map(log => {
+      // Formatting logic...
+    }).join('\n\n');
+
+    await Clipboard.setString(finalText);
+    
+    // Clear after successful copy
+    setLogs([]);
+    await saveLogs([]);
+    
+    return true;
+  } catch (error) {
+    return false;
+  }
+}, [logs, saveLogs]);
+```
+
+**Core Improvements**:
+1. **Direct Storage Access**: Does not depend on potentially outdated React state
+2. **Real-time Data**: Reads the latest storage data every time copying
+3. **Async Safe**: Avoids state update timing issues
+4. **Debug Enhancement**: Shows comparison between React state and storage state simultaneously
+
+### New Features
+
+#### 🆕 Force Refresh Logs Functionality
+```typescript
+const { forceRefreshLogs } = useLogStorage();
+
+// Bypass session detection, force load logs from storage
+await forceRefreshLogs();
+```
+
+#### 🆕 Development Environment Debug Monitoring
+- Automatically records detailed information about log operations
+- Monitors session detection process
+- Tracks state changes and storage operations
+
+### Usage Recommendations
+
+**When Debugging Log Issues**:
+1. Check development environment console debug output
+2. Use `forceRefreshLogs()` to force reload
+3. Check if `getLogCount()` return value is correct
+
+**Avoid Log Loss**:
+1. Important logs should be backed up using `copyLogsToClipboard()` in time
+2. Avoid frequent component re-mounting
+3. Ensure global variables are correctly initialized
+
+### Technical Details
+
+**Session Detection Flow**:
+```
+App Start → Generate Session ID → Hook Initialization → Check Session Flag → 
+First Time: Execute Session Detection → Mark as Checked → Load/Clear Logs
+Subsequent: Skip Session Detection → Directly Load Logs
+```
+
+**State Management Optimization**:
+- Use `useCallback` to optimize performance
+- Async operations do not block UI updates  
+- Error handling ensures state consistency

+}

+/**
+ * import {useMomentFormatStr, getTimezoneDifference} from 'useHooks/useMomentFormatStr'
+ * 计算给定时间字符串与时区偏移量与当前设备时间的时区差值
+ * @param dateString - 类似 "2025-11-26T17:48:41.5560000+11:00" 的时间字符串
+ * @returns 包含时区差值、当前时区名称和传入时间时区名称的对象，如果时区相同则返回null
+ */
+export const getTimezoneDifference = (dateString: string): {
+  differenceInHours: number;
+  currentTimezoneName: string;
+  givenTimezoneName: string;
+  currentTimezoneOffset: string;
+  givenTimezoneOffset: string;
+} | null => {
+  try {
+    // 使用 moment.parseZone 来解析带时区信息的时间字符串
+    const givenMoment = moment.parseZone(dateString);
+
+    // 获取当前时间的 moment 对象
+    const currentMoment = moment();
+
+    // 获取两个时间的 UTC 偏移量（分钟）
+    const givenOffset = givenMoment.utcOffset(); // 给定时间的 UTC 偏移（分钟）
+    const currentOffset = currentMoment.utcOffset(); // 当前时间的 UTC 偏移（分钟）
+
+    // 如果时区相同，返回null
+    if (givenOffset === currentOffset) {
+      return null;
+    }
+
+    // 计算时区差值（分钟）
+    const offsetDifferenceMinutes = givenOffset - currentOffset;
+
+    // 转换为小时
+    const offsetDifferenceHours = offsetDifferenceMinutes / 60;
+
+    // 格式化时区偏移显示
+    const formatOffset = (offset: number): string => {
+      const hours = Math.floor(Math.abs(offset) / 60);
+      const minutes = Math.abs(offset) % 60;
+      const sign = offset >= 0 ? '+' : '-';
+      return `${sign}${hours.toString().padStart(2, '0')}:${minutes.toString().padStart(2, '0')}`;
+    };
+
+    // 获取时区名称（基于偏移量的通用名称）
+    const getTimezoneName = (offset: number): string => {
+      const hours = Math.floor(Math.abs(offset) / 60);
+      const minutes = Math.abs(offset) % 60;
+      const sign = offset >= 0 ? '+' : '-';
+
+      if (minutes === 0) {
+        return `UTC${sign}${hours}`;
+      } else if (minutes === 30) {
+        return `UTC${sign}${hours}:30`;
+      } else if (minutes === 45) {
+        return `UTC${sign}${hours}:45`;
+      } else {
+        return `UTC${sign}${hours}:${minutes.toString().padStart(2, '0')}`;
+      }
+    };
+
+    return {
+      differenceInHours: offsetDifferenceHours,
+      currentTimezoneName: getTimezoneName(currentOffset),
+      givenTimezoneName: getTimezoneName(givenOffset),
+      currentTimezoneOffset: formatOffset(currentOffset),
+      givenTimezoneOffset: formatOffset(givenOffset)
+    };
+  } catch (error) {
+    console.error('计算时区差值时出错:', error);
+    return null;
+  }
+};

+/**
+ * Custom hook that executes a task every 30 seconds after app startup
+ * import { usePeriodicTask } from '~useHooks';
+ * const { isAppReady, taskCount, executeCustomTask } = usePeriodicTask();
+ */
+export const usePeriodicTask = () => {
+  const [isAppReady, setIsAppReady] = useState(false);
+  const [taskCount, setTaskCount] = useState(0);
+  const intervalRef = useRef<NodeJS.Timeout | null>(null);
+  const emitEvent = useGlobalEventEmitter();
+  // 添加已处理的预约ID列表状态
+  const [processedAppointmentIds, setProcessedAppointmentIds] = useState<Set<string>>(new Set());
+  // 添加延迟执行的引用
+  const delayedExecutionRef = useRef<NodeJS.Timeout | null>(null);
+  const dispatch = useDispatch();
+
+  // 监听用户点击"稍后"的事件
+  useGlobalEventListener(globalEventName.videoCallLater, useCallback(() => {
+    console.log('usePeriodicTask: 用户点击了稍后');
+
+    // 清除现有的延迟执行（如果有的话）
+    if (delayedExecutionRef.current) {
+      clearTimeout(delayedExecutionRef.current);
+      delayedExecutionRef.current = null;
+    }
+
+    delayedExecutionRef.current = setTimeout(() => {
+      executeCustomTask().then();
+      delayedExecutionRef.current = null;
+    }, 30000);
+  }, []));
+
+  // Cleanup on unmount
+  useEffect(() => {
+    console.log('usePeriodicTask mount');
+    setTimeout(async () => {
+      await executeCustomTask()
+    }, 5000);
+    return () => {
+      if (intervalRef.current) {
+        clearInterval(intervalRef.current);
+      }
+      if (delayedExecutionRef.current) {
+        clearTimeout(delayedExecutionRef.current);
+      }
+      if (intervalRef.current) {
+        clearInterval(intervalRef.current);
+      }
+    };
+  }, []);
+
+  // Monitor app state to detect when app is active
+  useEffect(() => {
+    const handleAppStateChange = (nextAppState: AppStateStatus) => {
+      if (nextAppState === 'active' && !isAppReady) {
+        setIsAppReady(true);
+      }
+    };
+
+    // Set app as ready if already active
+    if (AppState.currentState === 'active') {
+      setIsAppReady(true);
+    }
+
+    const subscription = AppState.addEventListener('change', handleAppStateChange);
+
+    return () => {
+      subscription?.remove();
+    };
+  }, [isAppReady]);
+
+  // Start periodic task execution after app is ready
+  useEffect(() => {
+    console.log('usePeriodicTask isAppReady=', isAppReady);
+    if (isAppReady) {
+      if (intervalRef.current) {
+        clearInterval(intervalRef.current);
+      }
+
+      // Execute the custom task immediately when app becomes ready
+      executeCustomTask().then();
+
+      // Set up interval to execute task every 30 seconds
+      intervalRef.current = setInterval(() => {
+        executeCustomTask().then();
+      }, 30000);
+    }
+
+    return () => {
+      if (intervalRef.current) {
+        clearInterval(intervalRef.current);
+        intervalRef.current = null;
+      }
+    };
+  }, [isAppReady]);
+
+  useEffect(() => {
+    console.log('usePeriodicTask useEffect global.curClinicData=', global.curClinicData);
+    console.log('usePeriodicTask useEffect global.curDoctorData=', global.curDoctorData);
+    if (global.curClinicData && global.curDoctorData) {
+      executeCustomTask().then();
+    }
+  }, [global.curClinicData, global.curDoctorData]);
+
+  // Custom task implementation - can be modified based on requirements
+  const executeCustomTask = useCallback(async () => {
+    setTaskCount(prev => prev + 1);
+    // Add your custom logic here
+    console.log(`Periodic task executed - Count: ${taskCount + 1}`);
+    console.log('usePeriodicTask executeCustomTask global.curClinicData=', global.curClinicData);
+    console.log('usePeriodicTask executeCustomTask global.curDoctorData=', global.curDoctorData);
+
+    // if ($fake) {
+    //   return;
+    // }
+
+    if (global.curClinicData && global.curDoctorData) {
+      try {
+        const data: Data | null = await waitingList(
+          global.curClinicData?.id,
+          global.curDoctorData?.id,
+          false,
+          undefined,
+          dispatch
+        );
+
+        console.log('usePeriodicTask waitingList data=', data);
+
+        if (data && data.items.length > 0) {
+          // 过滤掉已经处理过的预约
+          const unprocessedItems = data.items.filter((item: waitingListItem) =>
+            !processedAppointmentIds.has(item.id)
+          );
+
+          const find: waitingListItem | undefined = unprocessedItems.find((item: waitingListItem) =>
+            (item.isVideoConference && item.checkinStatus == 0)
+          );
+
+          if (find) {
+            // 记录已处理的预约ID
+            setProcessedAppointmentIds(prev => {
+              const newSet = new Set(prev);
+              newSet.add(find.id);
+              return newSet;
+            });
+
+            PopupPrompt(find);
+          }
+        }
+      } catch (error) {
+        console.error('usePeriodicTask executeCustomTask error:', error);
+      }
+    }
+  }, [taskCount, processedAppointmentIds, dispatch]);
+
+  const PopupPrompt = useCallback((data: waitingListItem) => {
+    console.log('usePeriodicTask PopupPrompt isNavigationReady()=', isNavigationReady());
+
+    // Get current route stack information using global navigation reference
+    if (isNavigationReady()) {
+      // Method 1: Get complete navigation state (includes full route stack)
+      const navigationState = getNavigationState();
+      console.log('Current navigation state:', navigationState);
+
+      if (navigationState) {
+        console.log('Current route index:', navigationState.index);
+        console.log('Current route name:', navigationState.routes[navigationState.index]?.name);
+
+        let routeName = navigationState.routes[navigationState.index]?.name;
+
+        if (routeName === 'MainTabNavigator') {
+          routeName = global.navigationRef?.getCurrentRouteName() || '';
+          const route = global.navigationRef?.getCurrentRoute();
+          const state = global.navigationRef?.getNavigationState();
+          console.log('usePeriodicTask PopupPrompt route=', route);
+          console.log('usePeriodicTask PopupPrompt state=', state);
+        }
+
+        console.log('usePeriodicTask PopupPrompt routeName=', routeName);
+
+        if (routeName !== routes.AgoraVideoCall.routeName &&
+          routeName !== routes.CreateConsultationPage.routeName &&
+          routeName !== routes.LoginPage.routeName) {
+
+          console.log('usePeriodicTask PopupPrompt navigationState.routes[navigationState.index]?.name=', routeName);
+          // Show video call invite modal
+          emitEvent(globalEventName.showVideoCallInviteModal, data);
+        }
+      }
+    } else {
+      console.log('Navigation is not ready or available');
+    }
+  }, [emitEvent]);
+
+  // 提供重置已处理预约的方法
+  const resetProcessedAppointments = useCallback(() => {
+    setProcessedAppointmentIds(new Set());
+  }, []);
+
+  return {
+    isAppReady,
+    taskCount,
+    executeCustomTask,
+    resetProcessedAppointments,
+  };
+};
+
+export default usePeriodicTask;

+/**
+ * Global Push Notification Handler Hook
+ * Automatically handles push notification processing without requiring implementation in individual components
+ *
+ * This hook:
+ * - Uses the Firebase Messaging hook to receive notifications
+ * - Automatically processes and clears notifications
+ * - Leverages the existing PushNotificationService for all notification handling logic
+ *
+ * Usage: Simply call this hook at the app level (e.g., in AppProvider)
+ * No parameters needed - it handles everything automatically
+ */
+const usePushNotificationHandler = (): void => {
+  const {notification, clearNotification} = useFirebaseMessaging();
+  const {
+    setShowCommonAlertModal,

+  const ref_notification = useRef<RemoteMessage | undefined>();
+  const emitEvent = useGlobalEventEmitter();
+  const {mode, uiTheme, setMode} = useThemeProvider();
+
+  const detectFingerprintAvailable = () => {
+    FingerprintScanner
+      .isSensorAvailable()
+      .then(async (biometryType) => {
+        console.log('detectFingerprintAvailable biometryType=', biometryType)
+        addLog('info', 'detectFingerprintAvailable biometryType=', '', biometryType);
+
+        // Emit global event to show biometric authentication popup
+        emitEvent(globalEventName.showBiometricAuthPopup, {
+          biometryType, onSuccess: async () => {
+            console.log('detectFingerprintAvailable onSuccess ref_notification.current.data?.bizType=', ref_notification.current?.data?.bizType)
+            addLog('info', 'detectFingerprintAvailable onSuccess ref_notification.current.data?.bizType=', '', ref_notification.current?.data?.bizType);
+            try {
+              if (ref_notification.current?.data?.bizType == 'TRUSTED_DEVICE_REGISTER_REQUEST') {
+                const deviceId = await DeviceInfo.getUniqueId();
+                const deviceModel = DeviceInfo.getModel();
+                const deviceOS = Platform.OS + ' ' + Platform.Version;
+                const keys = generateKeys();
+                console.log('detectFingerprintAvailable keys=', logKeysForVerification(keys));
+                if (keys.publicKey) {
+                  await storage.setItem(`storage.csxMobileCachekeys.trusted_devices_publicKey|${curAccount?.username}`, keys.publicKey);
+                }
+                if (keys.privateKey) {
+                  await storage.setItem(`${storage.csxMobileCachekeys.trusted_devices_privateKey}|${curAccount?.username}`, keys.privateKey);
+                }
+                let publicKey = keys.publicKey
+                console.log('detectFingerprintAvailable publicKey=', publicKey)
+                let deviceFingerprint = ''
+                /*
+                Generate deviceFingerprint using HMAC-SHA256 following backend Python example
+                RSA-vs-HMAC-SHA256-comparison.md
+                 不建议使用 keys.privateKey 作为 HMAC-SHA256 的密钥，原因如下：
+                  1. 密钥类型不匹配
+                    - HMAC-SHA256 需要对称密钥（共享密钥）
+                    - RSA privateKey 是非对称加密的私钥，设计用途不同
+                  2. 后端验证问题
+                    - 后端只接收 publicKey，无法使用它来验证 HMAC
+                    - HMAC 验证需要相同的密钥
+                  3. 安全考虑
+                    - 固定密钥虽然所有设备相同，但可以由后端安全管理
+                    - 使用 privateKey 作为 HMAC 密钥可能暴露私钥的使用模式
+                 */
+                const secretKey = '0oYv|m?jL82Zm32i&EwcE,#<gEnQ<l8J'; // Secret key for HMAC
+                // Generate hierarchical hashes similar to Python implementation
+                // hardware_id = hash(cpu_id + baseband_id)
+                const hardwareInfo = `${deviceId}|${deviceModel}`;
+                const hardwareId = CryptoJS.HmacSHA256(hardwareInfo, secretKey).toString();
+                // software_id = hash(os_version + security_patch)
+                const softwareInfo = `${Platform.OS}|${Platform.Version}`;
+                const softwareId = CryptoJS.HmacSHA256(softwareInfo, secretKey).toString();
+                // app_signature = hash(app_certificate + app_version)
+                const appVersion = DeviceInfo.getVersion();
+                const appBuildNumber = DeviceInfo.getBuildNumber();
+                const appInfo = `${appVersion}|${appBuildNumber}`;
+                const appSignature = CryptoJS.HmacSHA256(appInfo, secretKey).toString();
+                // timestamp_hash for additional uniqueness
+                const timestamp = Date.now().toString();
+                const timestampHash = CryptoJS.HmacSHA256(timestamp, secretKey).toString();
+                // Final deviceFingerprint = hash(hardware_id + software_id + app_signature + timestamp_hash)
+                const finalFingerprintMessage = `${hardwareId}|${softwareId}|${appSignature}|${timestampHash}`;
+                console.log('detectFingerprintAvailable finalFingerprintMessage=', finalFingerprintMessage)
+                deviceFingerprint = CryptoJS.HmacSHA256(finalFingerprintMessage, secretKey).toString(CryptoJS.enc.Hex);
+                console.log('detectFingerprintAvailable deviceFingerprint=', deviceFingerprint)

+                  "publicKey": publicKey,

+                }
+              } else if (ref_notification.current?.data?.bizType === 'TRUSTED_DEVICE_REMOVE_REQUEST') {

+                const deviceModel = DeviceInfo.getModel();

+                /*
+                Generate deviceFingerprint using HMAC-SHA256 following backend Python example

+                    - HMAC-SHA256 需要对称密钥（共享密钥）

+                  2. 后端验证问题
+                    - 后端只接收 publicKey，无法使用它来验证 HMAC

+                  3. 安全考虑
+                    - 固定密钥虽然所有设备相同，但可以由后端安全管理
+                    - 使用 privateKey 作为 HMAC 密钥可能暴露私钥的使用模式

+                // Generate hierarchical hashes similar to Python implementation

+                const appBuildNumber = DeviceInfo.getBuildNumber();

+                await trusted_devices_fingerprint({

+        setTextComponent(undefined);
+        setShowCommonAlertModal(true);
+        refOnConfirm.current = async () => {
+          // 
+        };
+      }
+      clearNotification();
+    }
+  }, [notification, clearNotification, setCommonAlertModalTitle, setCommonAlertModalContent, setCommonAlertModalConfirmTxt, setCommonAlertModalCancelTxt, setShowCommonAlertModal, refOnConfirm, curAccount, detectFingerprintAvailable, uiTheme]);
+};

+import { useSelector, useDispatch } from 'react-redux';
+import { SET_TIMEZONE_ALERT_SHOWN } from '/actions/action-types';
+
+export const useTimezoneAlert = () => {
+  const timezoneAlertShown = useSelector((state: any) => state.user.timezoneAlertShown);
+  const dispatch = useDispatch();
+
+  const setTimezoneAlert = (shown: boolean) => {
+    dispatch({
+      type: SET_TIMEZONE_ALERT_SHOWN,
+      payload: shown,
+    });
+  };
+
+  return {
+    timezoneAlertShown,
+    setTimezoneAlert,
+  };
+};

+/**
+ * Sentry error monitoring configuration
+ * Used for tracking login failures and other critical errors
+ */
+
+import * as Sentry from '@sentry/react-native';
+import DeviceInfo from 'react-native-device-info';
+import { Platform } from 'react-native';
+
+interface SentryConfig {
+  dsn: string;
+  environment: 'development' | 'poc' | 'production';
+  debug: boolean;
+  tracesSampleRate: number;
+  attachScreenshot: boolean;
+  beforeSend?: (event: any, hint: any) => any;
+}
+
+// Sentry configuration - replace with your actual DSN from stark-ex.sentry.io
+const SENTRY_DSN = 'https://ba7f32efd1c9a9dadb373a3c43aa00d2@o4509903274508288.ingest.us.sentry.io/4509903283879936';
+
+/**
+ * Initialize Sentry for error monitoring
+ * @param config Optional configuration overrides
+ */
+export const initSentry = (config?: Partial<SentryConfig>) => {
+  console.log('Initializing Sentry...');
+  console.log('  - DSN:', SENTRY_DSN);
+  console.log('  - Environment:', __DEV__ ? 'development' : global.env || 'production');
+  console.log('  - Debug mode:', __DEV__);
+  
+  const defaultConfig: SentryConfig = {
+    dsn: SENTRY_DSN,
+    environment: __DEV__ ? 'development' : global.env || 'production',
+    debug: true, // Always enable debug to see what's happening
+    tracesSampleRate: 1.0, // Always capture traces for debugging
+    attachScreenshot: true,
+    beforeSend: (event, hint) => {
+      console.log('Sentry beforeSend called with event:', {
+        level: event.level,
+        message: event.message,
+        exception: event.exception,
+        tags: event.tags,
+        environment: event.environment
+      });
+      
+      // Don't filter anything during debugging - send all errors
+      console.log('Sentry event approved for sending');
+      return event;
+    },
+  };
+
+  const finalConfig = { ...defaultConfig, ...config };
+
+  try {
+    Sentry.init({
+      dsn: finalConfig.dsn,
+      environment: finalConfig.environment,
+      debug: finalConfig.debug,
+      tracesSampleRate: finalConfig.tracesSampleRate,
+      attachScreenshot: finalConfig.attachScreenshot,
+      beforeSend: finalConfig.beforeSend,
+      integrations: [
+        Sentry.reactNativeTracingIntegration(),
+      ],
+      // Add transport configuration for better debugging
+      transport: undefined, // Use default transport
+    });
+    
+    console.log('Sentry initialized successfully');
+    console.log('Sentry v6 - Initialization complete. Ready for error capturing.');
+    
+    // Set initial user context
+    setUserContext();
+    
+    // Test Sentry connection immediately after initialization
+    console.log('Testing Sentry connection...');
+    Sentry.addBreadcrumb({
+      message: 'Sentry initialized successfully',
+      category: 'init',
+      level: 'info',
+      data: { timestamp: new Date().toISOString() }
+    });
+    
+  } catch (error) {
+    console.error('Failed to initialize Sentry:', error);
+  }
+};

+/**
+ * Set user context for Sentry
+ * @param userId Optional user ID
+ * @param username Optional username
+ * @param installationId Optional installation ID
+ */
+export const setUserContext = (userId?: string, username?: string, installationId?: string) => {
+  try {
+    const deviceId = DeviceInfo.getUniqueIdSync();
+    const version = DeviceInfo.getVersion();
+    const buildNumber = DeviceInfo.getBuildNumber();
+    const systemVersion = DeviceInfo.getSystemVersion();
+    const model = DeviceInfo.getModel();
+
+    Sentry.setUser({
+      id: userId || deviceId,
+      username: username || 'anonymous',
+      ip_address: '{{auto}}',
+    });
+
+    Sentry.setContext('device', {
+      deviceId,
+      model,
+      systemVersion,
+      platform: Platform.OS,
+      version,
+      buildNumber,
+    });
+
+    if (installationId) {
+      Sentry.setTag('installation_id', installationId);
+    }
+    
+    console.log('Sentry user context set successfully');
+  } catch (error) {
+    console.error('Error setting Sentry user context:', error);
+  }
+};

+/**
+ * Check network connectivity to Sentry servers
+ */
+const checkSentryConnectivity = async (): Promise<boolean> => {
+  console.log('checkSentryConnectivity function called');
+  
+  try {
+    console.log('Checking Sentry server connectivity...');
+    const sentryHost = 'o4509903274508288.ingest.us.sentry.io';
+    
+    // Simple ping-like check to Sentry's ingest endpoint
+    const response = await fetch(`https://${sentryHost}/api/0/envelope/`, {
+      method: 'HEAD',
+      timeout: 5000,
+    }).catch((fetchError) => {
+      console.log('Fetch to Sentry server failed:', fetchError.message);
+      return null;
+    });
+    
+    const isConnected = response !== null;
+    console.log(isConnected ? 'Sentry server is reachable' : 'Cannot reach Sentry servers');
+    return isConnected;
+  } catch (error) {
+    console.log('Network connectivity check failed:', error.message);
+    return false;
+  } finally {
+    console.log('checkSentryConnectivity function completed');
+  }
+};
