+/**
+ * Capture login error with context and enhanced monitoring
+ * @param error The error object
+ * @param context Additional context for the error
+ */
+export const captureLoginError = async (
+  error: Error | any,
+  context: {
+    username?: string;
+    installationId?: string;
+    apiUrl?: string;
+    statusCode?: number;
+    isTimeout?: boolean;
+    isOldAppConflict?: boolean;
+    responseData?: any;
+    // Security: Password metadata (NEVER actual password)
+    passwordProvided?: boolean;
+    passwordLength?: number;
+    usernameLength?: number;
+    installationIdLength?: number;
+    timeoutDetails?: {
+      configuredTimeout: number;
+      actualDuration: number;
+      timeoutType: string;
+      errorName: string;
+      wasAborted: boolean;
+    };
+  }
+) => {
+  const errorMessage = error?.message || error?.toString() || 'Unknown login error';
+  const captureStartTime = Date.now();
+  
+  console.log('captureLoginError called with:', {
+    errorMessage,
+    context,
+    isTimeout: context.isTimeout,
+    sentryAvailable: typeof Sentry !== 'undefined'
+  });
+  
+  // Check network connectivity first
+  console.log('About to call checkSentryConnectivity...');
+  const hasConnectivity = await checkSentryConnectivity();
+  console.log('checkSentryConnectivity returned:', hasConnectivity);
+  
+  if (!hasConnectivity) {
+    console.log('Network connectivity issue detected - events may not reach dashboard');
+  } else {
+    console.log('Network connectivity confirmed - proceeding with error capture');
+  }
+  
+  // Sentry v6 compatibility - skip client checks and use Sentry directly
+  console.log('Using Sentry v6 direct API calls');
+  
+  try {
+    await new Promise((resolve) => {
+      Sentry.withScope((scope) => {
+        console.log('Setting up Sentry scope...');
+        
+        scope.setLevel('error');
+        scope.setTag('error_type', 'login_failure');
+        scope.setTag('is_timeout', context.isTimeout || false);
+        scope.setTag('is_old_app_conflict', context.isOldAppConflict || false);
+        scope.setTag('debug_capture', true); // Add debug flag
+        scope.setTag('connectivity_check', hasConnectivity);
+        scope.setTag('capture_timestamp', captureStartTime);
+
+        // Enhanced timeout tags
+        if (context.isTimeout && context.timeoutDetails) {
+          scope.setTag('timeout_type', context.timeoutDetails.timeoutType);
+          scope.setTag('timeout_error_name', context.timeoutDetails.errorName);
+          scope.setTag('request_was_aborted', context.timeoutDetails.wasAborted);
+        }
+
+        scope.setContext('login_attempt', {
+          username: context.username || 'unknown',
+          installationId: context.installationId || 'unknown',
+          apiUrl: context.apiUrl || 'unknown',
+          statusCode: context.statusCode || 0,
+          timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),
+          deviceTime: DeviceInfo.getDeviceId(),
+        });
+
+        scope.setContext('capture_metadata', {
+          captureStartTime,
+          hasNetworkConnectivity: hasConnectivity,
+          sentryVersion: '6.20.0',
+          platform: Platform.OS,
+          environment: __DEV__ ? 'development' : global.env || 'production',
+        });
+
+        // Security: Only metadata about credentials (NEVER actual password)
+        if (context.passwordProvided !== undefined || context.passwordLength !== undefined) {
+          scope.setContext('credential_metadata', {
+            passwordProvided: context.passwordProvided || false,
+            passwordLength: context.passwordLength || 0,
+            usernameLength: context.usernameLength || 0,
+            installationIdLength: context.installationIdLength || 0,
+            note: 'Actual credentials are NEVER logged for security',
+          });
+          
+          // Add tags for easy filtering
+          scope.setTag('password_provided', context.passwordProvided || false);
+          scope.setTag('credential_lengths_tracked', true);
+        }
+
+        if (context.responseData) {
+          scope.setContext('api_response', context.responseData);
+        }
+
+        // Enhanced timeout context
+        if (context.isTimeout && context.timeoutDetails) {
+          scope.setContext('timeout_analysis', {
+            configuredTimeoutMs: context.timeoutDetails.configuredTimeout,
+            actualDurationMs: context.timeoutDetails.actualDuration,
+            timeoutType: context.timeoutDetails.timeoutType,
+            errorName: context.timeoutDetails.errorName,
+            wasAborted: context.timeoutDetails.wasAborted,
+            performanceRatio: (context.timeoutDetails.actualDuration / context.timeoutDetails.configuredTimeout * 100).toFixed(1) + '%',
+            exceedsTimeout: context.timeoutDetails.actualDuration >= context.timeoutDetails.configuredTimeout,
+          });
+        }
+
+        // Enhanced error categorization
+        if (context.isTimeout) {
+          scope.setTag('error_category', 'timeout');
+          if (context.timeoutDetails?.wasAborted) {
+            scope.setTag('error_subcategory', 'request_aborted');
+          } else {
+            scope.setTag('error_subcategory', 'promise_timeout');
+          }
+        } else if (errorMessage.includes('Network request failed')) {
+          scope.setTag('error_category', 'network');
+        } else if (context.statusCode === 401) {
+          scope.setTag('error_category', 'authentication');
+        } else if (context.statusCode === 500) {
+          scope.setTag('error_category', 'server_error');
+        } else {
+          scope.setTag('error_category', 'unknown');
+        }
+
+        // Add breadcrumb for login flow
+        Sentry.addBreadcrumb({
+          message: 'Login attempt failed',
+          category: 'auth',
+          level: 'error',
+          data: {
+            username: context.username,
+            installationId: context.installationId,
+            statusCode: context.statusCode,
+            hasConnectivity,
+          },
+        });
+
+        console.log('Calling Sentry.captureException...');
+        const eventId = Sentry.captureException(error);
+        console.log('Sentry.captureException called, eventId:', eventId);
+        console.log('Error details sent to Sentry:', {
+          message: errorMessage,
+          stack: error.stack,
+          name: error.name,
+          eventId,
+          captureTime: Date.now() - captureStartTime + 'ms'
+        });
+        
+        resolve(eventId);
+      });
+    });
+    
+    // Force flush to ensure immediate sending
+    console.log('Forcing Sentry flush...');
+    const flushResult = await flushSentryEvents(3000);
+    console.log(flushResult ? 'Sentry flush completed' : 'Sentry flush may have failed');
+    
+  } catch (sentryError) {
+    console.error('Error in captureLoginError Sentry processing:', sentryError);
+  }
+  
+  // Also try a simple test capture to verify connection
+  console.log('Testing simple Sentry capture...');
+  try {
+    const testEventId = Sentry.captureMessage(`Login error test: ${errorMessage}`, 'error');
+    console.log('Test capture eventId:', testEventId);
+    
+    // Flush test message too
+    await flushSentryEvents(2000);
+  } catch (testError) {
+    console.error('Test capture failed:', testError);
+  }
+  
+  console.log('Total captureLoginError duration:', Date.now() - captureStartTime + 'ms');
+};
+
+/**
+ * Capture general API error
+ * @param error The error object
+ * @param apiName The name of the API
+ * @param context Additional context
+ */
+export const captureApiError = (
+  error: Error | any,
+  apiName: string,
+  context?: Record<string, any>
+) => {
+  Sentry.withScope((scope) => {
+    scope.setLevel('error');
+    scope.setTag('error_type', 'api_error');
+    scope.setTag('api_name', apiName);
+
+    if (context) {
+      scope.setContext('api_context', context);
+    }
+
+    Sentry.captureException(error);
+  });
+};

+/**
+ * Add breadcrumb for tracking user actions
+ * @param message Breadcrumb message
+ * @param category Category of the breadcrumb
+ * @param data Additional data
+ */
+export const addBreadcrumb = (
+  message: string,
+  category: string = 'navigation',
+  data?: Record<string, any>
+) => {
+  Sentry.addBreadcrumb({
+    message,
+    category,
+    level: 'info',
+    data,
+  });
+};

+/**
+ * Capture message for non-error events
+ * @param message The message to capture
+ * @param level Severity level
+ * @param context Additional context
+ */
+export const captureMessage = (
+  message: string,
+  level: Sentry.SeverityLevel = 'info',
+  context?: Record<string, any>
+) => {
+  Sentry.withScope((scope) => {
+    scope.setLevel(level);
+
+    if (context) {
+      scope.setContext('message_context', context);
+    }
+
+    Sentry.captureMessage(message, level);
+  });
+};

+/**
+ * Wrap async functions with Sentry error handling
+ * @param fn The async function to wrap
+ * @param errorContext Context to add when error occurs
+ */
+export const withSentry = <T extends (...args: any[]) => Promise<any>>(
+  fn: T,
+  errorContext?: Record<string, any>
+): T => {
+  return (async (...args: Parameters<T>) => {
+    try {
+      return await fn(...args);
+    } catch (error) {
+      Sentry.withScope((scope) => {
+        if (errorContext) {
+          scope.setContext('function_context', errorContext);
+        }
+        Sentry.captureException(error);
+      });
+      throw error;
+    }
+  }) as T;
+};

+/**
+ * Test Sentry connection and configuration
+ * This function helps diagnose why errors might not be appearing in the dashboard
+ */
+export const testSentryConnection = () => {
+  console.log('=== SENTRY CONNECTION DIAGNOSTIC TEST ===');
+  
+  try {
+    // 安全检查 Sentry 是否可用
+    if (!Sentry) {
+      console.error('Sentry is not available');
+      return { success: false, reason: 'Sentry not available' };
+    }
+    
+    console.log('Sentry v6 API - Direct testing mode');
+    console.log('  - Available methods:', Object.keys(Sentry).slice(0, 10).join(', '));
+    
+  } catch (error) {
+    console.error('Error in testSentryConnection:', error);
+    return { success: false, reason: error.message };
+  }
+  
+  // Test 1: Simple message capture
+  console.log('\nTest 1: Simple message capture');
+  try {
+    const messageEventId = Sentry.captureMessage('Sentry connection test message', 'info');
+    console.log('Message captured with eventId:', messageEventId);
+  } catch (error) {
+    console.error('Message capture failed:', error);
+    return { success: false, reason: 'Message capture failed', error };
+  }
+

+  console.log('\nTest 2: Simple exception capture');
+  try {
+    const testError = new Error('Sentry connection test error');
+    const errorEventId = Sentry.captureException(testError);
+    console.log('Exception captured with eventId:', errorEventId);
+  } catch (error) {
+    console.error('Exception capture failed:', error);
+    return { success: false, reason: 'Exception capture failed', error };
+  }

+  // Test 3: Complex error with context (similar to login error)

+    const complexTestError = new Error('FETCH_TIMEOUT: Test timeout error');
+    complexTestError.name = 'TimeoutError';
+    
+    Sentry.withScope((scope) => {
+      scope.setLevel('error');
+      scope.setTag('error_type', 'connection_test');
+      scope.setTag('is_timeout', true);
+      scope.setTag('test_scenario', 'diagnostic');
+      
+      scope.setContext('test_context', {
+        timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),
+        testType: 'connection_diagnostic',
+        userAgent: 'React Native Test',

+        message: 'Running connection diagnostic test',

+  console.log('  1. Network connectivity to Sentry servers');
+  console.log('  2. DSN validity and project permissions');
+  console.log('  3. Firewall/proxy blocking Sentry requests');
+  console.log('  4. Rate limiting on Sentry project');
+  console.log('  5. Environment filters in Sentry dashboard');
+  
+  return { success: true, reason: 'All tests completed successfully' };
+};

+/**
+ * Force flush Sentry events (useful for debugging)
+ * This ensures all pending events are sent immediately
+ */
+export const flushSentryEvents = async (timeout: number = 2000) => {
+  console.log('Flushing Sentry events...');
+  const flushStartTime = Date.now();
+  try {
+    const success = await Sentry.flush(timeout);
+    const flushDuration = Date.now() - flushStartTime;
+    console.log(success 
+      ? `Sentry events flushed successfully in ${flushDuration}ms` 
+      : `Sentry flush timed out after ${flushDuration}ms`);
+    return success;
+  } catch (error) {
+    const flushDuration = Date.now() - flushStartTime;
+    console.error(`Error flushing Sentry events after ${flushDuration}ms:`, error);
+    return false;
+  }
+};
+
+/**
+ * Monitor Sentry event transmission status
+ * This helps debug why events with eventId don't appear in dashboard
+ */
+export const monitorSentryEventTransmission = async (eventId: string, maxWaitTime: number = 10000) => {
+  console.log(`Monitoring transmission of eventId: ${eventId}`);
+  const startTime = Date.now();
+  
+  // Simple monitoring approach - just flush and wait
+  try {
+    console.log('Attempting to flush event to Sentry servers...');
+    const flushSuccess = await flushSentryEvents(maxWaitTime);
+    const duration = Date.now() - startTime;
+    
+    if (flushSuccess) {
+      console.log(`Event ${eventId} flushed successfully after ${duration}ms`);
+      console.log('Check dashboard at: https://stark-ex.sentry.io/issues/');
+      console.log('Events may take 1-2 minutes to appear in dashboard');
+    } else {
+      console.log(`Event ${eventId} flush uncertain after ${duration}ms`);
+      console.log('Possible issues:');
+      console.log('   - Network connectivity problems');
+      console.log('   - Sentry rate limiting');
+      console.log('   - Event filtering/sampling');
+    }
+    
+    return flushSuccess;
+  } catch (error) {
+    console.error(`Error monitoring event ${eventId}:`, error);
+    return false;
+  }
+};

+export const monitorSentryCalls = () => {
+  console.log('=== Sentry Call Monitor Started ===');
+  
+  // Monitor captureException calls
+  const originalCaptureException = Sentry.captureException;
+  Sentry.captureException = function(...args) {
+    console.log('Sentry.captureException called:', args[0]?.message || args[0]);
+    return originalCaptureException.apply(this, args);
+  };
+  
+  // Monitor captureMessage calls
+  const originalCaptureMessage = Sentry.captureMessage;
+  Sentry.captureMessage = function(...args) {
+    console.log('Sentry.captureMessage called:', args[0]);
+    return originalCaptureMessage.apply(this, args);
+  };
+  
+  // Monitor withScope calls
+  const originalWithScope = Sentry.withScope;
+  Sentry.withScope = function(callback) {
+    console.log('Sentry.withScope called');
+    return originalWithScope.call(this, (scope) => {
+      console.log('Scope callback executing...');
+      return callback(scope);
+    });
+  };
+  
+  console.log('Sentry call monitoring enabled');
+  console.log('   Now trigger your timeout error and watch console');
+};
